First Lasso, random forests and Gradient Boosting the SVM and BP neural network model and LSTM six kinds of single algorithm electricity price models are construct, and then the combination model of Lasso, BP neural network and LSTM combining six algorithms and the combination model of BP neural network model combining three kinds of algorithm are constructed. The actual electricity price and load data from Queensland were used for simulation, and the simulation results shows that: Among the single algorithmic electricity price models, the LSTM model has the highest accuracy. BP neural network is suitable for combining the single algorithm electricity price model. The BP neural network model with the combination of the six algorithms has the highest accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Resonant Frequency Feedback Control Strategy of EAST Fishtail Divertor Magnet Coil Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Fishtail divertor (FTD), a new divertor concept, is a significant research object of EAST tokamak divertor system. Considering the requirement of sinusoidal current precision and stable output with variable frequency (10-3800Hz) and adjustable amplitude (0-5000A) in complex and arguable electromagnetic environment, a resonant frequency feedback control strategy is proposed for FTD magnet coil power supply. The equivalent mathematical model of the FTD coil PS and control process is set up. Through detailed theoretical analysis and simulation, the conclusion of performance optimization based on control strategy is obtained. At the work of frequency feedback control strategy, the power supply can promptly identify the resonant network frequency deviation caused by the interference of electromagnetic environment on the equivalent load characteristics within 1.5S, and actively correct the excitation voltage frequency, so as to ensure the accuracy of the FTD magnet coil current. Finally, the correctness of the design is verified through experimental tests.

articleTitle: Research on Harmonic Response of Voltage Transformers Based on Jiles-Atherton Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the inherent hysteresis characteristics and saturation characteristics of ferromagnetic materials, it is difficult to accurately establish a simulation model for a voltage transformer. In order to study the harmonic response of voltage transformers considering the hysteresis effect of iron core, a method for studying the harmonic transformation characteristics of voltage transformers is proposed. Based on the Jiles-Atherton model, the voltage transformer model is built. The hysteresis loop of the voltage transformer is measured by the RC integration circuit. The Jiles-Atherton model is used to identify the parameters and replace it into the built-in voltage transformer model. Compared with the harmonic transformation characteristics of the voltage transformer obtained by the experiment, the accuracy of the model is verified. Finally, through the experiment and simulation, the linear relationship between the ratio error of voltage transformer and the harmonic order is obtained. Compared with the traditional voltage transformer model, this model can more accurately reflect the excitation characteristics of the voltage transformer.

articleTitle: Arc-extinguish Characteristic Onsite Detection and Evaluation of Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The arc-extinguish characteristics are the most important performance of the circuit breaker. However there is still no methods of onsite detection and evaluation. The current methods of detection and evaluation include the electrical life method and the dynamic resistance method. The electrical life method cannot reflect the abrupt change of the arc-extinguish characteristics. The dynamic resistance method cannot be carried out onsite. In this paper, a method of evaluating the arc-extinguish characteristics of a circuit breaker based on the detection of radiated electromagnetic waves is proposed, which can detect and evaluate the arc-extinguish characteristics of the circuit breaker. The basic principle of the method is introduced, and the simulation platform is established in the laboratory. The influence of breaking voltage, breaking speed and ablation degree on the radiation electromagnetic wave signal is studied. In addition, a case was presented.

articleTitle: Background Harmonic Transfer and Mitigation in a Two-Terminal MMC-HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Recently, the modular multilevel converter (MMC) topology has been increasingly applied in power systems such as high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission systems, for the interconnection of offshore wind power plants into onshore AC power systems, interconnection of asynchronous AC power systems, etc. However, in some cases such as the HVDC system connected with wind power plants or hybrid HVDC systems, background harmonics may arise at the PCC of systems, these harmonics may transfer to HVDC systems and linked AC power systems, causing adverse effects or unexpected faults to the systems. The harmonic analysis of MMC phase-leg voltage under the influence of background harmonics is depicted in this work, from which a harmonic compensation method is proposed to mitigate the harmonic propagation in the system. Simulation results based on the model built in PSCAD/EMTDC platform approve the effectualness of the recommended method. The suggested method not only mitigates the harmonic transfer from one AC source to another in the HVDC transmission system, but also benefits in avoiding possible harmonic resonances in the system as well as the reduction of costly harmonic filters.

articleTitle: GPU-Accelerated Batch Solution for Short-Circuit Current Calculation of Large-scale Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the growing scale of the power systems, short-circuit current calculation becomes one of the most important, but intensive computational tasks for the power system planning and operation. Calculating the large-scale short-circuit current accurately and efficiently has great significance in practice. Graphics processing unit (GPU) has great potential in power system applications due to its superior performance in float-pointing calculation and memory bandwidth. To actively adapt to the unique characteristics of GPU’s software and hardware, a batch solution for short-circuit current calculation is designed and implemented by parallelizing kernel algorithms without compromising computational accuracy. Large-scale test systems are simulated to verify the accuracy and efficiency. Especially, compared with the counterpart CPU implementation, the proposed method can achieve about 36 times speedup ratio for the 10000-bus power system.

articleTitle: Study on Heat Transfer Characteristics of Serrated Fins of Plate-Fin Heat Sink
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the air-side channels in the plate-fin radiator are simulated for the serrated fins in the plate-fin heat sink. The Nusselt number of the fins under different Reynolds numbers, the relationship between the surface heat transfer factor, resistance factor and the Reynolds number are calculated. The numerical simulation results are compared with the relevant literature empirical values and empirical formulas. The calculation results show that with the increase of Re number, the Nusselt number, convective heat transfer coefficient and pressure drop of the heat sink increase with each other; the heat transfer factor and the resistance factor increase with the Reynolds number go downwhich can guide the determination of the size of the plate fin radiator.

articleTitle: Model Prediction and Rule Based Energy Management Strategy for Hybrid Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a real-time energy management strategy is proposed for a plug-in hybrid electric vehicle with the hybrid energy storage system including a Ni-Co-Mn Li-ion battery pack and a Lithium-Titanium-Oxide battery pack. Through modeling, a state-of-charge and state-of-power capability joint estimator is proposed to forecast the dynamic performance of battery packs. A model prediction and rule based energy management strategy using the joint estimator and fuzzy logic control is developed. For comparison, we analyzed a conventional rule based energy management strategy. Thereafter, a quantifiable battery degradation model and the hardware in loop tests are derived to evaluate two kinds of strategies. The results demonstrate that the overall performance of the hybrid energy storage system can be improved significantly by using the energy management strategy proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on WebGIS Technology of Small Hydro Group Based on HTML5
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a small hydro group WebGIS based on HTML5, which solves the problems of large number, wide distribution, disorderly management and difficult maintenance of small hydro group. The tile pyramid technology is used to migrate the map data needed by the small hydro group GIS to the local area for processing, storage and display, which realizes the localization of maps. Using HTML5 Canvas, the browser uses JavaScript to render graphics and draw dynamic graphics, which enriches the user’s experience. Data information such as water level, installed capacity and output load of small hydro station is transmitted between server and client through HTML5 WebSocket and WebStorage. The real-time data exchange between server and map interface is realized by using these technologies. The Small Hydro Group GIS adopts the service-oriented architecture (SOA) based on Web services, which enhances the compatibility, integration and interoperability of the system. The actual operation of a dispatching center shows that the system solves the problem of data management of hydro stations in the past, and can display the geographic information and operation status of hydro stations in real time and accurately. This system provides an integrated management platform for dispatchers.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Emission of Maglev Vehicle by Linear Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High-speed maglev adopts long-stator linear synchronous motor, which can realize train suspension and traction simultaneously by adjusting the air-gap magnetic field. However, the air-gap field will leak along the tangential direction of the motor. The electromagnetic emission of linear motor in maglev train carriage is studied through the establishment of three-dimensional linear motor finite element model combined with new high-speed maglev vehicle model. Originally in this paper, the leakage magnetic emission in the carriage is analyzed at different frequencies under normal working condition and abnormal working condition in which one side of the motor lacks a phase. The effect of the magnetic emission on passengers is evaluated through the relevant magnetic emission exposure limits. The results show that the magnetic emission meets the limits of ICNIRP and EN 45502-2-3 under normal working condition. But the low-frequency magnetic emission is shifted to the side of the phase-lacking motor under phase-lacking working condition, and the overall magnetic emission in the carriage is nearly 10 times larger, which has adverse effects on passengers wearing cochlear implants especially. Therefore, the abnormal phase-lacking condition should be avoided to ensure safety of passengers.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Charging Design of SiC SEPIC LLC Voltage Tracking Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a new SEPIC LLC energy storage device is designed by using the third generation semiconductor device silicon carbide (SiC). By analyzing the charging curve and considering the characteristics of the battery load, the working area of the LLC circuit is obtained, thus an optimal LLC design scheme is put forward. In this way, even if in the worse working environment, the circuit can work stably in the ZVS region. In addition, combined with the current voltage variation during charging and the current SEPIC PFC buck-boost characteristics, a voltage tracking technique is proposed. By changing the input voltage LLC and ensuring LLC work near the resonant frequency, which can meet the needs of 11c rectifier diode to realize zcs, and improve the power in the charging process. Finally, combined with the characteristics of SiC, the efficiency of SEPIC LLC can be increased to 88%.

articleTitle: A Novel Switching Strategy of Dual Active Bridge Converter with Hybrid Switch for Efficiency Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a switching strategy is proposed for the extended phase shift (EPS) controlled dual active bridge (DAB) converter which using the hybrid switch (HyS) configured by paralleling SiC MOSFET and Si IGBT, considering the special soft switching characteristic of DAB. For most of the existing literature, the common switching strategy of HyS is to switch on the SiC MOSFET before Si IGBT and switch off the SiC MOSFET after Si IGBT. However, if only using this switching strategy, the SiC MOSFET may be damaged by long-time operating at the over rated current condition. The proposed switching strategy for the HyS is that the SiC MOSFET is only conducted for a short while during the process of switching Si IGBT on or off. The proposed switching strategy can shorten the conduction time of SiC MOSFET, decrease the losses of HyS and extend the safe operation area of HyS. Simulation results on a 30 kW HyS DAB converter verify the availability of the proposed switching strategy.

articleTitle: Conductivity Current and Electric Breakdown Properties of Thermally Aged Nano Silicone Rubber
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this study, pure, Nano-Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and Nano-MgO silicone rubber are used to study the conductivity current characteristic and electric breakdown property after thermal aging. After 20 days thermal aging, all three kinds of silicone rubber experience decrease of conductivity current. For further aging of 40 days, the conductivity current of pure silicon rubber increases while that of Nano-Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and Nano-MgO almost remain the same as the conductivity of 20 days aging. After 20 days thermal aging, the electric breakdown field of all three kinds of silicone rubber increase. As the thermal aging continues to 40 days, the electric breakdown field of pure silicone rubber decrease from 107 kV/mm to 92 kV/mm, while that of Nano-Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, Nano-MgO silicone rubber only decrease by 3 kV/mm and 5 kV/mm respectively. We believe that the decrease of conductivity current and increase of electric breakdown field of all three kinds of silicone rubber during the beginning of thermal aging are due to the further vulcanization. The reason that Nano-Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and Nano-MgO silicone rubber shows better anti-aging properties in the further thermal aging period can be contributed to the better heat-conducting property which results in better heat dispersion

articleTitle: Temperature Rise Analysis of High Power Density Permanent Magnet Motor Based on Fluid-solid Coupling
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The temperature rise of the high power density motor directly influences the stability and reliability of the operation of the motor, and it has great significance to accurately calculate the temperature rise of the motor and rationally design the cooling system. In this paper, a water-cooled permanent magnet synchronous motor with a rated power of 40 kW is considered. Two types of waterway structures used as the cooling system are respectively analyzed, and the reasonable waterway structure is selected from the aspects of pressure, flow velocity, cooling effect and so on. The loss values obtained from electromagnetic field calculation are applied to the temperature field as the heat source. The 3-D temperature field simulation model of the motor is established based on the reasonable equivalence and assumption, and the temperature field simulation of the rated working condition and the short-time peak working condition is carried out based on the finite element method and fluid-solid coupling. The temperature field simulation result is agreed well with the temperature rise experiment result, which verifies the accuracy of the simulation and the effectiveness of the cooling system, and ensures the stable and reliable operation of the motor.

articleTitle: Development of High-Speed Mechanical Switchgear with Vacuum Interruption Technology and Application in HVDC Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High-speed switchgear is an essential part of HVDC mechanical circuit breakers. Taking advantage of faster dielectric recovery of vacuum interrupter, DC current interruption can be achieved by vacuum interrupter driven by high-speed operating mechanism and artificial current zero supplied with high frequency commutation current. The current frequency of commutation branch and the mechanical characteristic of high-speed switchgear are studied to develop a 50kV breaking unit as a building block of HVDC circuit breaker. A safe interruption zone where DC current interruption can be successfully made within a range of current frequency and gap distance is found out. Based on the developed building block, a scheme of ±500kV HVDC mechanical circuit breaker with a series of high-speed switchgears is developed successfully.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation of Regional Integrated Energy System Considering Energy Storage and Conversion
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the optimal operation of regional integrated energy system(RIES) considering energy storage(ES) and conversion is studied. Firstly, the basic model of regional integrated energy system is established, and then the models of energy storage, power to gas(P2G) and electric heat pump(EHP) are established. Four scenarios are put forward according to the energy storage and conversion devices. Examples are established to model and solve the optimization operation problem of regional integrated energy system. The comparison results of system cost, energy efficiency and carbon emission under four scenarios are obtained. The results show that the EHP model has the lowest cost and the highest energy efficiency, but the worst environmental efficiency. The scenarios with energy storage and conversion are superior to the basic model in terms of cost and energy efficiency. This paper makes a comparative analysis of three modes of energy storage and conversion and their roles and basic models in RIES optimal operation, which has practical guiding significance.

articleTitle: Optimal Purchasing and Selling Strategies for Electricity-retailers Based on Scale Spatial Scenario Generation and Flexible Resource Integration
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of China's electricity market, the purchasing and selling strategies of electricity retailers (ER) have attracted great concern. Taking demand side response into account, this paper proposes a comprehensive profit optimization model, which takes bilateral risks in both purchasing and selling businesses of electricity market into consideration. In the proposed model, the scale spatial clustering method is used to generate multi-variant scenario with an adaptive gradient tracking, including the spot price, the output of renewable energy, demand-response (DR) behaviors and the random fluctuation of demand from users. Moreover, the external environment of demand response in power market is taken in consideration, which reflected in the interruptible load and transferable load profit model. Based on the probabilistic scenario, the day-ahead strategies of the ER are randomly optimized, considering the bilateral business of purchasing and selling profiles. Utilizing the simulation of case studies, the results show that the proposed model is suitable and effective to be used for determining the purchasing and selling strategy of the electricity-sales companies.

articleTitle: Study on Field Calibration Technology of Zero Flux DC Current Transformer in ±500kV Converter Station
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Carrying out researches on field calibration test of DC current transformer is of great significance for improving the type test and field test system of DC current transformer. In this paper, the field calibration technology of DC current transformer was studied. The scene of the DC current transformer calibration experiment method was proposed. Besides, the high stability DC current source rated 5000A/12V and the GPS wireless synchronous data acquisition device was developed. On this basis, the field calibration tests of three zero flux DC current transforms operating in Deyang ±500 kV DC converter station neutral wires were carried out. Test results indicate that the error property of zero magnetic current transformers in Deyang ±500kV DC converter station is stable, and the calibration method proposed in this paper is reasonable.

articleTitle: Single-phase Grounding Fault Location Method for Distribution Network Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When a single-phase ground fault occurs in the distribution network, it is generally allowed to operate with faults from 1 to 2 hours, which may lead to further development of the fault and even threaten the safe operation of the power system. Therefore, when a small current system has a ground fault, it must be quickly diagnosed to shorten the time for the distribution network operation and maintenance personnel to eliminate the fault, thereby improving the safety of the distribution network operation. It proposes a single-phase grounding fault line selection method based on convolutional neural network (CNN). Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) is used to extract the negative sequence voltage and current phasors at both ends of the fault line, and the principle of double-terminal fault location is applied to high-precision fault location. Simulink simulation results show that the proposed method can realize line selection and accurate location of single-phase ground fault in distribution network, and is not affected by system frequency, fault location, transition resistance or other factors.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control of Active and Reactive Power of Distribution Network with Distributed Photovoltaic Based On Scene Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Variables such as distributed generation (DG) output and load demand have randomness and volatility, brings large challenges to operation and control of distribution network. In order to solve this problem, this paper generates multiple scene samples through Latin hypercube sampling (LHS) based on mathematical distribution model of variables, then reduces the scene samples by K-means clustering, typical scenes and the probability of each typical scene are obtained. Considering the adjustable capabilities of distributed photovoltaic (PV) and energy storage system (ESS), a multi-objective optimization model based on scene analysis for coordinated control of active and reactive power in distribution network is established, and the mixed integer nonlinear programming model is solved by second-order cone relaxation (SOCR) technique. Finally, the improved IEEE 33-node system is taken as an example for simulation with results confirming accuracy and rationality of the proposed algorithm.

Author Keywords: coordinated control of active and reactive power

articleTitle: Simulation and Experimental Study of Solenoid SFCL Under DC Impact Current
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As one of the most valid ways for the control and break of short-circuit current in the voltage source converter based high voltage direct current (VSC-HVdc) power systems, superconducting fault current limiter (SFCL) has received more and more attention, especially the resistive SFCL. In this paper, the simulation and experimental study of solenoid SFCL wounded by AMSC 8602 YBCO superconducting tape are carried out. The results show that the simulation using electric-thermal coupling model has certain credibility. When the initial voltage of the discharge capacitor is 1.5 kV, the fault current limiting rate of the solenoid SFCL is 33.3%. During the dc impact stage, the peak value of the voltage curve lags behind that of the impact current curve. The resistance inflection points of the solenoid SFCL are all 0.22¡. The Q-R curves of the solenoid SFCL are almost coincident under different impact conditions, indicating that the law of the resistance change with Joule heat is certain.

articleTitle: Study on Business Model of Virtual Power Plant based on Osterwalder Business Model Canvas
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The continuing shortage of fuel resources and the deterioration of the environment have forced the energy revolution, which is characterized by sustainable development, to accelerate. In this situation, the concept of the virtual power plant is introduced and considered to be the ultimate configuration of the Energy Internet. In this paper, the emphasis is given on the business models of virtual power plants. Firstly, the developments of the concept and connotation of virtual power plant are analyzed. And then, based on the Osterwalder business model canvas, the business model of virtual power plant is analyzed from nine different perspectives, including the customer segments, the value propositions, the channels, the customer relationships, the revenue streams, the key resources, the key activities, the key partnerships, and the cost structure. Finally, research prospects are given for the guidance of further research to innovate the business models of virtual power plant.

articleTitle: Research of Traffic Energy System and Optimization Operation Unified Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the integration of power systems and traffic systems accelerates, traffic energy systems are gradually taking shape. Firstly, the transformation of the traditional power system and traffic system to traffic energy system is expounded. Taking the transformation of private traffic as an opportunity, with the improvement of information sharing dimension, the architecture of traffic energy system is constructed. The energy consumption characteristics of the grid and traffic energy characteristics are fully considered. The different characteristics and energy value of the participants involved in the traffic energy system are fully reflected in the structure based on four different types of electric vehicles. Finally, a comprehensive optimization operation model of traffic energy system considering battery state of charge and time-space sequencing is proposed to realize real-time intelligent flow control of energy in the system.

articleTitle: Condition Analysis on Implementation of On-Line Monitoring of IGBT Modules of Three-Level NPC Inverters
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Implementation of on-line monitoring of IGBT modules in the three-level NPC inverters is necessary nowadays. The implementation of on-line monitoring requires an on-line monitoring condition and off-line monitoring technique to attach. In the previous study, it has been researched that the saturated voltage drop (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">CE</sub>) is one of the most essential diagnostic sign of IGBTs' healthy status, which is the key point of off-line monitoring technique in the monitoring system. So the on-line monitoring condition is mainly researched in this paper. Analysis has been made to show that it is necessary to force the operating state of monitored phase of inverter to be O state during the on-line monitoring. The results of simulation and experiment of the process of on-line monitoring verify the correctness of the condition analysis in this paper.

articleTitle: Internal pressure distributions of press-pack IGBT modules under two contact methods
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Pressure contact methods of press-pack IGBT include rigid contact and compliant contact. The rigid contact structure is supported by rigid copper electrode for each chip module, and the compliant contact structure is supported by disc spring assemble for each chip module. In this paper, the finite element mechanical models of IGBT sub-modules in rigid and compliant contact were established, and the pressure distribution rules of the chips under different height tolerances and uneven forces on the modules were analyzed. The experimental tests on IGBT samples using two kinds of contact methods were carried out by mechanical press and FUJI prescale films, and the correctness of the FEM simulation results was verified. By comparison, it is found that the use of disc springs will compensate for the displacement deviations caused by the machining errors, thereby automatically adjusting the pressure distributions on surfaces of chips. The parameters of the disc springs are more easily controlled than the machining errors of the various components, thus the requirements for the packaging process can be reduced.

articleTitle: Review on Met Mast Site Selection Methods in Grid-Connected Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Met mast is one of the most important devices to assessing wind resource, calculating wind energy production and predicting wind power in the grid-connected wind farm. Met mast site selection is a key problem for the representativeness. Met mast site selection in the grid-connected wind farm was discussed in this paper. First, this paper analyzed the differences of establishing conditions between the met mast in the grid-connected wind farm and in the wind farm being designed. The best site to build a met mast may change because of the change of the flow field in the wind farm. Second, the principles of met mast site selection are summarized. Wake impact which causing the changes of flow field should be considered in the site selection of a met mast. Last, suggestion and research direction about the met mast site selection in grid-connected wind farm are proposed.

articleTitle: EEAC-based Transient Stability Analysis of Hydropower System Considering Different Practical Hydroelectric Generator Models
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Hydropower is the largest renewable energy source in China. Transient stability is of great significance to the hydropower system. The extended equal area criterion (EEAC) theory is an effective method to analyze the system transient stability. The accuracy of the transient stability analysis is affected by the generator models. However, there is little research on the EEAC-based transient stability analysis of hydropower system considering different practical hydroelectric generator models. To fill this gap, this paper firstly introduces the characteristic of the second-order and fifth-order model of hydroelectric generators. Subsequently, the transient stability of the hydropower system considering generator models with different orders is analyzed based on EEAC theory and validated by time-domain simulation. Finally, the applicability of the second-order and fifth-order model is compared under different parameters of super-transient/ transient reactance, different fault locations and different super-transient time constants.

articleTitle: The Analysis and Modeling of TCSC in the Low-Frequency Oscillation Suppression of Electrified Railway
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, the low-frequency oscillation phenomenon in the coupling system of electrified high-speed vehicles and traction power supply grid (hereinafter referred to as vehicle-grid system) occurs frequently, which causes traction blockade. Focusing on the problem of low-frequency oscillation in vehicle-grid coupling system, this paper applies small signal impedance model to analyze the stability of vehicle-grid coupling system. Based on the simulation platform of Matlab/Simulink, an integrated simulation model of HXD2B electric vehicle and traction power supply grid is established, which reproduces the phenomenon of low-frequency oscillation. In addition, a method to suppress low-frequency oscillation by adding Thyristor Controlled Series Compensator (TCSC) from grid side is proposed. TCSC and its control scheme simulation model are established based on Matlab/Simulink. It is shown from the simulation results that the effectiveness of the proposed suppression measures is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Distortion Field of Inspection Robot around 500kV Substation Transformer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Artificial intelligence technology has developed rapidly, and inspection robots have been increasingly applied to the inspection work of substations. The electromagnetic environment of the substation is complex, and whether the inspection robot can work normally in a complex electromagnetic environment is a problem worthy of attention. Therefore, this paper establishes an inspection robot model to explore the electric field distribution of the inspection robot during substation operation. The Charge Simulation Method is suitable for the calculation of open domain, and the Finite Element Method is suitable for the calculation of complex boundary problems. Combining the advantages of the two, this paper uses the mixed calculation of Finite Element Method and Charge Simulation method to analyze the electric field distribution around the inspection robot when it's working. The results of computation show that the electric field around each device is distorted, and the electric field distortion around the top device is the most serious.

articleTitle: Research on Bidirectional Active Equalization Control Strategy of Lithium Battery Pack for Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Lithium battery pack is the smallest unit of energy storage system. Due to differences in manufacturing processes and usage environments, it is easy to cause the battery unit to be unbalanced, affect the overall performance of the battery pack and increase the safety hazard of overcharging and over discharging of the battery after long-term use. In this paper, the battery state of charge is used as the equalization variable, and the bidirectional flyback converter is used as the energy transfer circuit. A bidirectional active equalization control strategy is proposed for the energy storage lithium battery pack. The fuzzy PI controller is designed to optimize the equalization current, thus improving the equalization speed and efficiency. The equilibrium simulation model is built in MATLAB. The equilibrium results verify the effectiveness of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Fault Location in VSC-HVDC Using Stacked Denoising Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposed an intelligent algorithm based approach for fault location in a high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission system. To obtain post-fault signals, the point-to-point HVDC transmission lines, including overhead lines and cables, are modeled on PSCAD/EMTDC. The data set is split into two parts used for training and testing, separately. The proposed method uses stacked denoising autoencoder (SDAE), which takes the raw training data as the input of network and can directly obtain fault locations. SDAE with unsupervised learning is utilized to extract representative features automatically from raw data in pre-training. Then labeled data is applied to network for fine-tuning in a supervised manner. The testing data is used for the evaluation of the proposed method. The simulation results indicate that the SDAE based method performs well in fault location and has robustness against noises, ground resistances, and system parameters.

articleTitle: Real Taxi Operation Data and User Charging Expectation Pricing Based Charging Station Setting Position Decision Support System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, with increasing environmental and energy pressures, countries around the world have begun to adopt incentive policies for electric vehicles. Due to the rapid growth of the charging car market, research on electric vehicles and related facilities is imperative. Based on the passenger car operation data of Guangzhou City, we can obtain the position information of the vehicle when it reaches the preset driving position through the energy consumption position analysis. Then by constructing constraints and objective functions, taking into account the user's mileage anxiety, we use the charging station distribution location optimization algorithm to get the best location of the Guangzhou charging station. At the end of the article, this paper summarizes the charging station allocation method based on the actual driving situation of the user. This method provides a new decision-making idea for the academic community.

articleTitle: Standardized Management Mechanism for Power Grid Emergencies Based on Typical Case Base Updating Strategy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: According to the requirement of stability and safety of power grid and the high-speed construction of power information network, the standardized management mechanism for power grid emergencies based on typical case base updating strategy is proposed. Based on the classification and the level of emergency, the emergency information reporting process is improved. With the design of a standard case framework including basic attributes, feature attributes, processing patterns and evaluation attributes, the case matching mechanism and the case update mechanism is proposed, and the application of H-law algorithm is greatly improves the efficiency of case matching. Typical case base has the advantages of high hit rate and easy expansion, which can be applied in the field of power emergency management.

articleTitle: Evaluation for the Operation and Maintenance Quality of Electricity Information Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The accuracy of data acquisition is the key to measure the operation and maintenance quality of electricity information acquisition system. An evaluation method for the acquisition system is established in this paper, which covers the arrangement of main station, the operation condition of smart meter, maintenance strategy and other indicators. Analytic Hierarchy Process is adopted to determine the weight of each single indicator. It is concluded that the key factor affecting the accuracy of acquisition is the normal operation of smart meters. Therefore, it is necessary to evaluate the smart meters and the back propagation neural network is employed as assessment method. The training samples are obtained according to the corresponding relationship between fault symptoms and fault types. Through the self-learning process of training network, the model is developed, and the correctness is verified by simulation with test samples, which shows that this method can determine the fault type quickly and accurately, realize the related evaluation, and improve the quality and efficiency of operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: State Detection Technology and Failure Mechanism of Energy Fiber in HVDC Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the high failure rate, the state detection and fault location cannot be performed and the failure mechanism are difficult to diagnose of the energy fiber in HVDC measurement system. Based on Optical Time-Domain Reflectometry, a new state detection and fault location technology(EFDL) of energy fiber in HVDC measurement system is proposed, which can realize continuous status detection and fast fault location of energy fibers. Based on this EFDL technology, By the dynamic accelerated aging test of independent factor variables extraction such as temperature, macrobend, high power injection, end-face cleanliness and external pressure, the failure mechanism of energy fiber are analyzed, and the full life cycle management is supported.

articleTitle: Research on Emergency Power Control Method for Hybrid DC Grid and Its Effect
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Based on the closed-loop control theory of power system transient stability, this paper studies the influence of emergency power control of hybrid DC grid on AC/DC system transient stability under AC fault conditions. The emergency power control margin of hybrid DC grid is investigated, and the collaboration method of hybrid DC grid emergency power control and generation shedding is proposed. Based on DIgSILENT, a AC/DC hybrid network topology with a 5-terminal hybrid DC grid embedded into the IEEE 39-node system is developed, and the simulation results verified the effectiveness as well as the economic efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Optimization Strategy of Secondary Sound Source in Active Noise Control System of Power Transformer Based on Monte Carlo Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The active noise control (ANC) technology has been the main application method at present, and the optimal selection of the number, location, amplitude and phase of secondary sources is a core issue. This study mainly starts from the optimization of the secondary sound source layout to improve the noise reduction performance of ANC system. In this study, an electric-magnetic-structure-acoustic multi-physics field coupling model of transformer was established, and its sound field distribution characteristics were analyzed. Then this study simulated and verified the noise reduction effect of the simplified sound source model and transformer model. The sum of the squares of all the monitoring points' sound pressure was selected by mathematical derivation as the objective function of the optimization. In this study, the multi-coupled secondary sound source parameters were optimized by using the established transformer sound field radiation model in combination with the field environment. Considering the interaction between the secondary sound source location and the sound source strength, we decided to use the Monte Carlo method to optimize the location and strength variables of the secondary sound source to eliminate the effects of their interactions as much as possible. The location and strength parameters under different numbers of secondary sound sources were obtained respectively. This study combined simulation software to verify the feasibility of the research method. The final simulation results show that the method has the better active noise reduction effect.

articleTitle: Optimization of opening and closing test circuit for back-to-back capacitor bank in high voltage and large capacity laboratory
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the power grid, when the high-voltage circuit breaker frequently operates the switching capacitor bank, the recovery voltage is high and the time is long, which poses a serious threat to the grid device and system insulation, especially when the back-to-back parallel capacitor bank is broken. Because the high-voltage circuit breaker is suitable for the back-to-back capacitor group test, the test voltage is high and the capacitor bank has a large capacity. Therefore, the test parameters of the conventional large-capacity short-circuit experimental station are difficult to meet the requirements of the standard for the inrush current frequency and peak value.

articleTitle: Research on Overload Current Measurement of Intelligent Process of Miniature Circuit Breaker Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The intelligentization of circuit breakers is related to the development of smart grids. At present, the intelligent technology of air circuit breakers and moulded case circuit breakers has matured, but small circuit breakers rarely see their related reports. This is because the most critical of the intelligentization of the circuit breaker is the current detection technology, and the existing current measurement means cannot break the limitation of the small size of the miniature circuit breaker, thereby restricting the development of the miniature circuit breaker to the intelligent direction. In this paper, the current of the miniature circuit breaker is measured by the current thermal effect and BP neural network modeling method. The BP neural network model was established by some experimental data and trained to obtain a miniature circuit breaker current measurement model, and the model was validated with experimental data not involved in training. The results show that the model can accurately calculate the overload current of the miniature circuit breaker, which provides a reference for the current measurement of the miniature circuit breaker.

articleTitle: Information Reconstruction Error Evaluation Method Based on Singular Entropy Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Communication failures of digital substations can result in loss of sampled information data. Information reconstruction algorithms are often used to reconstruct missing sample data, which causes errors in the amplitude and phase of the Fourier filter calculation. Studies have shown that the amount and location of sampled data loss has a direct impact on the size of the reconstruction error. Combining the singular value decomposition and information entropy theory, this paper comprehensively considers the influencing factors of reconstruction error, studies the correlation between reconstruction error and sampling data singular entropy, and proposes a reconstruction error estimation method based on singular entropy. This method is used to evaluate the reconstruction errors of three interpolation methods.

articleTitle: Digital Business Operation Management of Distribution Companies Based on Big Data Thinking
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of information science and technology, the digital transformation of the power industry has become the general trend. Faced with the demand of digital transformation, distribution companies need to make the best use of power big data to achieve data-driven business operation. This paper proposes digital operation management framework for distribution companies, which is based on big data thinking. Firstly, this paper develops a business operational index framework for distribution companies. Secondly, the bussiness management is divided into three stages: problem identification, root cause analysis and case optimization. At each stage, this paper proposes a set of data analytic methods based on big data technologies. Case studies indicate that the proposed framework can transform decision-making from qualitative analysis to quantitative analysis, therefore enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of business operation.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Electric and Heat Integrated Energy System with Operational Constraints
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The regional integrated energy system is one of the effective ways to give full play to the complementary characteristics of various types of energy and to achieve energy step utilization. Considering the operational constraints of electric and thermal subsystems, a new hybrid energy station (HES) model is proposed. Firstly, the electric and thermal subsystems are modeled and solved, and the energy flow coupling structure of the new hybrid energy system is analyzed, and forming an electric and heat integrated energy system (EHIES) solution model; With the goal of minimum daily operating costs of HES, new and reasonable operational constraints of EHIES are set, and applying particle swarm optimization to optimize the EHIES energy flow to provide an optimal energy supply solution. It is verified by examples that through the coupling and transformation of energy, the comprehensive utilization of energy is improved, the operating cost of HES is reduced, and the electrical and heat subsystems all meet operational constraints.

Author Keywords: electric and heat integrated energy system

articleTitle: Research on Power System Fault Diagnosis Architecture Based on MAS
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A power system fault diagnosis framework based on multi-agent system (MAS) is proposed to realize the parallelization and intelligence of grid fault diagnosis system. In the form of encapsulating multiple sub-modules of power grid fault diagnosis function, the multi-agent system model of power grid fault diagnosis with perception, reasoning and interaction is formed. Under the co-operation of agents, the fault diagnosis system is designed and the complex fault analysis of power grid is realized. Finally, taking the 3/2 wiring fault analysis as example, the MAS cooperation architecture is analyzed.

articleTitle: Analysis of high frequency current at the sampling instant of SPMSM Based on High Frequency signal Injection method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents the influence factors of the high frequency current at the sampling instant based on the high frequency square-wave-type voltage injection method. Due to the use of SVPWM control strategy, the mathematical model of the surface-mounted permanent magnet synchronous motor (SPMSM) under the high frequency square-wave-type voltage injection method is established. Further, it can be deduced that the high frequency current at the sampling instant is affected by the amplitude of the injection voltage, DC-link voltage, switching period, estimated rotor position and motor parameters. Through changing these variables, the high frequency current at the sampling instant can be increased to guarantee the higher signal to noise ratio and the accuracy of the position tracking. Finally, the analysis are verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Overview of the Electricity Futures Market
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the deepening of China’s electricity market reform and the start of spot electricity market, the establishment of electricity futures market is of great significance. Firstly, this paper gives an overview of electricity futures trading from four aspects: trading characteristics, trading modes, futures contracts classification and contracts elements. Secondly, taking the United States, Nordic Europe and other countries and regions as examples, the development of futures trading in foreign electricity markets is introduced, including the development of futures market, the improvement measures of exchanges, the main types of contracts and the conversion between contracts. Then, the most important hedging function of electricity futures is introduced and exemplified. Finally, based on the experience of foreign countries and the current situation of China, some suggestions on the construction of electricity futures market are put forward.

articleTitle: A Domain Decomposition Charge Simulation Method for Calculation of Power-frequency Electric Field
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The distribution of power frequency electric field caused by super-high level power transmission engineering is an important issue in evaluation of electromagnetic environment problem. The calculation of this field around power transmission facilities in complex environment using Charge Simulation Method (CSM) is sometimes out of action for the reason of not enough RAM. This paper put forward a domain decomposition CSM. This method divided the calculation region into several subdomains with some overlapped parts at the border first. Then CSM is applied to these subdomains respectively to get the distribution of simulation charges. The impact of the adjacent domain (boundary problem) is solved by using iterative method. Finally, the distribution of electric field in different domains can be calculated respectively with simulation charges obtained inside its own domain. This method is verified and it is applied to the analysis of power frequency electric field around 500kV transformers in 500kV substation. The results indicate that this method can speed up the calculation and decrease the requirement of RAM. This method provides an effective way to analyze the distribution of power frequency electric field with complex environment.

articleTitle: Fault Location Based on Comparison of Current Information for Distribution Network with DGs
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For the distribution network with high-permeability distributed generations (DGs) access, the system is multi-directional, the topology is flexible, and the fault characteristics are different. The fault location principle of comprehensive fault current information comparison is proposed. Comparison of current amplitude and phase angle for fast and reliable positioning. The model of 10kV distribution network with DG was built by PSCAD, and various factors such as different positions, fault types and different DG penetration rates were simulated. It was proved that the proposed method need simple data and low configuration requirements, and it can achieve accurate fault location in many cases.

Author Keywords: amplitude and phase angle of positive sequence fault current
the criterion of current amplitude and phase angle comparison

articleTitle: Bi-level Model for Demand Side Management in Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The integrated energy system (IES) has realized the comprehensive utilization of energy, and the interaction between the supply side and the demand side is more complex. Therefore, a bi-level model for demand side management in IES, considering the income of energy suppliers, the comfort level and the cost of users, is constructed in this paper. In the upper level, energy suppliers optimize the subsidy price to improve their income. In the lower level, the users will adjust their consumption plans based on the subsidy electricity price from the energy suppliers. A solution method based on genetic algorithm and big-M method is used to solve the proposed bi-level model. And the model and solution method are verified in a 24-hour simulation. Through the simulation, the optimal subsidy price and users' energy-use plan can be obtained.

articleTitle: Power Grid Stability Identification Based on eXtreme Gradient Boosting
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of economy, the power grid structure becomes more and more complex, and many new business scenarios and new requirements has emerged. The power system stability analysis method based on physical model was unable to accurately model the uncertain factors in the power system, which make difficulty to analysis the system. In this paper, a method of grid stability identification based on XGboost method has been proposed, and the state of power grid was determined from the grid multidimensional operation data. Firstly, the decision tree method was introduced. Secondly, introduced the principle and characteristics of classification and regression tree, and then introduced the XGboost principle and characteristics. Finally, the IEEE39 node system has been used to verified the correctness of the XGboost.

articleTitle: Research on Application of New Intelligent Distributed Feeder Automation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper considers that the intelligent distributed feeder automation (IDFA) can effectively improve the reliability of distribution network. Slow distributed feeder automation (SDFA) is one mode of IDFA. The definition, implementation scheme and key technologies of SDFA are proposed. The distribution network is built based on Real Time Digital Simulator (RTDS). The SDFA is verified and analyzed through simulation experiments. It is shown that the SDFA has the characteristics of flexible configuration, fast fault isolation and restoration of power supply, and can effectively improve the reliability of power supply in distribution network by the action case of SDFA deployed in Pudong Core District of Shanghai.

articleTitle: Study on Optical-electrical Signal Characteristics of Partial Discharge of Gas-insulated Electric Equipment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: On-line monitoring of partial discharge (PD) of gas-insulated electrical equipment has great engineering value. PD detection method that is not subject to any electromagnetic interference has not been found yet. This paper proposes a PD detection method for gas-insulated electrical equipment based on the comparison of UHF method and optical method, which improves the reliability of PD detection. Based on the ability of fluorescent fiber to capture the PD optical signal, the PD detection platform for gas-insulated electrical equipment was built. The four-dimensional typical defect was compared and analyzed. The results show that the UHF signal under different defects has different amplitude, rise time and duration, and the single PD waveform signal obtained by optical method can only reflect the development of PD by amplitude; The UHF signal and optical signal show their respective characteristics in terms of amplitude and phase. Combined with UHF method and optical method, the accuracy of internal defect recognition of GIS can be increased.

articleTitle: Improved Droop Control Strategy Based on Energy Storage Inverter in Microgrid System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In microgrid system, the droop control is often adopted in the energy storage device. Since the main control unit in microgrid mostly adopts droop control, energy storage system usually distributes load power evenly with it when it is operating. In this way, the essential function of "peak load shaving" of the energy storage system will be weakened, and the amplitude and frequency of output voltage will be in an "uncontrollable" state. In order to solve the mentioned problem, an improved droop control method for energy storage system is proposed in this paper. Adjusting the output power of energy storage system according to the change of voltage and frequency of AC bus. Finally, the "peak load shaving" of active power and the "on-demand supply" of reactive power in energy storage system are realized. Simulation results are provided to validate the proposed method.

articleTitle: GZ HVDC DC filter C1 unbalance protection analysis and its improvement
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Started from wiring form of High-voltage capacitors and the internal structure of the capacitor. Analyzed three principles of DC filters C1 unbalance protection. For the case HVDC project repeatedly malfunction in DC filter C1 unbalance protection, accorded fault recorder, put forward corresponding measures for improvement. RTDS simulation system was used to carry out fault recorder playback and fault simulation. The results show that the improved protection logic can effectively avoid malfunctions by the interference of measuring.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Operation Effect for Grid-side Energy Storage Power Station Based on TOPSIS Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to evaluate the operation effect of grid-side energy storage power station scientifically and reasonably, an evaluation method based on TOPSIS model is proposed. Firstly, a relatively perfect evaluation index system is established, including charge-discharge effect, energy efficiency and reliability. Secondly, analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and entropy weight are used to calculate the subjective weight and objective weight of indicators respectively. Then TOPSIS model is set up to evaluate the actual operation effect of energy storage power station. At last, the actual operation data of an energy storage power station in Central China are analyzed. Rationality and effectiveness of the proposed index and evaluation method are verified by the results.

articleTitle: Determination of Dynamic Equivalent Boundary of AC-DC Power Systems Considering AC-DC Coupling
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Faced with the rapid development of UHV AC-DC transmission technology and networking technology, the power grid pattern has undergone great changes, making the impact of faults on the system global, so transient security assessment is need. To accurately simulate the dynamic characteristics of the AC-DC power systems after fault in the evaluation process while reducing the simulation scale and calculation amount, it is necessary to use a dynamic equivalent to represent the systems. The determination of the equivalent boundary usually has a great influence on the dynamic performance of original system. Therefore, this paper analyzes the coupling between AC and DC systems by simulating the dynamic characteristics of AC-DC power systems with different equivalent boundaries and evaluating the DC response after faults occurring at different locations of the AC system, which provides guidance on the determination of dynamic equivalent boundary.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of DC Distribution Network Considering Uncertainty of Source-Load
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In view of power generation and consumption of DC distribution network in the future, a comprehensive analysis means for reliability of DC system considering generation and load uncertainty, grid topology and equipment factors is proposed. For the DC distribution network grid-connected and islanded operation modes, the distribution system fault rate and repair rate of each load point of the DC distribution system under the grid-connected operation mode are calculated based on the network equivalent method. During the islanded operation, the adequacy transition rate parameter reflecting the uncertainty of power and load, the distributed generation mechanical operation parameter and the starting and switching parameter of islanded system were calculated. Finally, the two operating modes are integrated, and the Markov was used to calculate the reliability index of the network for the modified IEEE-RBTS BUS6 example. The accuracy and effectiveness of the method is proven and considered as a reference for research on reliability evaluation of DC distribution network .

articleTitle: Units Recombination Method Under New Energy Permeability Change
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In view of the problem that the operation mode of conventional units needs to be re-planned under the change of new energy permeability, the electrical distance factor is defined from the angle of the equivalent impedance and the flow section angle between the bus. The dynamic voltage reactive factor is defined by the different contribution of the dynamic reactive power of each unit to the voltage recovery of the new energy bus in the transient process after the disturbance. And an optimal combination method for conventional units under the change of new energy permeability is proposed based on these two factors. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed method is verified by taking a regional power grid as an example.

articleTitle: Cascaded quasi-Z source inverter based on switched-inductor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of inadequate boost capability and the large voltage stress across the capacitor of classic quasi-Z source inverter, this paper presented the cascaded quasi-Z source inverter based on switched-inductor by combining with the advantages of the switched-inductor cell. The inverter has improved boost capability compared to classic quasiZ source inverters, while reducing input current ripple and voltage stress across the capacitor. The topology and operating principle are analyzed and simulated with MATLAB/Simulink to verification the reliability and feasibility of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Application of ARIMA and Markov Combination Model in Medium and Long Term Electricity Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The quarterly electricity consumption curve shows certain regularity due to factors such as temperature and holidays. The ARMA(Autoregressive Moving Average) model has a good fitting ability for such time series, but the quarterly electricity consumption is also affected by economic growth. It is an ascending time series, which is a nonstationary time series. It cannot be directly predicted by ARMA model. Therefore, it is necessary to make finite difference processing to the original time series to stationary time series. The original time series is suitable for ARIMA(Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average) model. Any prediction model can not avoid the generation of residuals. The K-means clustering algorithm is used to divide the residual sequence state. By exploring the relationship between states at different moments, the transition matrix is established to predict the probability distribution of the residual state at the next moment. The predicted state is restored to the residual prediction value, and the prediction of the residual is completed to implement the correction of the original prediction value. That is, by predicting the residual by establishing a Markov model, the predicted value of the ARIMA model is corrected, and the prediction accuracy is improved.

articleTitle: Study on Propagation Characteristics of Partial Discharge Electromagnetic Wave in Gas Insulated Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The ultra-high frequency(UHF) method is the most commonly used method for on-site partial discharge(PD) detection in gas insulated switchgear(GIS). The primary premise of this method is to know the transmission of electromagnetic wave in GIS. According to the actual structure of 1100kV GIS, a cylindrical calculation model with a total length of 5m is established by using finite element simulation software. Considering the advantages and disadvantages of various discharge sources, the electric point dipole model is used as the internal discharge source of GIS. In the simulation, the Gauss pulse current with pulse width of 0.7ns and amplitude of 15mA is used as the excitation of the discharge source. The distribution and transmission of electromagnetic waves at different locations are studied, and the influence of the amplitude and pulse width of discharge source on electromagnetic wave signal is discussed. The results show that with the increase of time, the electric field norm of the detection point decreases slowly in the fluctuation, and the change of the electric field norm has a certain time lag; the smaller the pulse width of the excitation source, the higher the amplitude of the electric field norm; the larger the pulse width, the slower the attenuation of the electromagnetic wave.

articleTitle: Optimization Strategy for CHP with Heat Storage Participating in Deep Peak Regulation Market
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the northern heating season, combined heating and power (CHP) units are operated in the mode of "power determined by heat", which makes the power system lack of peak regulation ability, especially in valley load period. How to improve the peak regulation capability of the system is an important and urgent problem to be addressed. In this paper, under background of the reform of the power market and the rapid development of energy storage technology, an optimization model for CHP units with heat storage participating in deep peak regulation market is proposed. The conversion between electricity and heat is achieved by the CHP system and electric boilers, and the effective cooperation of thermal energy storage is considered. Guided by electricity price, optimal strategies for CHP units to participate in the spot market or deep peak regulation market are realized. Case study shows that by this scheme, the CHP plant with heat storage has more profit margins and greater competitiveness in the electricity market, so it has the incentive to actively participate in the deep peak regulation market.

articleTitle: Grading Evaluation of Typhoon Fault Impact in Electric Distribution Network Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A grading evaluation method for typhoon faults impact on distribution network lines is proposed in this paper based on data mining. Firstly, based on the online monitoring of big data resources in the distribution network, the typhoon fault impact evaluation index system is constructed. Then, the data mining method such as principal component analysis and singlelevel analysis is used to obtain the weight of evaluation index. Finally, the typhoon fault impact comprehensive score of each line is calculated and the evaluation level is divided. The data of typhoon fault line of distribution network in a certain province of China is selected to analyze the practicality and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. Using the rating result, we can accurately locate the weak link of distribution network line typhoon fault. It is of great significance to the precise operation and distribution network line upgrade of power supply company.

articleTitle: Energy Optimal Dispatch of AC/DC Hybrid Power Supply System with Time-shifting Load
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to friendly connect the new agricultural alternating current and direct current load ,effectively improve the photovoltaic accommodation ability, this paper establishes the greenhouse AC/DC hybrid power supply structure, and based on this, establishes a mathematical model with the goal of power supply cost. The model is solved by a genetic algorithm based on matrix real number hybrid coding, then economic comparison and optimization are carried out, finally an AC/DC hybrid power supply scheme including a variety of new agricultural loads that can be applied to greenhouses is formed. In order to verify the correctness of the model and the algorithm, this paper takes a greenhouse in the west as an example for analysis. It can be verified that this method not only effectively reduces energy waste but also promotes the development of agricultural power supply technology.

articleTitle: Optimization on Load Compensation of Generators Excitation Systems Considering Voltage Stability Margin
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To attain the optimal load compensations for excitation systems, this paper proposes an optimization model considering voltage stability margin constraints. The proposed model establishes a 1-norm objective function for minimizing the correction of the reference voltage. The relationship between reactive output power, voltage, and load compensation is analytically expressed based on the characteristic simulation that generator fails to maintain reference voltage under the limitation of reactive power capability. Since it is a typical non-linear programming model, the proposed model is solved successfully by the interior point method. Simulations on the WSCC 3-machine 9bus system, IEEE 10-machine 39-bus system, and two large systems show the proposed model with the careful consideration for the practical requirement of voltage stability and damping control have high computing efficiency and application prospect.

articleTitle: Research on Health Status Evaluation of Relay Protection Based on Combinatorial Weighting Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the occurrence of blackouts in the interconnected large-capacity power system, more and more attention has been paid to the health status of relay protection equipment. This paper proposes a combinatorial weighing model to assess the health status of relay protection equipment with reliability and maintenance efficiency. First, it proposes the evaluation index system covering the reliability and maintenance efficiency Then, the combinatorial weighting model based on the improved analytic hierarchy process and entropy are proposed. After that, the method to evaluation health status of the relay protection equipment and identify the weak links is proposed. Finally, the application to assess six types of relay protection equipment in one substation verifies the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis of Lightning Breakage in 10kV Distribution Network and Protection Characteristics of Arrester
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to find out the mechanism of lightning breaking of 10 kV transmission line and improve the reliability of distribution network system, this paper firstly analyses the mechanism of lightning breaking and the influence of arc current on the process of lightning breaking. Secondly, the simulation model of induction lightning strike distribution network is built in ATP/EMTP simulation software, and tower overvoltage under different lightning currents is analyzed. Finally, based on insulator flashover, the protection scope and performance of tower arrester are analyzed. The research work in this paper provides a reference basis for lightning break protection of 10 kV transmission lines and installation and layout of lightning arresters.

articleTitle: Vision of Next Generation Electricity Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Distribution network is a crucial part of an electric power system because of the proliferation of distributed renewable energies and electric vehicles, as well their great potentials in the near future. This paper presents the current situation and proposes the vision of the future distribution network in following four aspects: network, equipment, operation and market. It helps build consensus on the future distribution network and encourages collaborations among regulatory agencies, utilities, research organizations and manufacturers.

articleTitle: Research on Data Quality Detection Technology Based on Ubiquitous State Grid Internet of Things Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, the ubiquitous power Internet of Things platform has various problems, such as diversified technical components, difficult application, difficult data search, high data application threshold, and imperfect data management control mechanism. To support the ubiquitous power IoT data sharing and the value of grid data, this paper designs the overall framework and functional architecture of the data in the ubiquitous power IoT platform. And proposes the real-time data quality anomaly detection and improved algorithm based on isolated forest. Finally, the feasibility of the ubiquitous power IoT platform data quality detection algorithm is verified by two scenarios simulations of repair failure and power failure.

articleTitle: Comparison of the Application Effect of Existing Classification Algorithms by Measured Voltage Dip
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents the mechanism of five different algorithms for the type of unbalance dip, compared the results based on measured voltage dip by these algorithms.
