Apply three algorithms to calculate the type of unbalance dip for some typical cases. A conclusion is that there are large differences in results when applying the different algorithms to measured voltage dips. For two of the algorithms it is recommended against application or further development.

articleTitle: The Quantitative Relationships Between Mismatched Parameters and Dynamic Imbalanced Current During IGBT Turn-on
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The parameter mismatch has a great influence on dynamic current imbalanced for parallel IGBT. Now, high voltage IGBT physical models are difficult to obtain, so there is no quantitative relationship between mismatched parameters and dynamic imbalanced current. Therefore, the dynamic imbalanced current cannot be accurately evaluated. This paper analyzes the internal mechanism of dynamic current imbalanced, and puts forward that parameter mismatch affects dynamic current imbalanced mainly by making MOS current different in terms of high voltage IGBT. Finally, the quantitative relationships are established between the mismatched parameters and dynamic imbalanced current during turn-on, and verified by IGBT physical model simulation.

articleTitle: Adaptive Temperature Estimation for Lithium-Ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to accurately estimate the temperature of lithium-ion batteries and solve the problem that the local temperature cannot reflect the overall average temperature, an adaptive temperature estimation method for lithium-ion batteries is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the experimental platform is built to obtain the open circuit voltage characteristic curve, the specific heat capacity and the entropy heat coefficient, which are necessary for modeling. Secondly, an adaptive temperature estimation method based on dual extended Kalman filtering and the principle of heat transfer theory is proposed under variable temperature environment. Lastly, the proposed method is verified by experiment under the Federal Urban Driving Schedule test. The results show that this method can estimate the temperature of the battery in real time during the operation of lithium-ion battery. The proposed algorithm can converge with different initial temperature, and the average error is only 0.2 °C. Therefore, the method proposed in this paper shows a strong robustness performance.

articleTitle: Research on Service Capability Evaluation System of Provincial Electric Power Trading Center Based on Fuzzy Recognition Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The goal of the new electricity reform in China is to set up a relatively independent power trading institutions, with the main responsibility is to provide standardized, reliable, efficient and high-quality power trading services in accordance with the laws and regulations. This paper selects some representative and sampled indexes and constructs a service capability evaluation index system for provincial power trading center. Then, the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is used to carry out expert scoring and weight calculation of the indexes, thus, the importance ranking of different indexes is obtained. In addition, Fuzzy Recognition Theory is used to establish the service capability evaluation model. Taking a provincial power transaction as an example, an empirical analysis is taken to evaluate the service capability, then, according to the evaluation results, some countermeasures to improve the service capability is given.

articleTitle: Study on Protection Technology with Ultra-high Proportion of Renewable Energy Generation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Since the electromagnetic transient process of the wind turbine is more complicated than the synchronous generators, with the large-scale wind power grid integration, the fault characteristics of the relay protection have undergone significant changes. At present, there is no consensus on the fault characteristics of wind power, and the study on the mechanism of fault characteristics is insufficient. The fault characteristics are mostly derived from the wind turbine fault simulation under the specific control strategy, or based on the single wind power system fault recording data. These fault characteristics lack generality and essential understanding of fault. In order to study the protection principle applicable to wind power grid-connected systems, it is particularly important to carry out study on the common fault characteristics of various wind turbines under different control strategies. The recent study on the adaptability of system relay protection for wind power grid-connected is limited to the analysis of the protection principle and the criterion to adapt the fault data generated by the specific model under different fault conditions. It is easy to fall into exhaustion and is very lacking in credibility. There is an urgent need to propose a method and standard that can theoretically judge the adaptation of existing protection principles and criteria. This paper provides an introduction about the study on protection of wind power generation grid integration on technologies aspects, and tries to explore potential the trend in protection method and standard with the integration of RE generation into power systems based on exit practices and experience.

articleTitle: A Voltage Control Strategy for Low-Voltage Distribution Network with High Proportion PVs Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As large-scale distributed PVs are integrated into distribution network, the distribution network penetration rate continues to increase. The imbalance between photovoltaic output and load leads to reverse flow in the line, which easily causes the voltage to exceed the limit. The active distribution network can effectively prevent the voltage from exceeding the limit by coordinating and controlling the local controllable resources. This paper proposes a data-driven centralized voltage control method for distribution networks, and this method does not need accurately modeling the distribution system. Only the historical operation data are used as the training data of the BP neural network to fit the functional relationship between the injection power and the voltage of nodes. Then the voltage sensitivity can be obtained through trained BP neural network for voltage control in distribution networks. Effectiveness of the proposed voltage control method is verified by a simulation.

articleTitle: Methods for Obtaining Excitation Curves and Remanence of Transformers by De-energizing and Energizing Test
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Excitation curves of ultra-high-voltage-transformers under conditions of deep saturation are difficult to obtain accurately. In addition, it is difficult to directly measure the remanence of the transformer cores after de-energizing. In this paper researches are made on the above problems. By theory analysis, changes of flux linkage are calculated during energizing and de-energizing processes of transformers. The flux linkage coupling, caused by electric connection of tertiary windings of single phase transformers, is proposed. Methods are proposed to obtain excitation curves and remanences by energizing and de-energizing tests. Results of simulations and experiments show that excitation curve of the transformers under conditions of deep saturation can be corrected by above method, and the remanence after de-energizing can be estimated accurately, thus a good practicability is found for the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Research on Real-time Calculation Model for Transient Temperature Rise of Direct Buried Single-core Cable
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A lumped parameter model (LPM) was proposed to achieve the real-time calculation of transient temperature rise for buried single-core cable. In order to develop a model without monitoring cable surface temperature, the balanced thermal resistance and inductance were used to simulate the transient temperature characteristics in the process of heat diffusion. In the case studied, the temperature rise under the same condition was obtained with the LPM, finite element method, and commercial software (CYMCAP), respectively. The calculation results show that, the LPM can agree well with the other two methods, which verifies the accuracy of the method proposed in this paper. Furthermore, the model was improved through consideration of the effects of cable heat and environment temperature, respectively, based on the superposition principle of heat conduction. The calculation model was then promoted to be used for analysis of transient temperature rise with time-varying boundary conditions.

articleTitle: Grey prediction theory-based rotor side control of DFIG
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The conventional vector control strategy based on PI controller is generally adopted in the rotor side converter of doubly fed induction generator (DFIG),which has problems such as excessive overshoot and long adjustment time. To solve these problems, this paper designed a grey prediction PI controller (GP-PI controller) for rotor-side control of DFIG by combining the grey prediction theory with the PI controller. The simulations are developed in MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: A investment scale determination method of distribution network based on big data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To allocate the investment into where it is urgent needed and achieve more benefits under same investment, an investment scale determination method based on big data is proposed in this paper. Firstly, considering the influences of the investment demands, the enhanced demands of power grid, and the investment benefits, an investment scale determination model is proposed and the investment benefits are detailed described. Moreover, considering the quality of the data in the information systems, an investment scale allocation procedure based on big data is introduced and outliers are recognized and preprocessed. Finally, an actual application and case study are shown and the proposed method is verified. The model is practical and useful for the power grid enterprises to achieve more benefits under same investment.

articleTitle: Study on the evolution of equivalent impedance parameters for lithium-ion batteries under combined AC-DC conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, lithium-ion batteries are often used as energy storage system in electric vehicles or power system connecting with power electronic equipment, so they will be in the excitation conditions with high frequency ripples. In this paper, the evolution rules of lithium-ion battery parameters under combined AC-DC conditions are studied. Firstly, at a fixed State of Charge (SOC) point, impedance characteristics of 8 capacity rate (C) points selected in 0~1C superimposed with the same AC excitation are studied. The charge transfer process controlled by kinetic is fitted by simplified Butler-Volmer (B-V) equation, and the goodness-of-fit is close to 1. Then 10 SOC points are selected in the whole SOC range to analyze the evolution rules of impedance parameters under superimposed conditions. At the same time, the ohmic impedance in time domain and frequency domain is compared and analyzed, and the composition of 1s internal resistance in time domain is explained theoretically, and verified by experimental results.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification of Photovoltaic Power Plant Based on Data Dimension Reduction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the penetration rate of renewable energy continues to increase, its impact on the safe and stable of large power grid is becoming increasingly significant. Electromagnetic transient simulation is a powerful tool for system operator to handle the dynamic characteristics of power system. However, for renewable energy power plant, the accuracy of their electromagnetic transient model parameters is more or less biased. Therefore, it is of great significance to perform parameter identification. A parameter identification of PV power plant based on data dimension reduction is proposed in this paper. In order to avoid the combined explosion problem caused by so many parameters, a key parameter identification method is designed using data dimension reduction and visualization. Then, indices to measure the differences between different waveforms. Further, a parameter optimization method for key parameters is proposed. Test results of a real PV power plant validate the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Circuit Impedance Measurement Method Based on District Area and Fault Pre-judgment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, the research work on the distribution network area mainly focuses on the research of its load prediction and line loss, and the research on the related aspects of the topology of the district area is still lacking. This paper mainly uses the simulation modeling software to estimate the impedance parameters of each branch under the known situation of the network structure of the district area. This paper adds small interference based on Gaussian distribution in the process of post-processing data to reach the actual measurement situation. Then the method is applied to fault location and elimination of distribution network, which has certain significance for the fault elimination of distribution network.

Author Keywords: estimate the impedance parameters of each branch

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Pole-to-ground DC Fault in Power Supply System of Twenty-four-pulse Diode Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Twenty-four-pulse diode rectifier (TFPDR) with high resistance grounding at neutral point has been widely used in various isolated power systems. Many diode conduction combinations, complex and short transient process make it hard to model the dynamic behavior of pole-to-ground (P-to-G) dc fault of TFPDR. To solve this problem, a large signal mathematical model of P-to-G dc fault in TFPDR is established, which is based on switching function law and harmonic balance principle. Through comparison between mathematical calculation and physical experiment, it is validated that the mathematical model is effective and can accurately reflect the transient behavior of P-to-G dc fault.

articleTitle: Study on Mechanism of a Novel Autotransformer for 18-pluse Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: From the aspect of the isolated transformer for 18-pulse rectifier, a new topology of the 18-pluse autotransformer-rectifier with the advantages of small equivalent capacity, low harmonics and outstanding symmetrical structure is proposed, which is superior to the existing American patents. The relationship between the input and output currents, the distortion of input current, the relationship between the voltage of each branches and the phase shift angle and the equivalent capacity of the autotransformer are derived by using the potential vector diagram and the balance principle of the magnet potential. The phase shift angle of the proposed novel 18-pulse autotransformer is 20° that is exactly the same with the isolated transformer, which verifies the potential vector of the two is coincident. The input current distortion rate of this autotransformer is 10.05%, which reduces the harmonics of the rectifier to the power grid. The equivalent capacity is only 17.76% of the output power, which greatly reduces the volume and weight of the system. Finally, a prototype is made, which validates the correctness of the theoretical deduction and simulation, and provides a theoretical guide for future design.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Propagation Characteristics of HV Cables Based on A Novel Inner Sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A novel Partial Discharge (PD) inner sensor, which is a metal electrode, developed by the research group of the authors, equipped on the outer semiconducting layer of the 110kV High Voltage (HV) Polyethylene (XLPE) cable, is proven with high sensitivity and anti-interference ability. However, the propagation characteristics and laws of PD signals in the 110kV HV XLPE cable equipped with the inner sensors are unknown. Therefore, the propagation characteristics of PD signals based on the inner sensor was presented in the paper. Firstly, a mathematical model of PD signal was proposed, and then a simulation model of the 110kV HV XLPE cables equipped with inner sensors was established by PSCAD software. Secondly, the PD propagation characteristics in the simulation model was analyzed. Finally, the PD propagation characteristics experiment based on the inner sensors was carried out. The results showed that the error percentage between the amplitude attenuate coefficient of the PD signal measured by experiment and that measured by simulation is 3.73%. The PD propagation characteristics based on the inner sensor presented in the paper will contribute to provide a reference for the layout scheme of inner sensors in 110kV HV XLPE cables.

articleTitle: Dynamic Compensation Strategy of Microgrid PCC Voltage Based on Residual Generator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the disturbance current under the sudden increase of the common load power, and proposes a voltage feedforward compensation controller that can be used for parallel connection of multiple inverters under droop control, which is proportional to the disturbance current of the load end. The disturbance is given as a disturbance input to each compensator, and the common load terminal transient voltage is compensated. The controller can better compensate for voltage fluctuations during load shedding and three-phase imbalance problems. In order to meet the demand of plug and play, a voltage phase angle pre-synchronization method is proposed to eliminate the circulating current. The compensation effect is verified by comparing the simulation with the traditional control strategy.

articleTitle: Internal Oil Flow of Transformer Based on Multiphysics Coupling Characteristic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The misoperation of gas protection in transformer out-of-zone faults will seriously affect the security and stability level of power system. In this paper, the oil flow characteristics in transformer under different operating conditions are analyzed by multi-physical field coupling simulation. The principle of common gas protection relays and their causes of misoperation are analyzed. A numerical simulation model of multi-physical field inside transformer is established. The inner core and winding of transformer are modeled and simulated by ANSYS Maxwell 3D and ANSYS Fluent software. The variation of multiphysical field in normal operation, out-of-zone fault and in-zone fault of transformer is obtained. The changes of magnetic field and electromagnetic stress, oil flow and outlet pressure of inner winding and core of transformer are analyzed. This study provides a new basis for formulating measures to improve the reliability of gas protection operation.

articleTitle: Improved GRA-based Evaluation for Autonomous Operation Capability of AC/DC Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this study, a new evaluation method using improved grey relational degree analysis (GRA) is proposed to evaluate the autonomous operation capacity of an AC/DC distribution system. The proposed scheme is implemented based on the entropy method and an improved GRA. This paper considers that: 1) analyzing the key factors affecting the autonomous operation capability of AC/DC power distribution system; 2) establishing a comprehensive evaluation index system from generation side, grid side, load side and storage side; and 3) using an improved GRA based on entropy method to achieve quantitative assessment. Simulation results are presented and compared to verify the effectiveness of the evaluation method.

articleTitle: Type Identification of Short Circuit Faults Based on Alexnet
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Correct identification of fault types after grid short-circuit faults is the basis for fault handling, and it is also the basis and difficulty of grid fault analysis. In view of the traditional method, it is difficult to quickly and correctly guide the action of the circuit breaker relying on the electrical quantity judgment ,so based on the deep learning, a method of using Alexnet to judge the fault type is proposed. Firstly, this paper transforms the fault time series data into Hankel twodimensional matrix, next, the three-phase Hankel matrix is superimposed into jpg type image data, after that, converts the simulated voltage data into image pixel data between 0-255 through linear transformation. Then divides the graphic data into test set and verification set and puts them into the Alexnet network where the fault recognition model is trained. Finally, the proposed algorithm is verified to have higher accuracy through batch simulation data and it provides a new solution for fault type discrimination.

articleTitle: A Protection Scheme for Improved Transformer Bushing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The paper suggests a new bushing scheme which is suitable for bushing monitoring. Compared to the traditional bushings, the new scheme has a measurement tap on it. Then a capacitor and a small current transformer are introduced in series connecting with the measurement tap of the bushing. Then the voltage across the capacitor and the current through the measurement tap are supervised and their change rate are monitored. In this way, any great change of the bushing capacitance can be found immediately, and the protective relay sends the alarm or trip signal to isolate the transformer, so that the bushing security is enhanced.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on Short-circuit Capability of Transformer in Power System Series Compensation Test
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Series compensation can shorten the electrical distance of the line and improve the power transmission capacity of the sending power grid. At the same time, due to the strengthening of the grid structure, the system's equivalent reactance is reduced, and the short-circuit current is increased, posing a threat to the operation of electrical equipment. The short-circuit resistance of power transformers is one of the important indicators to measure the safety performance of transformers. In this paper, setting a short-circuit fault at the first and the end of the series-compensated line, the short-circuit current passing through the main transformer is calculated, and the ability of the transformer to withstand short-circuit is checked by comparing with the design capability value. Analyze the influence of different operation modes on the main transformer crossing current, and propose the operation scheme of reducing the short-circuit current with the sending power grid of series compensation, pointing out the method of adopting the series compensation to promote the sending risk and avoidance of sending capacity, which have a certain guiding significance for the series compensation planning and operation of the sending power grid.

articleTitle: Small-Signal Modeling of Off-Grid Integrated Energy System Considering Internal Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The development of the integrated energy system (IES) has become a hot spot in the energy field. According to the existing research, less research focus on off-grid mode modeling, but it play an important impact in operation and control of the system. In this paper, small signal modeling of off-grid IES considering external disturbances is studies. First, a small-signal state space model for four sub-modules including inverters, networks, phase-locked loop (PLL) and loads is established on its individual reference frame. On this basis, according to the coordinate transformation and intermediate equations, a complete small signal model is established on a common coordinate system by connecting all the sub-modules. Moreover, the internal disturbances of IES such as loads disturbances is added in the small-signal model by assuming the virtual resistor and disturbance load current. The modular small-signal model proposed in this paper can greatly simplify the small-signal modeling of IES, and this small-signal model can also provide theoretical basis for the state and stability evaluation of the system under internal disturbance.

articleTitle: Feasibility and Key Problems Analysis of Asia-Europe Intercontinental Power Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Under the background of energy shortage and air pollution, how to implement the optimal allocation of power in the world has been becoming a hot topic. In this paper, the feasibility and key problems of the Asia-Europe intercontinental power transmission system is analyzed in detail. First of all, the energy situation of the sending-end of Asia-Europe intercontinental transmission system is introduced based on the energy supplying and load demand. Then, the energy supply and demand of receiving-end is also studied based on the two different scenarios. The key technologies and possible transmission schemes are also proposed. Next, the comprehensive assessment system is built to evaluate the feasibility and practicability of Asia-Europe intercontinental transmission system. Finally, some useful suggestions are also proposed in order to promote the construction of Asia-Europe intercontinental transmission system.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Conduction Characteristics and Application of SiO2@SiC/Epoxy Nanocomposite
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Core-shell structure method is used to improve the nonlinear conduction characteristic of polymer composites. The typical nonlinear conduction particles (SiC) are coated with SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> by hydrolysis and also surface modified by silane coupling agent as a contrast. The SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>@SiC/epoxy nano-composites and the surface modified SiC/epoxy ones are prepared, respectively. SEM and DC conduction measurement are carried out. In addition, the electric field distributions in the prepared materials are obtained by simulation method. Experimental results show that the SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>@SiC/epoxy nano-composite have a stronger nonlinear conduction characteristic than pure epoxy and 3 wt% surface modified SiC/epoxy nano-composites. Simulation results suggest that the SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>@SiC/epoxy nano-composite is beneficial to lower the maximum electric field and is potential helpful to dissipate the accumulated charges.

articleTitle: Research on Parameter Estimation Method of Distribution Area with Known Topology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the country's investment in smart grid construction has increased, a series of distribution automation equipment has been gradually put into use. Among them, the widespread use of devices such as distribution Transformer supervisory Terminal Unit (TTU) and Distribution Automation Terminal (DTU) has made smart distribution network technology mature. The article is mainly based on the high-frequency, high-accuracy sampling data provided by the distribution terminal, and the topology structure of the distribution area is established. The mathematical modeling of the impedance parameters of the distribution network line is established, and the mathematical optimization method is used to find the answer when it meets the optimal solution with the smallest voltage error on the low-voltage side of the transformer. At the end of the article, the algorithm verification of the actual station area was carried out on the Pscad simulation software, and the correctness of the algorithm method was tested in the matlab and c language environments.

articleTitle: Multipriority Hierarchical Reactive Power and Voltage Optimization Strategy for a Large-scale New Energy Island System Delivered by VSC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: VSC-HVDC plays an important role in transmitting large-scale new energy power. The fast reactive power regulation of the converter station and the unique topology of new energy cluster require special reactive power and voltage control strategy. This paper has proposed a multipriority hierarchical reactive power and voltage optimization strategy for a large-scale new energy island system delivered by VSC-HVDC. This strategy takes objectives of the dynamic reactive power margin of converter station, voltage safety margin of PCC point, reactive power coordination factor of each new energy station and system power loss into consideration, and has been verified based on the planning of Zhangbei VSC-HVDC project. The strategy can keep the dynamic reactive power margin and voltage safety margin at high level with acceptable power loss, and improve resolving speed at the same time.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation Analysis of Integrated Community Energy System Considering Source-Load Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: An integrated community energy system (ICES) optimization operation method considering uncertainty of source and load is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the prediction error features of wind power, photovoltaic and load are analyzed. Then, the various aspects of ICES are modeled and analyzed. Based on this, a robust optimization model of ICES considering source-load prediction error is established. Finally, the chaotic particle swarm optimization (CPSO) algorithm is employed to solve the model, and the experimental optimization results under different prediction errors verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed model and method.

articleTitle: Inertial Coordinated Control Strategy of PMSG-Based Wind Energy Generation System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As wind energy is gradually infiltrated in modern power systems, the problem of reduced inertia of the power system has received widespread attention. The wind turbine (WT) is connected to the power net via a power electronic inverter, and rapid response capability of power electronics causes a reduction in the inertial response. Decoupling control between electromechanical systems also prevents wind turbines from responding to system frequencies in a timely manner. In response to this problem, this paper analyzes the different ways of inertial support for permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) wind energy generation system. Based on enumerating and comparing various approaches of providing inertial support to the system, selecting appropriate strategies to achieve the combination. This grants the WT to provide inertial support during operation. The rationality of the strategy is demonstrated by Matlab/Simulink simulation.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Short Circuit Analysis on Zero-sequence Current in Single-phase Grounding Faults
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, based on probability modeling, Monte Carlo simulation is adopted to conduct the probabilistic short circuit analysis on the single-phase grounding faults of distribution network. Firstly, a distribution network with four feeders and a photovoltaic (PV) generation is built in Matlab/ Simulink. Subsequently, the randomness of fault location, transition resistance, load and PV generation are modeled. Lastly, the specific impacts of these probabilistic uncertainties on the zero-sequence current of such fault line in the single-phase grounding condition are investigated and studied, as well as the corresponding conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of C-type Iron Core for HTS DC Induction Heater
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents an optimization method of C- type iron core for high temperature superconducting (HTS) direct-current (DC) induction heater. In order to maximize the magnetic field in the heating area without changing the coil size and the ampere-turns, it is necessary to optimize the structure of the core. The effect of aspect ratio and magnetic path length of the core on the magnetic field in the heating area have been evaluated. The effect of the chamfer and fillet of the core on the magnetic field in the heating area, which is based on the determination of the length and aspect ratio of the core, has also been developed. And the effect of chamfering and filleting on heating aluminum is carried out by the numerical analysis using commercial finite- element software.

articleTitle: Influence of PM2.5 Concentration on Photovoltaic Power Generation Based on Grey Correlation Degree Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper obtains the quasi-optimal factors and quasi-optimal characteristics of photovoltaic power generation system based on the grey correlation degree model of the interactions between system characteristics and system factors. The system characteristics include solar radiation, photovoltaic module temperature and photovoltaic system power generation; the system factors are PM2.5 concentration and ambient temperature. Based on the annual measured data from the 5.3kW photovoltaic power generation system of Beijing University of Civil Engineering and Architecture, the grey correlation degree was obtained with 42 environmental conditions under 6 PM2.5 level and 7 temperature levels. It is found that PM2.5 mainly affects the module temperature in low temperature, while in high temperature it mainly affects the radiation amount, thereby reducing the power generation of photovoltaic modules.

articleTitle: A Hierarchical Adaptive Protection Scheme for Short Lines in Low and Medium Voltage Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper aims to use the excellent ability of information interaction in active distribution network. The protection system of active distribution network is mainly divided into three layers: the terminal layer, the regional layer and the main station layer. The connection between different hierarchies of the system and the inner connection are realized through the layered, distributed and open network system. Finally, the hierarchical adaptive protection scheme for short lines is presented by using the method of the horizontal coordination in one layer and the vertical coordination between different layers. The two sets of adaptive protection schemes for horizontal and vertical coordination implement autonomous working and do not affect each other. In this way ,they give full play to their respective advantages in different power distribution scenarios, effectively solve the problem that the protection of active distribution network cannot be reliable tripping due to the close short circuit level and the variable operation mode.

articleTitle: Stress Testing of Delaying Investment on Power Infrastructure in Context of Mixed Ownership Reform
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, the China government proposes many policies on the reform of mixed ownership, which provides guidance for the mixed ownership reform of power grid enterprises. Reform of mixed ownership is an irresistible trend. Based on this, it is important to study the risks faced by power grid enterprises in the process of mixed ownership reform. The traditional risk assessment methods cannot effectively estimate the possibility of extreme events. Stress testing shows the excellent performance on extremely environmental risk measures such as financial crisis, which plays an indispensable role in modern bank risk assessment. It also becomes an important supplement to traditional tools such as VaR. This paper adopts the method of financial stress testing, and focuses on potential economic and security risks faced by China's power grid enterprises in the process of mixed ownership reform. Taking risk analysis of delaying investment of power infrastructure as an example, we first carry out the qualitative analysis and then conduct the stress testing including the sensitivity analysis. We screen out key risk indicators through sensitivity stress testing. On this basis, we investigate the comprehensive influence of key pressure factors on pressure variables and the specific affects in extreme cases through scenario analysis. The results show that the stress testing method can directly reflect the degree of risk exposure in the future power market. It also can be an effective tool for risk assessment for power grid enterprises during the mixed ownership reform.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Dry-type Tridimensional Wound-core Transformer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the dry-type tridimensional wound-core transformer. The characteristics and development of the transformer are introduced. An application of dry-type tridimensional opened wound-core transformer demonstrates that it has the advantages of both tridimensional wound core technique and epoxy resin casting. On the basis of all consideration of no-load loss, energy efficient, product size, reliability and flexibility of manufacturing process, it has the value of popularization and application.

articleTitle: Research on Wide-Area Backup Automatic Switch System for Smart Substation Based on RTDS
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the last few years, the development of smart substation technology in china has changed rapidly. The conventional microcomputer type of backup automatic switch will lose its original logic when the operation mode of the power grid changes. Wide-area backup automatic switch system can greatly reduce the operational risk of smart substation through automatic input of emergency generator. Aiming at the special power grid structure in Shenyang, this essay proposes wide-area backup automatic switch system for Smart Substation in this area. This system uses the optical-fiber channel for communication transmission based on IEC61850 standard. This essay explains the system framework and control principle of wide-area backup automatic switch system, and Selective analysis action logic of it. In finally, we use Real Time Digital Simulator (RTDS) simulate and analyze wide-area backup automatic switch system in this area; the simulation results verify its feasibility.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of DC Distribution Network with Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, many distributed generators (DGs) and DC loads have been continuously connected to power grid. The DC distribution network (DCDN) has become the trend of power grid development in the future because of its strong controllability, high reliability, and the ability to coordinate the access of DGs and multiple loads. In this paper, typical DGs are modeled and the typical net structure and working strategy are introduced. Based on the PSCAD platform, a radial DC net model with typical DGs is built. The operating states of various devices are analyzed by example analysis.

articleTitle: A New Interleaved Pulsed Power Converter Topology with Improvement of Response Speed
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a new interleaved pulsed power converter (P-IPPC) topology with improvement of current response speed for high-power semiconductor laser. The proposed P-IPPC topology consists of an interleaved converter, auxiliary circuit and pulse forming circuit, improving the current response speed and reducing output current ripple. The basic concept of this technology is to store energy in inductor by precharge method and releasing energy instantly to obtain a fast current rising edge response. Meanwhile, an auxiliary circuit is added to solve the problem of difficult digital pre-charge control of fast current response. As the driving load is stopped, the inductance energy is fed back to the power supply to realize the fast cutting off of the load current. MATLAB/Simulink simulation software is used to verify the proposed topology and pre-charge method. The simulation results show that the proposed topology and pre-charging method are effective. Compared with the conventional buck interleaved pulsed power converter topology, the current response speed is improved, and the problem of inductor limited current response speed is solved as well.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on the Characteristics of SiC MOSFET Module at 180 °C
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: SiC MOSFET is theoretically suitable for high- temperature applications due to its wide band gap and high thermal conductivity. In response to the lack of relevant experimental research on high-temperature characteristics of high-power SiC MOSFET module, this paper takes 1200V 300A SiC MOSFET module as the research object to evaluate the operation capability of the high-power SiC MOSFET module at 180 °C. Firstly, static and dynamic characteristics of the module are measured at high temperature, and superior high- temperature characteristics have been proved from two aspects of transient electrical characteristics and loss. Then, the thermal equivalent high-temperature power operation test is completed by using the heat-sensitive electrical parameter method. The test value of junction temperature is 186 °C, and the operating current is 280 A. The test verifies that the module can achieve high-temperature operation through reasonable thermal design. The experimental results show that the 1200V 300A SiC MOSFET module has the ability to operate at junction temperature of 180 °C and a good application prospect of high temperature.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Polarity Verification of Sampling Value System in Intelligent Substation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Intelligent substation sampling value system is the core part of intelligent substation relay protection, whether the polarity is correct or not will affect the correct action of relay protection, and it is an important item for intelligent substation debugging. This paper proposes the interface requirement of the sampling value system verification tool and the automatic identification algorithm of the DC method transformer polarity verification based on the half-cycle integration algorithm. Then, a polarity checking equipment is developed and used in several intelligent substation including traditional electromagnetic transformers, electronic transformers, field tests show that it is feasible.

articleTitle: Resistor analysis and simulation of HVR in the snubber circuit of Large-scale Superconductor Test Facility
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Quench protection(QP) system is responsible for protecting the superconducting magnetic coil in case of quench occurrence. During the QP operating process, overvoltage may be produced under the stray inductance in the system according to the rapid change current. Snubber circuit(SC) in the QP system provides the protection function for the overvoltage restraint in Large-scale Superconductor Test Facility(LSTF) with the power parameter analysis. With the high rated power parameters of 90 kA and 10 kV in the LSTF, the SC is developed and the resistor made of High Voltage Resistor material is put forward due to its remarkable advantages. The simulation processes concerning about heat, deformation and electromagnetic analysis are carried out with FEA tool. By the simulation results, it can be proved that the design of the SC resistor is feasible and effective in the QP system.

articleTitle: Characteristic and Control Strategy Study of Electromagnetic Coupling Mechanism among EV Wireless Charging system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to maximize the transmission efficiency of wireless electric vehicle (EV) charging system, transmitter coil and receiver coil are generally assumed to be coaxial perfectly aligned. However, offsets often exist between transmitter coil and receiver coil both in design and in implementation, which would lead to the drop of system efficiency. Based on the mutual inductance circuit model, this paper analyzes the reasons of the system efficiency decrease, and verifies it by using the finite element simulation software. To solve this problem, a frequency adaptive tracking system including power detection circuit, the wireless signal transmitting and receiving modules etc is designed. Finally, the correctness of theoretical analysis is verified by the experiment of static wireless electric vehicle charging. The results indicate that the frequency adaptive tracking system is effective, which in turn promotes the theoretical studies of wireless charging electric vehicle.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation Scheme of Energy Storage Capacity of Charging Pile Based on Power-Boosting
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the gradual popularization of electric vehicles, users have a higher demand for fast charging. Taking Tongzhou District of Beijing and several cities in Jiangsu Province as examples, the charging demand of electric vehicles is studied. Based on this, combining energy storage technology with charging piles, the method of increasing the power scale of charging piles is studied to reduce the waiting time for users to charge. Based on the consideration of safety and cost of distribution network, an optimization scheme of capacity allocation for energy storage devices to access the distribution network is designed. Finally, taking a city's distribution network as an example, a Simulink model is established to simulate the impact of large-scale electric vehicles to the distribution network, and the operation of the distribution network is analyzed after the optimal allocation scheme of energy storage capacity is adopted.

articleTitle: AC Loss Calculation of Tri-Axial HTS Cables
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, high temperature superconducting (HTS) cables have been extensively studied. Tri-axial cables have advantages of compact structure, high current carrying density and low loss, which can save energy in power transmission and become an important research direction. As the three phases of tri-axial cable are in one cryostat, it subjects to a more complex electromagnetic environment. When transmitting alternating current (AC) or/and exposing to alternating magnetic field, tri-axial cable’s AC loss becomes a critical aspect on its stable transmission performance. In this paper, a tri-axial type HTS cable with YBCO superconductor tapes modeled and analyzed by finite element method. To simulate the highly nonlinear superconductor tape numerically, H-formulation is adopted. Time-varying AC loss of tri-axial HTS cable is obtained. By comparing AC loss of each phase, the influence of the external magnetic field on AC loss is given.

articleTitle: Detection and Research of 500kV Submarine Cable Routing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the first 500kV submarine cable project in China, the Southern Power Grid and Hainan networking project plays an important role in the development history of China's power industry. The 500kV submarine cable of Fuxujia line passes through Qiongzhou strait from north to south, with complex seabed topography and dense distribution of sand waves. Under the condition of strong hydrodynamics, the stability of the bottom of Qiongzhou strait is poor and scour phenomenon is easy to occur. In order to ensure the long-term safe operation of the cable, the landform and topography of submarine cable route should be inspected regularly. Based on the changes of topography of submarine cable routing, this paper analyzed the sediment movement in this area, and studied the stability of submarine cable routing area and the movement trend of sand slope, and provided scientific basis for the protection of submarine cable.

articleTitle: Modeling Transaction Behavior of Multiple Stakeholders Based on Interactive Cooperation in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the continuous reform of electricity market and multi-energy complementary utilization, the participants in the market are not only a single component unit related to electricity, but also the heating, gas and other forms of energy in a typical integrated energy system. The coupling characteristics of integrated energy make the trading behavior for multi-stakeholders of the market more complicated and diversified. Based on this, this paper puts forward the concept of multi-stakeholder hub system, which is composed of coupling connection between hubs. Taking the coordination and complementarity of electricity, heat and gas as an example, three different stakeholders are constructed. The multi-dimensional characteristics of three stakeholders are modeled and analyzed by quantifying the energy flowing through the power tie-line and natural gas pipeline between the system and the main network, including the output characteristics of each equipment in the hub at different time periods. Meanwhile, considering the demand response characteristics of multi-period loads, aiming at minimizing the total cost of gas-electricity purchasing and guiding reasonable distribution of electricity, heat and gas. Finally, 3 typical parks within multi-stakeholder hub system are taken as an example to demonstrate the superiority of transaction behavior of multiple stakeholders based on the interactive cooperation in the distribution network.

articleTitle: Metallic return line longitudinal differential protection research into Xing-An HVDC Project
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When metallic return line occurs transient fault, DC protection system will not request fault restart in existing protection logic in Xing-An HVDC Project, which reduces the reliability of DC system. This paper proposes a metallic return line longitudinal differential protection (87MLL) at SIMADYN D platform. This protection acts as the main protection for metallic return line earth fault. This paper uses EMTDC model to simulate earth fault at different power, different fault location, different resistance monopolar metallic return operation. The result shows that protection has misstrip disk when fault resistance is large, the arc can't extinguish during DC system restart when DC power is high. By comprehensively considering protection logic design scheme and EMTDC simulation result, we don't suggest to add 87MLL in Xing-An HVDC Project.

Author Keywords: metallic return line longitudinal differential protection

articleTitle: Equivalent Inertia Evaluation of Wind Farm Based on Stabilization Diagram
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of the large-scale power electronic equipment access in modern power system, the inertia is continuously reduced. Based on the stability graph theory, the inertia evaluation method for power electronic system is proposed and designed. The method derives the relationship between inertia and active power from the second-order rocking equation model of the power system. Then, based on the output equivalence principle, the equivalent model of the new energy generation system is established by the synchronous machine rocking model. Further, the combination is stable. The graph method identifies the equivalent inertia of the wind farm and the fan based on the active power of the grid connection point. The simulation and measured tests show that the inertia estimated by this method can effectively adapt to the evaluation of the equivalent inertia of the wind farm, thus significantly improving the level of inertia assessment of the power system.

articleTitle: A General Method for Assessing the Operation Health of Power Transformer Group
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the absence of equipment operation parameters or inaccurate input of basic information, it is impossible to accurately grasp the operation status of transformers, resulting in the current situation of group transformers after fault repair became serious rapidly. This paper proposes a general method of grading management, which is easy for operators to accurately diagnose the operation status of the transformers. By supplementing the basic data such as bad operating conditions and family defects of transformers, screened out the transformers that have experienced more than 70% short-circuit current impulse, and the changing trend of historical test data of both capacitance and reactance is selected as the preferred condition for judging the winding deformation position, and constructed the capacitance-reactance models to equivalent the deformation amount. Through the analysis of historical data of group transformers, the latent danger of non-blackout equipment can be found in advance, and the passive situation of transformer maintenance after long-term faults can be changed.

articleTitle: Study of Hydrophobicity Migration of HTV and LSR materials
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High temperature vulcanizing silicone rubber(HTV) and liquid silicone rubber(LSR) are widely used for external insulation of electrical equipments in HVDC converter station. The performance and service life of HTV and LSR materials show some differences, owing to the difference of their components, vulcanization mechanism, molding process, etc. In this paper, one of the key performances of HTV and LSR materials—migration of hydrophobicity was investigated. Besides the comparison of frequently-used HTV and LSR materials, the study found that the best hydrophobicity migration appeared at 60%RH for most samples, which is contradict with the traditional understanding that higher humidity leads to slower migration. In order to analyze the difference of HTV and LSR materials’ hydrophobcity migration in detail, this paper used several microscopic methods, including Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), Gel permeation chromatography (GPC) and liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS). Through these microscopic research, it was found that the distribution of pollution is the decisive factor, but not the amount of LMW siloxanes.

articleTitle: Study on Natural Contamination Depositing Characteristics of Insulator of EHV Transmission Line in High Altitude Salt Lake Area
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to study the natural contamination deposited characteristics of insulators in salt lakes of Qinghai, China, sampling of insulator contamination was carried out on 750kV Chai-Yu I, II line and 330kV Ge-Yan line in Chaerhan Salt Lake area. The characteristic values such as equivalent salt density (ESDD), gray density (NSDD), gray salt ratio, coefficient on uneven distribution of upper and lower surfaces (K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">E</inf>,K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">N</inf>) were obtained from the test point, and the difference of pollution accumulation where inside and outside the salt lake area was compared. Furthermore, the chemical composition of the salt lake and saline-alkali land was measured, and analyzed the composition and content of soluble salt and insoluble substances in pollution layer on insulator Surface. The results show that the pollution level reaches above d and e both in salt lake and its vicinity, and the contamination on the surface of the insulator is rapidly accumulated in the salt lake environment. The ratio of gray to salt tends to be concentrated and less than 1, and the ratio on composite insulator is 2 to 3 times than porcelain. The degree of contamination on bottom surface of each shed is much larger than that of the top surface, and the average values of K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">E</inf> and K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">N</inf> are 2.33 and 1.42 respectively. The components of the pollution are mainly composed of CaSO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, NaCl and CaCl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, the insoluble matter are mainly CaO, SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, and the coefficient of effective ESDD in this area can be taken as 0.8.

articleTitle: Optimal Local Energy Trading considering Network Cost via Hotelling Game
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the high penetration of distributed renewable resources, local energy trading makes it possible to trade energy from local renewable sources, such as small-scale photovoltaics panels and wind turbines. In this paper, a novel Hotelling Game based local energy trading is proposed in this paper to determine the optimal strategies of the minimum total costs. Both network cost of transportation and energy cost of generation are considered in the trading decision-making. The network cost is determined based on the MW-Mile method to reflect the usage of the network in energy trading. The local trading is modelled as a Hotelling Game and the optimal trading strategies can be obtained for the customer to minimize their energy bill. The proposed energy trading method is demonstrated on a representative system to illustrate the significance of network cost in the local trading scenario.

articleTitle: Research of Day-ahead Scheduling Strategy in Smart Grid Considering Uncertainties of Demand
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The development of smart grid provides conditions for implementation of demand response (DR), while the uncertainties from response ability of power users bring difficulties for the formulation of day-ahead scheduling plan. For this purpose, this paper proposes a day-ahead scheduling strategy considering uncertainties from DR. Firstly this paper builds the uncertainty model of time-of-use and virtual power plant model of interruptible load. Then involve these models into day-ahead scheduling model and thus the day-ahead scheduling stochastic programming model is developed. To cope with stochastic variables in the model, a scenario generation and reduction technology based on Monte Carlo method is adopted and the original problem is changed into multiple deterministic programming models. Finally, the validity of proposed method is demonstrated by comparing with deterministic method.

articleTitle: Safety Analysis of Power-battery-equipped Traction System for Urban Rail Transit
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The paper notices that there is an absence of dedicated standards for the power-battery-equipped traction system for urban rail transit vehicles, those for reliability and safety performances in particular. Therefore, it reviews the composition and the working mode of such traction system, and builds the corresponding fault tree model where safety-related incidents are considered as top events. On this basis, the paper introduces the minimal cut set method to calculate and analyze the probabilities of the top events of the subtrees in the dedicated time continuous distribution model.

articleTitle: A Mixed Integer Linear Programming Method for Generating Backbone Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The intelligence algorithm used in the backbone grid search is unrobust and has uncertain results. To tackle the drawback, this paper proposes a Mixed Integer Linear Programming (MILP) model for generating the power system backbone grid. Based on the graph theory, this model considers the connectivity of the backbone grid as linear constraints with integer variables. Constrains of line power in the model are elicited by the derivation from Kirchhoff's current law. Since the expressions in this model are analytical and linear, with the help of developed MILP algorithm, the proposed model can fully solve the problem of absence of robustness in existing method. The simulations of IEEE 39-bus system and IEEE 118-bus system show that the proposed model is effective and reliable, which provides a new idea for the development in this research.

articleTitle: Comparative Review of Flexible Alternative Current Transmission System Devices in the Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The application of the flexible alternative current transmission system (FACTS) devices has been playing an important role in improving the flexibility, stability and intelligence of the smart gird. Until now, various kinds of FACTS devices are proposed, studied and utilized by the academic and the industry. Most literatures provide an in-depth study on one single kind of devices, without comparisons between different devices from the aspect of their technical performances as well as economic costs. In this paper, the current FACTS devices are investigated, from the aspect of the technical performance, the working principle as well as the industrial application. Moreover, the relationships are demonstrated and comparisons are made between different kinds of FACTS devices. This paper offers a comprehensive knowledge of the FACTS devices and introduces the new process of their application in the smart gird. It is also helpful for the researchers and engineers to choose suitable FACTS devices to satisfy the demand of the smart grid.

articleTitle: Study on the Power Grid Loss and Conducting Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to make the energy-saving of power grid more pertinent, this paper studied the refined calculation model of power grid losses and loss transmission mechanism. Based on the traditional loss calculation method, an accurate loss calculation method based on load curve was proposed, and the influence of new energy access on the loss calculation results was analyzed. Based on the characteristics of power grid, that is, the reduction of power loss in lower power grid can reduce transmission power and power loss in higher power grid, a transmission model of power loss was proposed. Taking transmission lines and transformers with different voltage levels as examples, the influence of load curve sampling period and new energy access on loss calculation results was studied, and the influence of loss transmission mechanism on power network planning and operation was discussed.

articleTitle: Radiation Range Evaluation of Grid Disturbance Sources Based on Voltage Vector Information
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The increasing complexity and randomness of grid operation environment make it of great practical significance to realize real-time assessment of grid static stability based on wide-area measurement information. This paper describes an online node spatiotemporal linkage assessment using trajectory clustering to realize radiation range assessment of grid disturbance sources. The motion characteristics of the measured voltage vector trajectory information are firstly mined, and a new definition of the trajectory distance is proposed to fully characterize the trajectory features. A parameter-adaptive trajectory clustering algorithm is proposed to observe the similarity of voltage motion trends of nodes in different grid situations, so as to achieve the assessment of the influence range of specific nodes. The simulation of the IEEE 39-node system verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A investment allocation method of distribution network based on big data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To improve the efficiencies and benefits of distribution network investments, a investment allocation method of distribution network based on big data is proposed in this paper. Firstly, considering the corporate responsibility, user perception and power grid development demands, the index systems for power grid development level and investment direction are established, and then the coupling relationship between these two index systems is calculated based on big data. Considering the differences in the current power grid development level, planning objectives and indexes of different regions, a correcting coefficient is proposed to modify the above model and the priorities of power grid investment directions are achieved eventually. The above model is further verified by the actual data of a region in Hebei province.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Signal Denoising Based on DualTree Complex Wavelet Transform Combined with Thresholding
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In high voltage engineering, it is of great importance to monitor partial discharge (PD) of critical apparatus. On-site PD signal is usually contaminated by white noise. Therefore, it is necessary to denoise the measured signal to acquire real PD. The most widely used method is the traditional wavelet thresholding. In this paper, a modified version for the traditional wavelet thresholding is proposed, i.e. dual-tree complex wavelet transform (DTCWT) is used to replace single wavelet to be combined with thresholding. Two DTCWT examples are used, i.e. dual tree wavelet pair constructed by common factor method, and dual tree wavelet pair constructed by Db family wavelets. To verify their performance, a numeric study is carried out, and the computation results show that DTCWT combined with thresholding is better than traditional wavelet thresholding.

articleTitle: A Novel Scheme for Isolated Modular Converter Based Lithium-ion Battery Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The isolated modular converter (IMC) based energy storage system (ESS) is a kind of bidirectional power system. This article introduces a new scheme for backup power supply applications, which consists of the hybrid cascaded topology of IMC and the distributed control strategy of Lithium- ion series battery packs. The IMC is used as the power exchange interface between DC-bus and battery packs, which is a two-stage power electronic circuit. The first stage is input-series-output- parallel connection (ISOP) circuit based on isolated bidirectional DC-DC sub-modules. The second stage is H-bridge. The function of H-bridge is to adjust the output voltage in positive and negative range. By cascading the ISOP sub-modules and H- bridge circuit, the IMC device is formed. The control method in this paper includes DC-bus connection control method and SOC equalization of Lithium-ion battery packs control method. Benefiting with hybrid cascaded topology and control strategy, ESS can provide stable voltage or current to DC-bus and realize SOC equalization of battery packs. This paper realizes the design of lkW isolated bidirectional DC-DC with 93% peak efficiency. The theoretical peak efficiency of a 12kW hybrid cascaded IMC based on 5 series lkW isolated DC-DC sub-modules is 97%. Due to the distributed control strategy, the energy of Lithium-ion battery packs is fully utilized and the total energy utilization of ESS will be greatly improved.

articleTitle: The Impact of Wind Power in Wind-Thermal Hybrid Centralized Transmission on Transient Angle Stability of Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: China has a unique exploitation of energy resources that is the centralized and large-scale combination of thermal power, wind power, and high-voltage AC-DC transmission, this has a certain impact on the transient angle stability of the power system. The effects of different proportions of wind and thermal power, the grid-connection location of wind power, the rapid recovery of active power of wind power during the fault clearance and reactive voltage control mode on the transient angle stability were studied. In the PSD-BPA power system simulation analysis software, the equivalent aggregated model of wind farm and the hybrid transmission model of wind and thermal power has been established. The actuation time of the transmission section splitting device and the first swing speed of the rotor angle in the thermal power units are adopted as measurement criteria. The simulation verifies the rationality of the proposed characteristics and research conclusions.

articleTitle: Intelligent Detection Technology and Engineering Application of High Voltage Circuit Breaker Based on One Key Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High voltage circuit breaker test is one of the most conventional electrical tests. Traditional test is restricted by wiring and detection mode, requiring manual wiring and repeated detections. It takes a long time with low accuracy and hidden safety dangers. Starting from optimizing wiring mode and innovating detection mode, this paper proposed an intelligent detection technology for high voltage circuit breaker based on one key detection. An intelligent detection device for high voltage circuit breaker is developed. Field application was also carried out. The average detection time of high voltage circuit breaker test is shortened from 65 to 7 minutes by using the technology and device proposed in this paper. The correct rate of one-time test increased from 88% to 99.8%.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Method of Start-up Mode for Improving Multi-Infeed Direct Current to Resist Risk of Commutation Failure
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The voltage stability problem of multi-infeed DC receiving AC grid is becoming more and more prominent. Based on the strength of the system's anti-disturbing ability under different start-up modes, this paper proposes an optimization method for the startup mode of multi-infeed DC to resist the risk of commutation, it can effectively reduce the risk of DC commutation failure after large disturbance and provide effective support for system voltage recovery and stability. Firstly, the influence of DC feed on the receiving power grid is analyzed, based on the dynamic reactive power support effect of the generator, the optimization method of the boot mode is proposed. This method is used to optimize the power start-up mode of the 2018 summer peak load mode of the multi-infeed DC feeding and receiving end power grid in a certain region, and the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Combined output offshore wind-tide-virtual energy storage system model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A virtual energy storage system (VESS) is proposed in this paper based on the virtual power plant (VPP) concept to integrate, regulate, coordinate, and optimize all manner of distributed energy storage facilities. A combined output model of the offshore wind-tide-VESS is designed fully exploit all available marine energy, stabilize power output, and minimize the power-free time of single energy generations. The effectiveness of the model is proven by simulation analysis and the influence of the offshore wind-tide-VESS on the distribution network structure is preliminarily investigated. The results presented here may demonstrate the advantages of the combined output model and improvements to energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Voltage Control of Rural Grid with High Proportion of Residential PV plants
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to large-scale residential photovoltaic (PV) plants connecting to the grid, the problem of voltage offset at the end of rural power grid is very serious. A novel priority control strategy is proposed in this paper in order to solve this problem. The strategy considers the voltage sensitivity and voltage offset of each node, as well as the state of charge (SOC) and capacity of each energy storage device to determine the action priority and action threshold voltage of each energy storage device. According to the action threshold voltage and voltage data collected locally, each energy storage device discharges or charges to solve the voltage offset problem. Finally, a simulation model is built in MATLAB and the simulation results fully prove the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Signal Denoising Based on Block Thresholding
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In high voltage engineering, it is of great importance to monitor partial discharge (PD) of critical apparatus. On-site PD signal is usually contaminated by white noise. Therefore, it is necessary to denoise the measured signal to acquire pure PD. The most widely used method is the traditional wavelet thresholding. In this paper, a modified version of the traditional wavelet thresholding is proposed, i.e. block thresholding is used to replace regular thresholding. Wavelet coefficients are divided into blocks which will be regarded as a whole part, then each block is thresholded. Several common thresholding functions are compared with block thresholding, and the computation results show that block thresholding is better than traditional wavelet thresholding.

articleTitle: Task Execution Ability Evaluation Method of Smart Meter Considering Time Series Influence
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Whether task execution results of the smart meter are successful is Boolean and task execution has time sequence. By regarding the data of task execution ability of the smart meter as time series and Boolean, a time-domain extended principal component analysis is proposed to evaluate the smart meter task execution ability in this paper. Firstly, the results of smart meter task execution are extended in the time domain to form the original phasor data matrix by converting Boolean quantity to amplitude and time-series information to phasor phase information. Then, principal component analysis is used to process the original phasor data matrix to determine the key indexes affecting the task execution ability of the smart meter and to establish an index system. Finally, analyzation of historical data of remote payment control of the smart meter in Jibei shows that the key indexes proposed in this paper are reasonable and accurate and the tasks of the smart meter can be guaranteed to be executed efficiently and reliably.

articleTitle: Research on Bi-level Optimal Operation of Microgrid in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In view of the current large-scale centralized wind power and photovoltaic power generation in different regions of China, there is a serious phenomenon of abandoning wind and photovoltaic power, in order to enhance the capacity to absorb wind/photovoltaic power, this paper establishes a bi-level optimal operation model with source-load interaction in the framework of AC/DC hybrid microgrid connected to the distribution network. In load level, demand response model based on time-of-use price is introduced to satisfy users satisfaction as a premise, which guides users to change their electricity consumption habits so as to make certain shift in load and improve the accommodation rate of wind/photovoltaic power; The source level uses the output of the wind turbine, photovoltaic array, micro turbine and fuel cell as the decision variables and the daily economic cost as the objective function to obtain the optimal output combination.
