Finally, Based on the power consumption data of industrial users in a certain area, this linear optimization model is simulated and solved by using MATLAB, and simulation results verifies the validity and rationality of the proposed optimization operation model.

Author Keywords: the accommodation rate of wind/photovoltaic power

articleTitle: Polarization Current and AC Impedance Characteristics of Electric Power Equipment Metal Materials with Different Corrosion Condition Under High Temperature and High Humidity Industrial Pollution Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Metal structure materials of power equipment will be seriously corroded in the polluted atmosphere. Impedance spectrum and polarization current are effective means to monitor metal corrosion status, early warning and take protective measures. The corrosion characteristics and mechanism of metal materials in power equipment in high temperature, high humidity, high Cl<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> and industrial pollution atmospheres were investigated by scanning electron microscopy and electrochemical measurement. Results indicate that with the increase of corrosion time, the surface morphology and products of Q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">235B</sub> low carbon steel are transformed from cracks in the pre-corrosion stage and flaky γ-FeOOH to the products of cotton-like α-FeOOH and constitute a dense rust layer gradually. The surface rust layer of galvanized steel also gradually changes to thicker and denser. The corrosion current I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">corr</sub> of carbon steel increases rapidly and then decreases slowly. The corrosion current I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">corr</sub> of galvanized steel rises slowly and then decreases rapidly. During the corrosion process, the corrosion current of carbon steel is larger than that of galvanized steel. The low-frequency capacitive reactance arc radius of carbon steel and galvanized steel and the charge-transfer resistance R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</sub> after fitting are first reduced, then increased; the charge transfer resistance R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</sub> of the galvanized steel after corrosion is greater than carbon steel. The rust layer of carbon steel will accelerate corrosion in the early stage, and the dense rust layer will resist corrosion in the later stage, but the effect is small. The rust layer of galvanized steel has better resistance to corrosion.

articleTitle: High Frequency Resonance Analysis of Distributed Storage Converter and Design of Output Filter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The application of distributed energy storage converter in modern distribution network has received sustained attention. The output filter, as the essential part in distributed energy storage converter, can effectively filter the switching ripple of the converter and improve the current quality. However, the output filter has many parameters, which are closely related to each other. Therefore, determine these parameters during designing is a difficult and vital step. Meanwhile, the study of this paper show that the filter and the current control process of the inverter are coupled to change the equivalent impedance of the inverter while the filter parameters have a decisive impact on the equivalent impedance in high frequency. When the parameters of the filter are unreasonable, zero impedance will appear in some high frequencies, which will result in the resonance of the inverters. When the number of parallel inverters increases, the damping of the system decreases due to the impedance parallel connection, and resonance phenomena become more obvious. Consequently, in this paper, the influence mechanism of output filter parameters on high frequency oscillation is obtained via establishing the mathematical model of converter under current closed-loop control. Combined with the requirements of filter performance, a design method for output filter parameters settings is summarized. Finally, experiments indicate the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of wind power output capacity in a regional power grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The rapid development of wind power has made its access capacity problem more eagerly concerned. It is urgent to analyze the curtailment factors and put forward corresponding measures for wind power consumption. In this paper, the wind resource characteristics, power load characteristics and peakload regulation capability are analyzed for specific power system zones. The reliability of regional power grid is analyzed for wind power acceptance based on effective load carrying capacity and different characteristics of power load and peak-load regulation. At the same time, the curtailment ratio and the inter-regional power regulation are taken as factors to analyze the wind power acceptance level. The research has a certain reference value for power grid planning and operation, especially regional power grids with different wind resources and power load characteristics and peak-load regulation capability.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Thermal Finite Element Modeling of MCR via Homogenization Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The magnetic valve controllable reactor (MCR) has been widely used in Ultra High Voltage/distribution networks for the reactive power compensation. The magnetic valves of MCR are stacked up by laminated sheets and work in the domain of deep saturation. This results in high power loss and abnormal high-temperatures in the iron cores, which can threaten safety operation of MCR. In this paper, an electromagnetic thermal FEM model of three-phase 35kV/10MVA MCR via homogenization method is presented. The magnetic field and temperature field distribution of a full-size MCR are presented in three-dimension (3-D) view. The simulation results show that homogenization of MCR's laminated iron core is necessary and effective.

articleTitle: Optimization of the Integrated Energy System with Energy Storage Considering Risk Operation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The integrated energy system (IES) can make use of the advantages of multi-energy complementarity to provide more flexibility and economy for the dispatch of operators. At present, the uncertain impact of renewable energy with high permeability has not been quantified as a risk index in the scheduling research of integrated energy system. Meanwhile, the time-coupling equipment such as energy storage has not been considered, and the time-scale differences of different forms of energy have not been distinguished. In this paper, based on the modeling of IES with energy storage and considering the influence of uncertainties, the optimal scheduling model of IES based on multi-scenarios is propoesed, furhermore, the time-scale differences between electric energy and thermal energy are distinguished, and the multi-period coupling constraints of energy storage are establisehed. Aiming at the large scale of the model, an algorithm based on Benders Decomposition is proposed to solve the problem. Finally, the influence of confidence level, energy storage power and capacity on the operation cost and risk of IES is analyzed by an example.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Pole Slipping Operation of Turbo-generator Based on Improved Damping Finite Element Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The pole slipping number of the generator is an important indicator related to the safe and stable operation of the power system. The electrical and mechanical systems of the turbine generator body interact with each other and restrict the pole slipping operation of the generator. In order to fully and accurately analyze the electromechanical characteristics of the pole slipping operation, firstly, a mechanical shaft-field-circuit-network coupled time-step finite element model of turbo-generator based on improved damping model was established, and the rationality of the damping parameters was verified by the rotor AC impedance principle. Then the characteristics of the pole slipping operation of the turbo-generator under the improved damping model and the traditional damping model were analyzed through the simulation, and the shaft fatigue life loss caused by the large disturbance was evaluated. Finally, the pole slipping number of the unit under the two damping models was calculated separately. The results show that the improved damping model is more in line with the damping effect of the actual turbine generator, which creates conditions for accurately analyzing the oscillation process after large disturbance and exactly estimating the transient stability and limit cut-off time of the system.

articleTitle: Optimised Wind Farm Active and Reactive Power Dispatch While Considering Fatigue Distribution
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the traditional optimization of wind farms (WFs) power dispatch, the strategies of active and reactive dispatches are decoupled. However, the electrical power losses inside a WF is related to both the active power dispatch and reactive power dispatch. This paper unites active and reactive power dispatches to make the output power of WF maximal. In addition, the uneven fatigue distribution of WF caused by wake effect and the improper active power dispatch will lead to high maintenance frequency, which means high maintenance costs. Therefore, this paper also takes the fatigue distribution of WF into account. The fatigue coefficient is selected to represent the fatigue suffered by wind turbines (WTs). And the standard deviation is take to evaluate fatigue distribution. Simulations are made in a WF consisting of 50 PMSG WTs. The PSO algorithm is implemented to solve problems. The active and reactive power of each WT are the control variables. The case study section shows the new strategy’s superiority.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Type Identification in GIS Based on SCG Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: During the insulation failure of Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS), partial discharge will occur in the power grid. This phenomenon not only affects the operation of GIS, but also affects the security of the power grid. In order to study and identify four kinds of discharge phenomena better, four kinds of partial discharge signals were collected in the GIS partial discharge laboratory, and 13 kinds of characteristic parameters were extracted. The Scaled Conjugate Gradient (SCG) propagation algorithm based on artificial neural network was applied for training. Continuously change the number of hidden neurons in the hidden layer until the appropriate number was selected to achieve the highest partial discharge accuracy in GIS. The training results show that the recognition accuracy was 96.5% when the number of hidden neurons in the hidden layer was 18, which provided a new idea for the future study of partial discharge pattern recognition in GIS.

articleTitle: Analytical Magnetic Field Analysis of Misalignment Tolerance Characteristic of Double D Pad and Bipolar Pad
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Wireless power transfer (WPT) is an emerging technology for electric vehicles. The unavoidable misalignment impact on the system performance is a critical issue which needs to be considered. Bipolar Pad (BPP) is a coil structure proposed recently to reduce the impact of misalignment. Although experimental results have shown the effectiveness of this structure, there is still a lack of general theoretical analysis. In this paper, an analytical magnetic field analysis method is used to show the advantage of BPP compared with the commonly used double D pads (DDP) when the primary pad and secondary pad are misaligned. Firstly, the expression of the output power when using BPP with double-sided LCC compensation topology is given. By using Biot-Savart Law, the flux distributions of both BPP and DDP are derived, and the magnetic flux is calculated by integrating the corresponding area of the coils. The results confirm that with properly controlling the phase angle of the two adjacent coils, BPP exhibits superior misalignment tolerance over DDP. Finally, a Finite Element Analysis (FEA) simulation is used to verify the accuracy of the proposed method, which shows that the error of the proposed method is less than 8%. However, it only needs several seconds to finish a calculation while FEA needs about twenty minutes.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of Energy Storage System via MPC considering High Density Photovoltaics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to suppress the fluctuation of high density photovoltaic (PV) system, enhance the acceptance capability of the distribution network for PV power generation, and improve the utilization of solar energy, a side energy storage system with high density PV power distribution network will be built to coordinate and optimize the control, which can obtain better economic benefits and system stability. Also, an optimal allocation method based on model predictive control (MPC) is proposed. The method is aimed at energy storage system in distribution network with high density photovoltaics (HDPV). Considering the uncertainty of PV power generation and load demand, energy storage systems can obtain the lowest cost in the whole life cycle. The validity and superiority of the optimal allocation model are verified by the analysis of typical daily dispatch optimization in different seasons and the comparison with energy-storage-free system.

articleTitle: Dynamic Compensation Control Strategy of DC Microgrid Bus Voltage Based on Disturbance Observer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To solve the problem of bus voltage dynamic response under the droop control method in DC microgrid, a parallel dynamic compensation structure of converter based on disturbance observer was proposed. Firstly, the problems existing under the traditional DC droop control are analyzed. The state space model is established for the parallel models of multiple converters in the DC microgrid. The current changes caused by the common load switching in the parallel state are analyzed. The synchronous measurement method (PMU) is applied to the disturbance current. The measurement distribution is carried out. According to the left and right mutual decomposition theory and the Youla parameterized stability controller theory, the parallel dynamic compensation structure of the converter based on the disturbance observer is obtained. The model matching algorithm is used to obtain the Youla parameterization matrix Q(s). The current loop compensation structure M(s) is designed to counteract the effect of the compensation signal on the current loop. Simulation results show that the structure can accelerate the dynamic response speed of DC bus voltage when the common load is switched. At the same time, the structure can suppress the double frequency disturbance of DC bus voltage caused by an unbalanced load and keep the bus voltage stable.

articleTitle: Load Modeling and Scheme Design of 48V DC Power Supply System for Civil Buildings
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of continuous access of distributed energy, data center and DC power load effectively, full DC power supply for civil buildings has become one of the research hotspots in recent years, which is still in the stage of demonstration project. According to the scenario of civil power supply, load modeling and quantitative analysis are firstly carried out in this paper. Then, according to the load characteristics of civil buildings, the architecture of DC power interconnection system based on DC-DC parallel connection and the corresponding control strategy are proposed. Interconnect interface can achieve active regulation of the interface voltage by using a bidirectional Buck circuit topology. Non-master-slave control strategy without communication based on adaptive droop was adopted between different interface circuits to solve the problem of uneven load. Theoretical analysis and experimental verification are carried out in this paper. The interconnected system established in this paper is applicable to the DC system of civil buildings and other similar scenarios.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on DC Breakdown Characteristics of Liquid Nitrogen under Rod-plane Electrodes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of high temperature superconducting (HTS) apparatus, the importance of electrical insulation characteristic of liquid nitrogen (LN2) grows significantly. In the last two decades, as the R&D focus is on AC applications, DC electrical insulating performance of LN2 is not fully explored. In this research, DC breakdown (BD) characteristics of LN2 are investigated for different electrodes gap distances and polarity under rod-plane electrodes pair condition. To provide valuable reference for the insulation design of high voltage DC (HVDC) HTS power apparatus using LN2 as the independent major insulation such as resistive HTS fault current limiter, the gap ranges from 5 mm to 180 mm, which corresponds to BD voltage higher than 300 kV. Experimental results revealed that the DC BD strength of LN2 differs with electrode polarity. The positive rod condition has a higher BD strength when the gap is shorter than roughly 100 mm while negative rod withstands a higher voltage when the gap is bigger than that. Furthermore, positive rod condition reveals obvious saturation effect whereas the negative rod condition does not. The insulation design of HVDC HTS power apparatus should consider both the polarity and saturation effect of LN2 and take the pessimistic condition as the design basis.

articleTitle: Coupling Path and Distribution Characteristics of Pulse Disturbance on High Speed EMU Body
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Pulse disturbance are created when the train raises its pantograph or pantograph arcing. It is coupled into the train body through the high-voltage cable in the electric multiple unit (EMU), which will cause the train body potential fluctuation and jeopardize the normal operation of the EMU. This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of the conduction path of this pulse disturbance. First, the coupling path between the pulse and the train body was studied by establishing the equivalent circuit and then calculating the distribution parameters. The induced voltage was obtained by simulation which was in good agreement with the actual measurement results. Then the distribution of current on the train body was analyzed, and the surface current distribution on the train body was calculated by the finite difference time domain method. Finally, the distribution of current at low frequency and high frequency was studied.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Grid-connected Simulation Based on RT-LAB and dSPACE
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the large-scale development and application of photovoltaic(PV), research on the impact of PV systems on the power grid has received much attention. By analyzing the principle of PV array and control strategy, a grid-connected PV system simulation model is built based on MATLAB. And the influence of the PV system on the power grid under different environmental scenarios is studied. Then, Hardware-in-the-loop simulation of the PV system based on RT-LAB and dSPACE is used to test the result of MATLAB. Finally, the dynamic characteristics of PV output power, voltage, and current at different temperatures and sunlight intensities are obtained. And the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed PV grid-connected control strategy are verified.

articleTitle: State Evaluation of Arc Contact of Circuit Breaker Based on Radiated Electromagnetic Wave Signal
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of the existing method for evaluating the state of the arc contact of the porcelain column circuit breaker, a method based on the electromagnetic wave signal generated during the charging and closing process of the porcelain column circuit breaker is proposed to evaluate the state of the arc contact. The basic principle and testing device of the method are introduced. The laboratory simulation research platform is built. The characteristics of the radiated electromagnetic wave signal during the opening of the circuit breaker under different ablation degrees are studied, and the substation 35kV porcelain is on site. The column circuit breaker performs detection and disintegration. The results show that the degree of ablation influences the radiated electromagnetic wave signal during the opening process. The number, peak value and duration of the radiated signal during the ablation process are larger than those of the slightly ablated contact. The use of the radiated electromagnetic wave signal in the process of circuit breaker opening can realize the electrification evaluation of the arc contact and predict the state of the arc contact in advance. This method has obvious advantages and has the value of promotion.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection of Technical Loss Based on Situation Awareness and Control Chart Technologies
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Technical losses are comprised of power dissipation in components of power system. This paper proposes a method to detect the abnormal technical loss based on situation awareness and control chart technologies. The situation awareness technology is used to perceive the future trend of the technical loss based on the predicted load data and power flow calculation. The control chart is employed to detect the abnormality of the technical loss based on the differences between the perceived technical loss and actual technical loss. Three abnormal technical loss scenarios are set and simulated to evaluate the proposed method. The results show that the proposed method effectively detects abnormal technical loss.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Large-Scaled Photovoltaic Grid-Connection on the Transient Stability and Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the continuous growth of grid connected photovoltaic capacity, the influence of photovoltaic (PV) on the transient stability and corresponding countermeasures has become an important research topic. In this paper, the active and reactive power characteristics of PV unit and its grid connected system during rapid voltage dropping and lifting are analyzed, and the influence of different control modes on these characteristics are analyzed firstly. On this basis, aiming to the sending system with conventional generator and photovoltaic, the influence of PV on transient stability is analyzed, and countermeasures are proposed. Simulation results got from Hetian area of Xinjiang Uygur autonomous region verified that the proposed countermeasures can improve the transient stability of sending system with conventional generator and photovoltaic effectively, and these countermeasures provide technical solution to enhance the acceptance capacity of photovoltaic power.

articleTitle: Orderly Clustering of Active Distribution Network Planning Scenarios Based on Change Point Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: An orderly clustering method for active distribution network planning scenarios with distributed generators (DG) based on time series modeling is investigated in this paper. Firstly, the medium and long term planning of active distribution network is simulated in time series, and the time series mathematical model of load growth is established according to different types. Then, the change point theory in statistics is introduced to establish the subscenarios of DG and load sequential partition, respectively. Finally, the above-mentioned time series scenarios are fused by the comprehensive change point theory, and the typical time series scenarios are extracted by segments. The simulation results show that, by searching for change points, nearly a million moderately and long-term sequential scenarios can be clustered into 14 continuous-time scenarios in an orderly manner, which greatly reduces the number of scenarios and improves the efficiency.

articleTitle: Correction of the Relationship between Opticalelectrical Signal and Charge Quantity in Partial Discharge Combined Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The internal insulation defects of gas insulated electrical equipment will cause partial discharge (PD). The accurate and effective PD detection has important significance for fault assessment. Using the fluorescent fiber as the PD sensor, the PD of the four typical defects was tested. The relationship between the UHF signal and the discharge amount at different pressures, the relationship between optical signal and the discharge amount at different size defects were corrected. The results show that under different pressures, the UHF signal energy and the discharge square can always maintain a good linear relationship. For different defects, the UHF signal energy-discharge amount increases with the gas pressure. Whether there are defects of different types or different sizes of the same type, there is a good linear relationship between the integral value of the optical signal and the discharge amount. For the free metal particle defect, it is difficult to summarize the law between the particle size and the discharge amount. When the pressure in the simulated cavity is 0.3 MPa, the correction value is compared with the measured value, the relative error of the free metal particles defect is 14.4%, and the relative error of other defects is less than 5%. Taking the smallest size defect in the experiment, the calculated value of the slope k is also compared with the measured value, and the relative error obtained is less than 10%.

articleTitle: Simulation Modeling and Line Loss Research Based on Typical Urban Distract Area
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, there are few simulation models in the research area of transformer district and the main research directions of Pscad-based simulation modeling are in the direction of microgrid and wind power photovoltaic. Since the line area will operate under different working conditions such as different distribution capacity, line parameters and number of users, the line loss will change accordingly. Therefore, it is necessary to build a multi-case simulation platform for line loss in the station area. Based on the massive historical data of typical stations, the design and development of multi-case experimental simulation system in the station area, and the establishment of a software simulation experiment platform, so that it is fully equipped with adjustable capabilities, can fully simulate the operating status of typical urban transformer district.

Author Keywords: simulation models in the research area of transformer district

articleTitle: Dynamic Compensation Control of AC Microgrid Based on Residual Generator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: 1 This paper presents a dynamic compensation control strategy based on a residual generator, which enhances the anti-interference ability of island AC microgrid to voltage jump, harmonic and three-phase unbalance. First, based on the d-q axis coordinate system, the input current of the inverter is decomposed into fundamental current and non-fundamental current when voltage jump, harmonic and three-phase unbalance occur. A state-space model of the inverter is established, in which the fundamental current is used as the input signal and the non-fundamental current as the disturbance signal. Second, according to the dynamic compensation control strategy based on a residual generator, the voltage dynamic compensation controller is designed using linear matrix inequality (LMI), and the current dynamic compensation controller is designed using linear superposition principle. Finally, the strategy is added to the double closed-loop control of the inverter to improve the power quality of island microgrid voltage, and its effectiveness is verified on the hardware-in-the-loop simulation system.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Equipment Status Monitoring and Analysis System Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper introduces the design concept and application function of the equipment status monitoring and analysis system based on big data. The difficulties and solutions in the remote data transmission and storage of big data are also highlighted in this paper. The concept of lightweight application and the concept of application market are put forward which has a good reference for the similar system construction of other units.

articleTitle: Coordinated Planning of PEV Fast charging Network with Station-owned Photovoltaic Generation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Renewable energy is widely used by commercial and industrial facilities. As the distributed renewable generations have no need fuel and require distribution network to transmit power, it is considered as a useful tool to protect the environment and postpone the power system upgrade investments. In this paper, joint planning of plug-in electric vehicle (PEV) fast charging stations network with station-owned photovoltaic generation (PVG) is proposed, where the transportation network and electric network are coupled. A bilevel model is adopted to depict the interactions of this mode, i.e. "Centralized planning, Decentralized scheduling". The utility determines the siting and sizing of the PEV stations as well as the capacity of each PVG, while the stations determine the PVGs daily operation plan. We adopted a mixed-integer second-order cone model to simulate the behaviour of the utility and formulated stations’ operation as a linear problem. A two-part tariff including electricity charge and demand charge is studied to match the realistic situation. Twelve typical scenarios are considered to address the uncertainty of loads and PVs. A numerical experiment is implemented to show the benefits of this coordinated planning method.

articleTitle: Optimal Capacity Configuration of Railway Power Conditioner Based on Probability Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Railway power conditioners are widely used to mitigate the adverse effects of traction loads on the utility grid, especially in terms of three-phase imbalance. In many studies, the optimization function is usually used to solve the objective function of the designed power conditioner optimal capacity to obtain the optimal capacity value, and then corrected by random simulation. Due to the strong randomness of the traction load, there is currently no easier way to solve the optimal capacity of the power conditioner. This paper firstly analyzes the application scenario and typical wiring mode of the power regulator, then proposes the capacity configuration strategy of the power regulator based on the probabilistic load model. According to the national standard limit of the voltage three-phase unbalance, the formulas for solving the optimal capacity in different wiring modes are given. Finally, Monte Carlo simulation verification and comparison of measured data show that the proposed method has high accuracy and effectiveness. These methods have a positive significance for the reasonable determination of the installation capacity of the railway power conditioner.

articleTitle: Fault Location of Hybrid Three-terminal HVDC Transmission Line Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The fault transient process of HVDC transmission line has stronger natural frequency signal. Therefore, this paper extracts the amplitude and frequency of natural frequency as sample attributes, and proposes a neural network based hybrid multi-terminal HVDC transmission line fault location algorithm. For the traditional-flexible hybrid three-terminal transmission line, the fault branches are different, and the components, amplitude and phase of the natural frequency are also different. Firstly, the branch line where the fault occurs is determined according to the magnitude of the dominant frequency in the natural frequency spectrum, and then the faulted ranging is performed by using the hierarchical distributed neural network. The particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the weight and threshold of BP neural network, and the network training efficiency is improved, and the convergence speed is accelerated. The simulation results of PSCAD and MATLAB show that the fault location algorithm has high reliability and accuracy.

articleTitle: An Improved Dynamic Equivalent Method for the DC Offshore Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to analysis the output dynamic characteristics of dc offshore wind farm, a multimachine representation dynamic equivalent method based on an improved fuzzy C-means (IFCM) clustering algorithm is proposed. First, characteristic variables which can characterize the dynamic characteristics of the input and state performance are researched. Second, an IFCM clustering algorithm is first put forward. Third, the dc offshore wind generators (DCOWGs) are divided into many groups by analyzing the characteristic variables data with the IFCM. Finally, DCOWGs in the same group are equivalent as one DCOWG to analyze the dynamic characteristics. Simulation results from MATLAB/SIMULINK verify the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Uncertain Power Flow Algorithm for Hybrid AC/DC Grids Incorporating VSCs
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The AC/DC hybrid system enhances the ability of the power system to accept renewable energy sources. At the same time, the uncertainty of renewable energy output presents new problems in AC/DC hybrid systems, especially in converter buses. In this paper, affine arithmetic based sequential AC/DC power flow method is established. It can provide less conservative affine estimation results when the system contains uncertain injection power. Furthermore, affine numbers can preserve the correlation between the uncertainties, so the quantitative analysis of the influence of the uncertainty can be carried out by the index of the impact of the uncertain variable on the system state variables. In the affine arithmetic based sequential AC/DC power flow method, the VSC bus is equivalent to the type of the AC bus and the DC bus, and corresponds to the pure AC and pure DC power flow model. The fastness and accuracy of the algorithm are tested by an AC/DC grid incorporating VSCs. At the same time, the impacts of the uncertain variable on the system state variables of the test system is analyzed.

articleTitle: Study on available energy estimation of LFP battery based on increment energy curve
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the battery ages, the available energy of the battery will decline obviously, and accurately estimating the available energy of the battery will have important significance for the management and control of the battery system. Four 50Ah lithium iron phosphate (LFP) batteries returned from electric bus as the research object. The maximum charging and discharging current that can be sustained by a cell was tested for 1000 cycles at 25°C, and the one-time energy test was conducted for every 100 cycles, this includes a capacity test with 1/3C current and an increment capacity analyze(ICA) test with 1/20C current. The energy and capacity degeneration characteristics are compared through the above experiments, and the increment energy (IE) curve that reflects the chemical characteristics of the battery is obtained by analogy with ICA. The IE curve is used to analyze the degeneration characteristics of the battery and estimate the available energy of the battery, and verify the correctness and effectiveness of the method.

Index Terms: Increase In The Number Of Cycles

articleTitle: Design of the Unit Startup Process by Dragging Back-to-back for Pumped Storage Power Station
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The range of equipment that needs to be operated in the startup process of the pumped storage unit in back-to-back mode is discussed in this article, and the analysis of the security lockout relationship and sequence between devices is also discussed in the article. The driven machine is the master, which can ensure the synchronization and safety of the startup process. Moreover, the interaction information between the two units in the back-to-back mode is reasonably set.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatch of Integrated Electricity and Natural Gas Energy Systems with Long-Distance Pipeline Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the large-scale application of gas turbines in power system and the development of P2G technology, integrated electricity and natural gas energy systems is the development trend of future. However, in the case of long-distance natural gas network, the dynamic characteristics of natural gas network can't be neglected in joint dispatch due to the calculation errors under the steady model and the neglect of natural gas network's storage capacity, which leads to the adjustment space of gas well output to reduce. In order to describe the dynamic characteristics, based on the fluid equations of natural gas flow, the equations are simplified, and in order to avoid the influence of large time step selection on numerical stability, the central implicit difference method is used to difference partial differential equations. Therefore, an optimal dispatch model of integrated electricity and natural gas energy systems with long-distance natural gas network is proposed in this paper. Finally, the rationality and correctness of the proposed model are verified by IEEE-39 nodes and Belgian natural gas 20-node example.

Author Keywords: integrated electricity and natural gas energy systems

articleTitle: GIS Partial Discharge Type Identification Based on Optimized Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The fault diagnosis of partial discharge in GIS is of great significance to the evaluation of the operation status of GIS. The traditional pattern recognition algorithms include neural networks and support vector machines (SVM). However, the isolated data points in the data samples will cause over-fitting during classifier training because of the existence of interference signals. The training error was continuously reduced and the complexity of the model was continuously improved, which eventually leads to an increase in generalization error and a decrease in recognition rate. In order to solve these problems, four partial discharge models were established and detected by UHF method to extract characteristic parameters. Besides, SVM was optimized by choosing appropriate kernel function, adopting L2 regularization and principal component analysis (PCA). The recognition accuracy of 96.5% can be achieved. The recognition speed was improved by applying PCA. The results show that the optimized SVM algorithm can improve the efficiency of pattern recognition.

articleTitle: Study on Interference for PD Dectection in Substation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The complex electromagnetic interference in substation could bring great influence to the on-line detection of partial discharge. Therefore, how to resist interference in PD detection has been the most critical point. At present, the main PD detection methods include UHF (ultrahigh frequency) detection and HF (high frequency) current detection. In this paper, substation with representative geographical location and voltage level were selected, and UHF and HF current method are used to detect the time-domain, frequency-domain and statistical characteristics of typical electromagnetic interference in substation. Studies have shown that the two main types of electromagnetic interference in PD detection are mobile communication signals and pulse discharges outside the device. From the characteristic analysis, the external pulse discharge is very similar to the PD signal, which is very easy to affect the PD detection.

articleTitle: Parallel Calculation Method of Line Loss Based on Decomposition and Coordination of Tie-line Extended Area
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to meet the online computational demand of theoretical loss for large-scale network, this paper proposes a parallel calculation method for line loss based on the decomposition and coordination calculation model. On the basis of network partitioning, different types of networks can select appropriate power flow algorithms. Further utilizing the tie-line extended area, a double-layer iterative mode is introduced. The outer iteration of the boundary vector is used to realize the unification of power flow for the whole network, ensuring that the parallel algorithm has the same convergence as the traditional method. The parallel program code is written by MATLAB parallel toolbox and tested on the IEEE14 node system and the actual regional power grid. The results show that the proposed method has good computational accuracy and convergence ability, and the acceleration effect is obvious, which has certain application value.

articleTitle: Research on Online Software Management System of Intelligent Substation Based on Two-layer Architecture of Regional Station Domain
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For the problem that the secondary equipment configuration of intelligent substation has a large workload and the software version used does not have full process management, an online software management system is proposed. Firstly, the substation software management and control architecture of the two-layer architecture of the regional station domain is proposed. Then, the system functions, software management processes and application scenarios are elaborated and analyzed. This system can manage the life cycle of the software of the secondary equipment of the intelligent substation, ensure the accuracy of the whole process of the intelligent substation equipment software version, improve operation and maintenance efficiency, and realize the stable and reliable operation of the intelligent substation.

articleTitle: A Medium-Voltage Wind Generation System Based on MPMSG and MMC and Its Fault-Tolerant
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of high power and high- reliability requirements for wind turbines, a new type of medium-voltage wind generation system based on multi-phase permanent magnet synchronous generator (MPMSG) and modular multi-level converter (MMC) is proposed in this paper. The system makes full use of the modularity and fault tolerance of MPMSG and MMC, and has the ability to output medium and high voltage through the cascade of modules, and can improve the fault tolerance of the system. Based on the detailed description of the system topology, operation principle and control method, this paper then proposes a fault-tolerant control strategy based on redundant power module switching and common-mode voltage segmentation injection, and analyzes its feasibility and impact. In the end, the effectiveness of the proposed solution is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Allocation of Distributed Generations in Multi-energy System for Rural Area
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the optimal allocation of multi-energies in rural area is analyzed. First of all, the energy generation potential capacities of PV, wind power are analyzed according to the natural conditions of the specific area. Then, the characteristics of the AC loads, DC loads and thermal loads at the large time-scales are also analyzed. Besides, the basic structure of the typical multi-energy system is presented based on the classification of different loads. Furthermore, optimal allocation model of multi-energy system, including the objective function and control strategy, is built. Finally, the cost sensitivity analysis of the different renewable energy is implemented. The results of this paper provide the reference for the construction of the multi-energy system in a rural area.

articleTitle: Fault Phase Selection Method for Half-Wavelength Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a novel faulted phase selection scheme is proposed for time delay longitudinal protection and distance protection applied to half-wavelength power transmission lines. The authors describe the principle of a faulted phase selection scheme for half-wavelength power transmission lines using the fault superimposed voltage and current sampled from one end of a half-wavelength power transmission line. This method is based on a fault superimposed circuit. This paper shows that conventional faulted phase selection schemes cannot perform properly. Complex faulted superimposed voltage and current selectors are used to build the faulted phase selection scheme. This scheme is insensitive to fault path resistance, system impedance and load current. Simulations verify the high accuracy of the scheme for different types of faults in a typical half-wavelength power transmission line.

articleTitle: Research on Local Optimal Dispatching Method of Park-Level Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to realize the complementary coordination among different energy forms such as electricity, gas, cold and heat in the park-level integrated energy system, and improve the economic benefits of its operation, a typical energy hub structure which takes combined heat and power unit as the core and integrates multi-coupling devices is proposed. By minimizing the daily operating cost, the day-ahead dispatching model of the internal energy flow distribution of the park-level integrated energy system is established and solved by chaotic particle swarm optimization algorithm. The case study verifies the effectiveness of the algorithm, and the established day-ahead dispatching model can flexibly adjust the internal energy flow according to load and the change of time-of-use electricity price, and distribute the output of various devices, which can improve the economic benefits of multi-energy supply, complementary and coordinated operation in the park-level integrated energy system.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation Index System of Guangdong Electricity Auxiliary Service Market
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The analysis and evaluation of ancillary services is an integral part of power market construction. However, the research work on the evaluation system of ancillary services in power market at home and abroad is relatively few and not deep enough, and a complete market analysis and evaluation system and theoretical methods have not yet been formed. Based on the requirements of the "two rules" issued by the China Electricity Regulatory Commission and the current implementation, operation and management of auxiliary services in Guangdong power grid, this paper constructs a relatively scientific and comprehensive evaluation index system of an ancillary services market. It is from the aspects of technical assessment, market conditions, market behaviour, market performance and market risk, taking into account the complexity and diversity of the indexes involved in the evaluation of ancillary services market, which can provide a quantitative reference for the supervision and evaluation of ancillary service in Guangdong power grid.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Resource Allocation in NOMA Wireless Power Transfer Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper investigates resource allocation of simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) in non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) system with power splitting (PS) technology. Our goal is to optimize both the harvested energy and the transmission rate subject to the minimum requirements on each user’s harvested energy and transmission rate. Considering the battery is capable of storing power which is converted into throughput in reverse link, we establish the equivalent-sum-rate (ESR) maximazation function by combining the transformed throughput and the transmission rate with a weight coefficient. Since the formulated nonconvex problem is difficult to solve, we develop a deep learning-based approach to obtain an efficient resource allocation strategy. In particular, deep belief network (DBN), which comprises preparing data samples, training and running, has been adopted. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed DBN-based scheme, and prove that the ESR performance of the considered NOMA-SWIPT is better than that of the OFDMA-SWIPT.

Author Keywords: simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT)

articleTitle: EV Charging Guidance Strategy Considering Dynamic Road Network and Personalized Driving Conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the high risk of electric vehicles running out of power during driving, it is urgent to research a charging path planning method for electric vehicles that is conducive to reducing users' travel anxiety. In this paper, through the selection can accurately reflect the actual characteristics of running condition of road users in the driving characteristic parameters, analysis of the characteristic parameters and the correlation between power consumption and the characteristics of the correlation between the strong and weak, using principal component analysis on the characteristics of dimension reduction, based on information entropy fuzzy clustering method for driving modes are classified, and the energy consumption of building electric cars driving model. In order to reduce the road network travel time when drivers go to charging stations, a dynamic road network model is established. According to the personalized driving conditions, a driving mode recognition model is established. Through the identification and analysis of different driving modes, a personalized energy consumption model is established. This paper analyzes the influence of personalized energy consumption model and dynamic road network on charging path planning and the influence of different optimization objectives on the optimization results of user charging path, and verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed planning method.

articleTitle: Research on Business-oriented Smart Grid Asset Information Modeling Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a smart grid asset information modeling language based on domain-specific modeling method, which is used to describe the data specification of smart grid asset account, and is easy for experts in the field of asset management to understand and use. In order to meet the requirements of asset life cycle management, asset objects are described from three dimensions: functional location, product and spatial location, which have the characteristics of flexibility and wide applicability. A meta-model of asset information modeling language is proposed and a modeling tool is implemented. It can be used to model and edit asset account specifications for business personnel. It can be divided into asset classification model, structural model and parameter model. The validity of the proposed modeling language is proved by the case study and large-scale application.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Scheduling of Power System with High-penetration Renewable Energy Considering Flexibility of Power Supply Side and Load Side
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The integration of high shares of variable renewable energy (VRE) makes the system’s uncertainty increase sharply. It is technically and economically unsustainable to adopt traditional system reserve methods to cope with uncertainties. Fully exploiting various flexible resources to adapt to high shares of VRE is an important issue in the operational planning of future power systems. This paper considers the demand response to establish the power system flexibility adequacy assessment indicators on power supply side and load side. Secondly, in order to reflect the contribution of multi-type flexible resources to the improvement of system flexibility, a flexible resource contribution evaluation index is built. Then, the system flexibility adequacy index is included in the constraint conditions, and a flexible optimization scheduling model of power system with high penetration of wind power considering the flexibility of power supply side and load side is established. Finally, based on IEEE39 system, the related indicators and scheduling optimization methods proposed in this paper are verified. The example shows that the optimization method proposed in this paper can effectively reduce system reserve and flexible scheduling various flexible resources to reduce renewable energy curtailment. In addition, with the increase of wind power penetration rate, the demand response is more and more important to the flexibility of the power system, especially the downward flexibility.

articleTitle: Two-stage Optimization Model of Electric Vehicle Participating in Balancing Market
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart grid and vehicletogrid (V2G) technology, we can alleviate the system imbalance caused by high proportion of renewable energy by carefully designing the balancing market rules and introducing new flexible resources, such as electric vehicle (EV). Firstly, the paper designs the integrated process of EV participating in electricity market by establishing a bilevel architecture with EV aggregator (EVA) and sets a comprehensive process of EVA participating in balancing market. Then, based on the charging and discharging characteristics of EV and the users' transportation demand, the paper proposes an implementation framework of EVs participating in balancing market, including contract details, EVs characteristics and vehicle grouping. Finally, based on rolling horizon procedure, an optimization model for EVA participating in the day-ahead market and the balancing market at the same time is established to make full use of the flexible capabilities of the growing number of EV. The MATLAB/CPLEX software is used to illustrate the impact of the proposed model on EV user's profit by comparing with the traditional clearing model of the balancing market involving only generators. The result shows that the model can improve the benefits of EVA and reduce the balancing cost of the system.

articleTitle: Disturbance Feedforward Compensation Control Strategy for Parallel Inverters Systems in Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When the load is suddenly increased or decreased and different DGs are arbitrarily plugged-in or plugged-out from the parallel inverters system, due to the inherent regulation characteristics of PI controller, a large overshoot will be generated, which makes the output voltage of each inverter inevitably increase or drop in a sudden following way, which will have a non-negligible impact on the islanded microgrid. Due to the lack of inertial components, the parallel inverters system is prone to disturbing oscillation, which will lead to the imbalance of circulating current and power distribution between inverters and cause the fluctuation of operating voltage of microgrid. To ensure the microgrid under the topology changes of stable operation, at the same time without having to join the power quality compensation device and communication links among droop controllers to solve the problems, this paper put forward disturbance feedforward dynamic compensation control for parallel inverters based on the robust residual generator.

articleTitle: Design of Energy Block Chain System Supporting Electric Vehicle Charge and Discharge Trading
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As one of the underlying supporting technologies of Energy Internet, energy blockchain has attracted more and more attention. How to combine energy blockchain with specific application scenarios is a difficult problem in current research. Firstly, the technical feasibility of the application of energy blockchain in the field of energy trading is analyzed in detail. Then, taking the scenario of electric vehicle charging and discharging trading as the breakthrough point, considering the convenience and security of both sides of the transaction, a blockchain system framework supporting consensus algorithm and intelligent contract is proposed, which includes blockchain layer and intelligent contract. There are four layers of architecture: extension layer, application layer and presentation layer. Finally, from the perspective of system platform development, the technical connotation and application demonstration based on ethereum architecture are introduced. The system architecture and its application effect provide technical reference for promoting the integration of energy system and information technology and improving energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Robust Fusion Estimation of Asynchronous Hybrid Measurement in Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper develops a robust unscented Kalman filter (RUKF) based on unscented Kalman filter (UKF) for power system fusion estimation of asynchronous hybrid measurement. The proposed RUKF estimation method mainly solves two problems. First, the un-synchronization between PMU and SCADA measurements results in the inability to use the mixed measurements at the same time. Second, the bad data of PMU cause the reduction of filtering accuracy. RUKF achieves the synchronization of mixed measurements by calculating the measurement correlation. And a gain matrix correction method has been proposed that allows us to detect bad PMU measurements and filter them out by RUKF. Simulation results carried out on the IEEE 30-bus test system show that the RUKF can track system status more accurately and reliably than the traditional UKF and extended Kalman filter (EKF).

articleTitle: Research on Orderly Electricity Consumption Management Strategy for Campus Dormitory
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electricity in student dormitory is an important part of campus electricity. The particularity of the campus student dormitory and the use of high-power equipment make the student dormitory consume a large amount of electricity, but electricity consumption is not efficient. The power supply of high-power equipment such as water boiler and air conditioners in the current student dormitory is continuous, but the travel of the people in the student dormitory is regular. From this perspective, It is significant and feasible to put forward a kind of orderly electricity management strategy for campus student dormitory based on the study of the travel laws of the staff in the dormitory. In this paper, the concept of "social energy" is first introduced to propose an orderly power scheme for student residences by controlling the state of the water boilers. Then based on the proposed orderly electricity technical route, the case study of the typical student dormitory building of Beijing Jiaotong University(BJTU) is provided and studied to show the preliminary design and feasibility of the orderly electricity technical route. Finally, in the concluding remarks, the paper summarizes the full-text technical route and the prospect of an orderly electricity plan that incorporates the concept of "social energy".

articleTitle: Research on the Market Trading Model of Ancillary Services of Diversified Flexible Ramping
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of clean energy, the penetration of renewable energy has increased the difficulty of regulation of the power grid. Flexible resource support services provide a feasible means to solve this problem. Considering multiple flexible resources such as generators, electric vehicles, energy storage and so on, and aiming at minimizing the economic cost of the system, this paper proposes a method that clearing multiple flexible resources together, and constructs a real-time market flexible ramping products (FRP) clearing model with the participation of various aggregators(VA). Finally, the feasibility and applicability of the model are verified by the case analysis.

articleTitle: Effectiveness Evaluation System and Evaluation Method for Anti-ice Damage Technical Transformation Project of Overhead Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Implementation of technical transformation measures for anti-ice damage of overhead lines can effectively reduce the occurrence of power grid accidents, which are important means to ensure the safety and stable operation of power grid and to improve the operation level of equipment. This paper firstly sorts out the mechanism of the occurrence of ice damage on overhead lines and common protective measures. Then, from the four aspects of ice damage trip, ice damage failure outrage, ice damage risk index and unit investment reducing loss benefits, an evaluation index system is proposed. Finally, DARE-RSR, a new method, is used to evaluate the effects of the technical transformation projects. To evaluate the anti-icing effect, firstly, the evaluation index system should be constructed and the anti-icing damage attribute of the system should be determined; then the index weight should be determined according to the DARE method; then the index values can be calculated to obtain the original data matrix; The uniformization process is performed to rank each evaluation object; finally, the weighted RSR of each evaluation object is calculated, and the ice damage is analyzed in combination with the evaluation result.

articleTitle: Review of Research on Fault Analysis of Large-Scale Motor-Generator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Based on power balance and stability of power grid, pumped storage power station plays an important role in modern power system. Motor-generator is the main equipment of a pumped storage power station. The fault rate and operation reliability of motor-generator is directly related to safe and stable operation of the power station and even the power grid. This paper summaries different types of faults with several examples of fault treatment of large-scale motor-generators, and puts forward corresponding countermeasures and suggestions, which provides a good reference for similar fault prevention and diagnosis.

articleTitle: SOC Estimation of Li-ion Battery by Adaptive Dual Kalman Filter under Typical Working Conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Estimating the state of charge (SOC) of Li-ion battery by the traditional extend Kalman filter (EKF), the unreasonable noise settings and inaccurate model parameters may decrease the accuracy. Here, an adaptive dual extended Kalman filter which can dynamically adjust the process noise covariance and battery model parameters is established by the second order RC model. The algorithm uses the EKF algorithm as the main body, fixes the measurement noise covariance, and adaptively adjusts the process noise covariance based on the maximum likelihood estimation criterion. Another Kalman filter (KF) is simultaneously used to estimate battery model parameter in real time to constitute a joint algorithm. In this paper, the charging and discharging experiments of lithium iron phosphate batteries are carried out. The SOC estimation by different adaptive adjustment strategies of noise covariance are compared and analyzed under actual operating condition. Meanwhile, the SOC under different aging conditions is also estimated and compared. The results show that the proposed joint algorithm has higher estimation accuracy, faster convergence speed and more extensive applicability.

articleTitle: Calculation Method for Incremental ‘Coal to Electricity’ Load and Corresponding Average Distribution Transformer Capacity
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Distribution network planning is the basis to guarantee reliable operation of ‘Coal to Electricity’ (‘C2E’) distribution network. While, as a kind of incremental load, there is no standard about transformer capacity for each ‘C2E’ consumer. As a result, ‘C2E’ distribution network planning and design lacks basic rules. Aimed at this problem, a method named ‘Heat load to Electricity load’ for calculating ‘C2E’ incremental load and average transformer capacity per consumer is proposed in this paper, which provides basis to ‘C2E’ distribution network and electrical equipment selection. With this method, ‘C2E’ electrical load and average transformer capacity is determined by heating load of building in demand side. An example with typical residential building in Beijing is taken in this paper. Heating load of building is calculated using DeST (Designer’s Simulation Toolkits) firstly. Then, with the kind of electrical heating equipment, average transformer capacity for each ‘C2E’ consumer in Beijing rural area is given.

articleTitle: Suggestions on Electric Power Industry Reform under Regional Integration of Yangtze River Delta
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The development of regional integration in the Yangtze River Delta has become part of the national development strategy. The electric power industry in East China is in need of advanced planning to better serve the economic development in the new situation. In this paper, we actively consider how to take the regional integration of Yangtze River Delta as an opportunity to promote the operation and management of local power grid. On the one hand, the construction of energy platforms based on the cooperation of relevant provinces and municipalities is considered. On the other hand, the research and exploration of the ubiquitous power Internet of things are included. Finally, some suggestions for the reform of the electric power system in the Yangtze River Delta region are discussed.

articleTitle: Methods of Preventing Collusion of Generation Enterprises in East China Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The electric power industry organizational reform in China has achieved remarkable progress. In such a critical period of electricity market development and reform, it needs to avoid the risks brought by power generation enterprises exercising market power and manipulating market prices. Collusion, which is one of the behaviors of power generation enterprises to exercise market power, is more unfavorable to market competition. This paper proposes specific methods and rules to prevent the collusion. The goal is to disturb and stop the redistribution of profits among collusive generators. And the methods can provide a reference for the formulation of electricity trading rules in East China Power Grid.

articleTitle: Three-Phase Imbalance Management and Economic Operation for Distribution Area with Natural Ester Insulating Transformers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the expanding application of natural ester insulating transformers in distribution area, the economic operation of distribution network becomes more and more important in order to reduce the overall cost in a distribution transformer's life cycle. The imbalanced three-phase load increases the loss of transformers, and results in low voltage problem in the heavy load phase or even damages to customer's electrical equipment. In this paper, a multi-objective optimal commutation mathematical model is established and verified to optimize the performance of the three-phase load imbalance regulation based on commutation switches. Compared with the common devices such as reactive compensation and SVG, the real-time online commutation switch system with an automatic commutation control strategy based on proposed vector genetic algorithm displays a better performance in reducing the power loss of distribution area as well as in solving the low voltage problem of users. We expect it to be a competitive solution for the economic and efficient operation of the distribution power grid.

articleTitle: Feasibility Analysis of Nuclear-BESS Hybrid Systems for Peak Regulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the proportion of renewable energy generation continues to increase, the system's demand for flexible peak-regulation resources is increasing. In order to promote energy transformation, nuclear power and other power sources that originally only bear the base load will gradually share the burden of peak-regulation. With the advancement of nuclear power technology, its load-following performance has gradually improved. Nuclear power companies need to study their possible peak-regulation measures to prepare for the subsequent nuclear power to actively participate in the system load regulation. This paper explores the feasibility of nuclear-BESS hybrid systems for peak regulation and compares the economics under two different regulation modes ("alternative peak-regulation mode" and "joint peak-regulation mode"). The simulation results show that " alternative peak-regulation mode" has a better economy.

articleTitle: Financial Storage Rights in Modern Energy Markets: Strategies and Outlooks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The paper discusses the benefits and shortcomings of two existing direct current optimal power flow (DCOPF) models in the context of financial storage rights. According to the case study results, the FSRs may not be able to provide confident incentives for storage owners to transfer their operation rights to system operators. The paper proposes possible solutions to solve this issue. The simulation results indicate the proposed schemes not only create motivations for storage owners to transfer their operations to the system operator but also reinforce the storage devices owners’ profits.

articleTitle: Research on Cross-border Electricity Price Spread Model of Nordic Power Market
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the cross-border electricity price difference data in the Nordic power market is modeled with the standard generalized autoregressive conditional heteroscedasticity model, GJR model and Markov-switching GARCH model. These models are estimated with normal, skewed normal and skewed student-t-t distributions. Studies show that cross-border electricity price difference data is not only a "spike" higher than the electricity price data, data jumping is more obvious, but also "volatility cluster" and strongly regime-dependent. The example analysis shows that the MS-GARCH model estimated with skewed normal distribution has the better predictive performance than other models, according to evaluation index like mean squared error MSE and the mean absolute error MAE for one- and multi-step ahead forecasts. Accurate cross-border electricity price difference forecast results can enable power companies and consumers to avoid risks when auctioning in the financial transmission right market.

articleTitle: Analytical Calculation of the Difference in Parallel Output Current Between the 12-pulse Rectifier Bridges Based on Transformer Leakage Inductance and DC inter-phase Reactor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electric propulsion is a future trend in terms of ship propulsion. The high-power multi-pulse rectifier will be widely applied to the electric propulsion system due to its simple structure, high efficiency, high reliability and low cost. Considering the non-ideal characteristics of the 12-pulse rectifier transformer system(RTS) used for 2MW-level propulsion and such factors as transformer leakage inductance, DC inter-phase reactor and rectifier commutation overlap, this paper has presented an equivalent circuit of the two paralleled rectifiers with an inter-phase reactor, formulated the equations of their DC steady-state voltage and AC small signal voltage and derived an analytical expression for the output current difference between the two rectifiers, according to each of four sections. On this basis, the output current difference is calculated and simulated according to different output voltage, AC side leakage inductance and inter-phase reactor value of the transformer. The results show that the derived analytical expression for the output current difference is correct and feasible which will provide the theoretical basis for the optimal design of a 2MW-level 12-pulse RTS involving the transformer leakage inductance and DC inter-phase reactor.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies and Development Strategies of Versatile Power Supply Station (VPSS) Construction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The construction of versatile power supply station (VPSS) is an important part of the development strategy of the State Grid Corporation in the future. Under this circumstance, how to implement the business combination and the information fusion of the VPSS has been becoming a hot topic in last decades. In this paper, the typical characteristics of VPSS and the existing challenges in VPSS construction are summarized. Then, the key technologies of VPSS construction are proposed from the working team, requirement equipments and the business managements aspects. Moreover, the corresponding development strategies are also listed in the extension of the distribution system in rural area in China. The theoretical analysis of this paper has certain guiding significance for the construction of VPSS in the future.

articleTitle: A Distributed Fault-detecting Mechanism in Cyber-Physical Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Recently, to cope with resource and environment problems, quantities of new energy sources have been exploited. Many of them are connected to the power distribution network in the form of distributed generation (DG). With the promotion of permeability of DGs, the direction and amplitude of fault currents are dramatically influenced, making traditional protection unable to detect faults. Besides, with the development of cyber-physical systems(CPS), it is possible to gather more information to make comprehensive decisions to help detect a fault in power distribution network. This paper proposes a distributed fault-detecting mechanism in a CPS. Depending on the designed CPS structure, information of current and voltage from all nodes can be gathered in a subsystem. Furthermore, such information will be edge-computed, using the proposed algorithm and process of fault identification and location. Thus, varieties of fault can be effectively discovered and accurately located, in power distribution network with DGs.

articleTitle: A Multi-Objective Optimization Planning of Park-level Integrated Energy System Based on Two-tier Planning Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A two-tier planning model is presented for multi-objective optimization planning in the park-level Integrated Energy System (IES) for the complementary coupling of electricity, heat and gas, to determine the optimal capacity of the device and the corresponding operating plan for the system, while taking into account constraints like multi-energy supply and demand, equipment capacity, and energy pipeline transmission loss. Such optimization is to minimize the system annualized investment cost, the operation cost and the carbon emission, by way of the weight coefficient method. The whale optimization algorithm is used to model the upper optimization, while the MATLAB/YALMIP/ GUROBI joint solver is used to model the lower optimization. The obtained results show that the IES gives full play to the complementary coupling between various energy forms.
