Compared with the traditional independent energy supply mode, IES performs better in economy and environmental protection.

articleTitle: A High-voltage and Large-capacity Reactive Power Compensator Based on Magnetic-controlled Switch
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A novel high-voltage and large-capacity reactive power compensator based on magnetic-controlled switch (MCS) is proposed, according to the present situation of reactive power compensation in high-voltage distribution network. MSC is either "on" or "off", implementing the dynamic switch of compensation capacitors, while the transformer is either short-circuited or open-circuited by turning on or turning off the triacs. In order to improve the voltage and power ratings, the multi-winding transformer is employed. In this paper, the characteristic of compensation and no-load and special case about large-capacity MCS is analyzed theoretically. A rated 35kV, 2100kVA prototype is developed and the experimental results verify the advantages of the compensator such as small transient inrush, high reliability and low loss.

articleTitle: Knowledge Acquisition of Online Static Voltage Stability Margin Assessment Based on Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Modern power system has produced a large amount of offline data during the operational planning studies. In order to extract the evaluation rules of voltage stability margin from massive data, a knowledge acquisition model based on random forest (RF) algorithm is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the training set of the random forest is obtained by PV curve analysis and calculation of voltage stability margin, based on the simulation data under n-k fault. Then, the online evaluation model of the voltage stability margin is trained using the RF algorithm. Finally, by using the proposed RF rule extraction method, some voltage stability margin evaluation rules are extracted with high accuracy and coverage. The proposed method is verified on IEEE 3-machine 9-bus system. Simulation result shows that the obtained knowledge of voltage stability margin has high accuracy, and can effectively evaluate the real-time operation status of the power grid.

articleTitle: Comparison of Various Tracking Modes on Improvement of PV Power Generation System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This study mainly elaborates on six installation modes for PV power generation systems, namely, traditional fixed type, vertical single-axis tracking, north-south single-axis tracking, east-west single-axis tracking, dual-axis tracking, and fixed mode on the horizontal plane. Based on the above installation modes, a mathematical model is established for power generation of and solar radiation received by solar cell modules under the temperature of modules and attenuation of power generation. Furthermore, the ratio of energy output under different installation modes to energy output under horizontal installation is calculated by MATLAB. This paper concludes with the comparison of power generation capacity of six devices in Chenggong District of Kunming. It is showed that the utilization rate under dual-axis tracking is the highest and that under horizontal installation is the lowest. The study results can serve as a reference basis for the design of PV projects in low-latitude Class II Region of China (moderately abundant in solar energy resources), and provide data support for the implementation of different tracking modes.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on Generation Right Trading Models for Supporting Renewable Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Generation right trading between renewable generation units and thermal power units is a common practice in China. This paper performs comparative studies of generation right trading models with different objective functions, which may include the optimization of social benefits, energy conservation and emission reduction. Moreover, a multi-objective generation right trading model that combines the objectives of maximization of social benefits and energy conservation is proposed. The ideal point and weight coefficient methods are employed to solve the multi-objective optimization problem. Comparative case studies show that generation right trading with maximization of energy conservation and emission reduction can effectively promote renewable energy consumption.

articleTitle: Enabling Technologies for Multinational Interconnected Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The multinational interconnected smart grid is a crucial part for the construction of global energy internet, which requires various technologies to support. Based on the key technologies of multinational grid, this paper first states the importance of emerging information communication technologies, such as distributed cloud computing and blockchain, which ensure safe and stable operation of the grid. Then this paper discusses smart-grid control technologies for power dispatch and grid security. Finally, this paper talks about enabling power electronic technology and analyzes the relationship between power electronics, flexible AC transmission and HVDC transmission technology. To conclude, all these technologies play key roles in enabling multinational interconnected power systems.

articleTitle: Day-Ahead Scheduling of a Microgrid-Like Fast Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the fast spreading of electric vehicles (EVs), the demand for EV fast charging station (FCS) is increasing fast. In this paper, a day-ahead scheduling strategy for a microgrid-like FCS with an in-station photovoltaic system (PVS) and a battery energy storage system (BESS) is proposed. The strategy is modeled as a scenario-based stochastic optimization problem whose objective is to minimize the expected total operation cost in the next day. Considering the power exchange between the FCS and the grid, the operation cost contains the cost of buying power in the day-ahead market, the expected adjustment cost and penalty in the real-time market and the life loss cost of the BESS. A piecewise linear life loss calculation model of the BESS is adopted. The uncertainty of the PVS output and the fast charging demand are considered in the model through randomly generated scenarios. In each scenario the PVS output and fast charging demand are generated using a Monte Carlo simulation method. This strategy considers the life loss cost of the BESS effectively and provide reasonable day-ahead schedules. In the case study, a simulation of the proposed day-ahead scheduling method is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Error Analysis and Correction of the Fluctuation Quantity-Based Method in Harmonic Impedance Identification for Traction Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The fluctuation quantity-based method has been widely used because of its simple principle and strong practicability. However, when the harmonic source of the system side fluctuates greatly, the method has a large error. Therefore, in order to accurately evaluate the calculation error of the fluctuation quantity-based method and explore the applicability of the fluctuation quantity-based method, this paper takes the V/v wiring transformer as an example to propose the phase-to-phase harmonic transmission formula of the traction power supply system, and derives the error coefficient of the system harmonic impedance of the calculation by the volatility method. The results show that the calculation error of the fluctuation quantity-based method cannot be neglected. Therefore, an error compensation scheme based on genetic algorithm to identify the impedance parameters is proposed. In order to verify the correctness of the proposed theory and scheme, this paper establishes the simulation model of V/v wiring traction power supply system and conducts the computer simulation analysis. The results show that the error coefficient can accurately reflects the relative error of the fluctuation quantity-based method, and the scheme has good reliability and practicability.

articleTitle: Summary of Research on Power Boosting Technology of Distributed Mobile Energy Storage Charging Piles
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The rise and rapid development of the electric vehicle industry has made people's dependence on electric vehicles more and higher, and the accompanying range anxiety has become an urgent problem to be solved. The existing charging infrastructure is difficult to meet the needs of users for fast replenishment. Large-scale construction of DC charging piles has caused excessive demands on the distribution network capacity and easily leads to low equipment utilization. Therefore, this paper studies the construction of high-power charging piles for distributed mobile energy storage. Firstly, the application status of high-power charging technology and energy storage technology is summarized. In view of the shortcomings of the prior art, a high-reliability and low-cost charging pile power-boosting technology is proposed; Then the load forecasting method based on space-time dimension and the capacity optimization configuration method of energy storage device are expounded; Finally, the general situation and summary of the whole paper are given, and the future development direction of power-boosting of distributed mobile energy storage charging pile has prospected.

articleTitle: Integrated Demand Response Model of Microgrid Considering Electro-Thermal Coupling in Market Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the reform of the power market and the rapid development of distributed power supply and energy storage technology, the microgrid (MG) has greater market potential to participate in demand response(DR). In this paper, under background of the development of multi-energy integration and demand response in the electricity market, a real-time price based integrated demand response model for user-side microgrid is proposed where the rigid load is concerned and the multi-energy microgrid is used as a unit. Electricity and heat can be freely converted through the combined heat and power (CHP) system with adjustable thermoelectric ratio and the electric boilers: What's more, electricity and thermal energy storage on the user side to participate in demand response can realize the value superposition of the energy storage system. In this way, the rigid load can also exhibit a certain elasticity to the large power grid. Case study shows that the proposed scheme can timely respond to real-time price fluctuations, give full play to the advantages of the complementary coordination of electric and thermal energy and the value of "energy transfer" of energy storage technology, so as to realize the multi-win of users, micro grid and large grid.

articleTitle: Estimation for the Demand Response Potential of Residential HVACs
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: It has been proved by industrial practice that reduction of power system peak load can be effectively achieved through Demand Response (DR) programs, especially those based on direct load control of heating, ventilation and air conditioning devices (HVAC). When considering DR resource in planning and operation strategy of distribution system, accurate estimation of demand response potential for HVACs is crucial for improving the planning and operation outcomes. This paper proposes a methodology for estimating the demand response potential for residential HVACs using half-hourly smart meter data. The specific contributions of this paper extend the prior studies by: 1) establishing an HVAC load extraction framework based on a pattern similarity searching strategy; 2) incorporating the uncertainty of the baseload (i.e. energy consumption of nonthermal appliances) into the HVAC temperature response parameter estimation process. We apply this methodology on a real premise dataset that contains 300 households and show how it can be utilized to assess the DR potential of residential HVACs.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Least Squares Support Vector Machine Based Condition Evaluation Method of Microgrid Community
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the demand of microgrid community energy management and coordination control system for adaption to flexible adjustment of inter-microgrid, multi-working condition control strategy, a fuzzy Least Squares Support Vector Machine based low-voltage microgrid community operating state real-time assessment model is proposed. Based on traditional electricity system operating state description method, the model establishes the boundary condition for safe, normal operating state of microgrid community and sub-microgrid, classifying the state of microgrid with multidimensional characteristic vectors such as voltage deviation rate, residual energy storage capacity, charging and discharging time, power generation, power consumption, evaluating re-al-time operating state by using fuzzy Least Squares Support Vector Machine, finally judging the operating state of microgrid community. Case calculation and analysis show that the model can make a real-time evaluation in line with system sampling period, accurately and effectively classify the operating state of sub-microgrid both on-grid or off-grid, providing reliable basis for microgrid community to quick judge the condition of the grid and flexibly adjust control strategy.

Author Keywords: Fuzzy Least Squares Support Vector Machine

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Composite Insulators
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Composite insulators are widely used in high voltage transmission lines in coast and polluted areas due to excellent pollution flashover resistance, high strength and convenient installation and maintenance. While there are still various kinds of defects such as abnormal temperature rise, aging of materials even fracture in the existing composite insulators which have drawn the close attention of the operation and maintenance department of power grid. In order to realize the basic performance of new composite insulator products in China, specimens from major manufacturers of composite insulators are sampled for mechanical, electrical and physical and chemical testing. The test results show that the composite insulator products meet the requirements overall, but a few of them have micro-interface and macro-interface defects which may cause local heating even fracture under high humidity conditions. At the same time, the raw materials of composite insulator housing from different manufacturers is quite different, which has certain influence on the service life of composite insulator.

articleTitle: Modeling and Control of Variable Speed DFIG Pumped Storage Turbine Based on RTDS
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Hundreds of megawatt level variable speed Doubly Fed Induction Generator (DFIG) pumped storage turbine will play an important role in voltage and frequency regulation, system stability, active and reactive power control etc.. However, similar but different from the DFIG wind turbines, such power rating and reversible pump-turbine with small capacity converter to control the whole variable speed system is challenging. In this paper, mathematical analysis and modeling of variable speed DFIG pumped storage turbine including reversible pumped turbine, DFIG and back to back converter is build first. On this basis, the control method is presented. The grid side converter stabilizes the dc-side voltage and control the grid-connected current sinusoidal. The rotor-side converter can control and decouple the active power and reactive power independently. Finally, the real time simulation results of 300MW pumped storage turbine based on Real Time Digital Simulator platform indicate the proposed control strategy can achieve good performance in different working conditions of pumping and generation. The system has fast response and good stability.

articleTitle: Fine resolution 30-year climatic wind energy dataset over China for renewable energy assessment and operation via Weather Research and Forecasting model hindcast
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: One of the greatest obstacles in the exploitation of wind and solar energy is their intermittency and fluctuation. Long-term dataset of wind energy resource, which is built on basis of atmospheric numerical models, has been proved to be the most effective approach for wind energy resource assessment in wide area, on grid level and in fine resolution, as well as renewable energy electric energy capability forecast, site planning and dispatch/ operation schedule making of power system. To improve the accuracy of wind energy resource dataset by numerical models, the Weather Research and Forecasting model (WRF) and the Climate Four-Dimensional Data Assimilation (CFDDA) are adopted to conduct a sensitivity experiment, in 9 km spatial resolution, to distinguish a reliable model configuration in this study. Based on the statistics between WRF-CFDDA model output in hub-height wind speed and in-situ observations (sited on typical wind farms in Gansu, Xinjiang and Jilin province, 2010-2013), it has been confirmed that the model configuration with MERRA2 background field, Topowind topographic correction method and smoothed VASSO (VAriance of Sub-grid Scale Orography) terrain data is the most reasonable one, with a correlation coefficient 0.79 and RMSE 1.62 for 10-m height wind speed. Following this configuration, with assimilating all 30-year (1987-2016) ground-based meteorological observation from Chinese international exchange sites, the wind energy resource from 1987 to 2016 around China has been hindcasted and assessed in a resolution of 9 km, 15 min. The hindcast is capable to reproduce the characteristics in temporal and spatial distribution. This model system can be a reliable tool for reproducing decades of reanalyzed climatology and finer resolution assessment on hub-height wind energy, moreover, for reconstruction of typical wind power output curve.

Author Keywords: Hindcast dataset on high-resolution climatic wind resource

articleTitle: An Improved Profit Allocation Method of Load Aggregator based on Shapley Value under Government Regulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Load aggregator is one of the most effective means of integrating demand-side resources into the power system. However, with the complexity of the load aggregator members, especially with the introduction of "peaking devices" represented by batteries, the traditional method based on energy produced can not evaluate the role of participants properly. Aiming at this problem, this paper presents a distribution-allocation bi-level optimization model based on the improved Shapley value. The upper layer takes the relative income balance of each member as the optimization target, while the lower layer treats wind power, battery and interruptible load as the member of load aggregator. The power flow of load aggregator is optimized. In this paper, the operability and rationality of the proposed improved profit allocation method are proved by case study. It is also verified that the load aggregator is an effective way to integrate demand-side resources into the power system.

articleTitle: Research on Market-Dispatch-Management data Storage of the Versatile Power Supply Station
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The business of the Versatile Power Supply Station (VPSS) contains a variety of services due to it includes multiple information and data systems, involving a wide variety of data. Therefore, how to analyze and storage the multi-data of VPPS has been becoming a hot topic in the process of Ubiquitous Internet of Things construction. Under this circumstance, the basic characteristics of big data of VPPS are analyzed in this paper. On this basis, a big data dynamic adaptive composite storage scheme for VPPS, with low data redundancy and high data reliability, is designed. Moreover, the composite storage prototype system was tested for performance. And the results show that the data storage strategy proposed in this paper has strong data reliability and versatility, which can be widely used for data storage of VPPS.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling and Simulation of cyber Physical System of AC/DC Hybrid Distribution Network Based on Power Electronic Transformer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The close integration of distributed renewable energy and the close integration of cyber physical system bring challenges for power system modeling. In this paper, Firstly, the topology and control strategy of power electronic transformer (PET) are proposed. Secondly, this paper develops a modeling method about the hybrid distribution network PET based on finite state machine (FSM) and the joint simulation platform of cyber Physical system (CPS) based on RT-LAB, OPNET and control platform. Taking the hybrid distribution network based on PET with different penetration of photovoltaics (PV) as an example, the validity of PET model and control strategy is verified by comparing physical simulation results with joint simulation results of cyber physical system.

articleTitle: The Voltage Sag Mitigation Method Based on Hybrid SMES-BES Dynamic Voltage Restorer(DVR)
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The research of voltage sag mitigation method is an important task. A new method using hybrid energy storage (HES) strategy is proposed, which consists of Superconducting Magnetic Energy Storage (SMES), Battery Energy Storage (BES) and Dynamic Voltage Restorer (DVR). In addition, a power allocation optimization strategy for HES-based DVR is proposed and validated using the life cycle cost (LCC) theory. LCC is the objective function, which can be used to establish the optimization model. The constraint conditions of the model include the power of the throughput, the state of charge (SOC) and the power allocation optimization strategy. Finally, the cost analysis and the compensation performance are implemented using the SEMI F47 curve for the single BES, single SMES and SMES-BES device. The compared results show the superiority and effectiveness of the proposed method on the voltage sag mitigation.

articleTitle: Optimal Energy for Grid-Connected Microgrid with Battery Swapping Station and Wind Photovoltaic and Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, an optimal dispatch strategy, which can take into account the period division of time of use, the output power of renewable energy sources (RES) and replacement demand for batteries, is proposed. On this basis, by optimizing the battery swapping station (BSS) load in each period, an optimization model is established to minimize the power interaction between microgrid and the distribution network. An optimization algorithm is developed based on the well-established particle swarm optimization (PSO) and penalty function method to solve the power dispatch model. The proposed approach is demonstrated through an existing microgrid.

articleTitle: Effect of Diameter and Height on Ice Thickness of Cylinder
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The selection of design ice thickness directly affects the investment quota of line construction and transformation. In order to ensure the safe and reliable operation of transmission lines when encountering natural frozen disasters, it is necessary to demonstrate the design ice thickness of transmission lines in detail. This paper expounds the influence mechanism of height and wire diameter on ice thickness of conductors, observes the relationship between ice thickness and suspension height, wire diameter on the spot, analyses the influence of suspension height and wire diameter on ice thickness based on accumulated ice coating data at Xuefeng Mountain Natural Ice Covering Observatory Base of Chongqing University, and puts forward the height and diameter correction coefficient of ice thickness design of conductors in order to improve power grid construction. The investment benefit can provide reference for the sustainable development of power grid construction.

articleTitle: Analysis of Parallel Operation of 4H-SiC GTOs
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: SiC GTO is one of the most powerful power devices and very promising in high power applications such as HVDC and MW traction. However, the die size of SiC GTO is limited by the material defects, resulting in small current handling capability of discrete devices. Different from the situation in Si GTOs that parallel operation is never practically feasible, it is potential for paralleled SiC GTOs to balance their static currents naturally owing to the exhibited positive temperature coefficient of on-resistance in their temperature-dependent forward current-voltage characteristics according to our recent study. This paper focuses on analyzing the parallel operation of SiC GTOs. The temperature-dependent forward conduction characteristic and dynamic current sharing characteristics of SiC GTO is firstly investigated. And then the turn-off process is analyzed to explain the reason why turn-off failure occurs. Some possible solutions have also been proposed and verified to solve the turn-off failure problem. Therefore, the feasibility of parallel operation of SiC GTOs is demonstrated, and this will further help improve the power handling capability of SiC GTO based power electronics systems.

articleTitle: Mechanism Analysis on Peak Regulation Auxiliary Service Market in China: Towards a High-penetration Renewable Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, the renewable energy (RE) generation develops rapidly in China. The power grid is integrated with larger RE penetration along with severe energy curtailment. To address this challenge, it requires for an adaptive peaking regulation mechanism supported by more advanced market framework. Hence, this paper studies on the mechanism of peak regulation auxiliary service (PRAS) market in China. First, we review the current rules and procedures of different trading categories in PRAS market. Then, we compare the detailed rules in different provinces, including the transaction pricing and clearing mechanism. Then, a real-world case study is presented to compare the implementation of exemplary PRAS markets for power grids by com-paring the financial benefits of multiple market participants. Furthermore, we summarize the characteristics of current market mechanism, and provide suggestions to promote the RE accommodation through auxiliary market-based strategies.

articleTitle: Characterization of Gibbsite Filler in HTV Silicone Rubber by Thermogravimetric Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the present research, five filled HTV silicone rubber with different ATH filler content were manufactured and analyzed by TGA measurement in Argon atmosphere. The crystal structure of ATH filler was measured by XRD analysis, based on the XRD results, it can be confirmed that ATH filler used in this research is the Gibbsite. The weight loss process of HTV silicone rubber during the TGA process was identified, two loss peaks were observed in the derivative of TGA curve, one was attributed to the dehydration of ATH filler and the other one was attributed to the pyrolyzation of silicone rubber matrix. Furthermore, a calculation method for obtaining each component weight in HTV silicone rubber based on TGA results was proposed, based on this calculation method, the detailed content information of these five HTV silicone rubber was obtained. Based on this research, it can be concluded that the TGA analysis of filled HTV silicone rubber is an effective way to obtain the weight of each component in HTV silicone rubber.

articleTitle: Research on Commutation Torque Ripple Suppression of Open-winding Brushless DC Motor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The open-winding brushless dc motor has no neutral point, and the phase windings are electrically isolated, which can realize independent control of each phase. Firstly, the mathematical model of open-winding brushless dc motor is introduced, the influence of each phase caused by the mutual inductance and the impact of the diode freewheeling for non-commutation phase with the same bus power supply are analyzed. Secondly, the current commutation process of open-winding brushless dc motor during the commutation period is analyzed. It is concluded that if the turn-off and the conduction phase current with the same change rate, under the ideal Back electromotive (Back EMF) force condition, the non-commutation phase current is constant, then the electromagnetic torque remains the same. Thirdly, the working principle and process of overlapping commutation with phase current closed-loop control are given, the voltage applied on turn-off phase and the delay shutdown time formulas in overlapping commutation are derived. Finaliy, the control method is carried on the Matlab simulation and experiment, both the simulation and experimental results indicate that the control method can realize the commutation torque ripple suppression of the open-winding brushless dc motor.

articleTitle: An Improved Jiles-Atherton Model for DC Bias of Transformer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The Jiles-Atherton (J-A) theory is widely used in the field of semi-macro hysteresis modeling. However, the DC bias transformer model based on presented J-A theory has a big deviation due to only existence of AC component and the description of the hysteresis curve is incomplete in the biased state. Firstly, this article makes a revision to the J-A formula under normal excitation state. Moreover, through innovative introduction of DC component to improve non-hysteresis magnetization curve and differential expression of magnetization of J-A theory under DC bias state, and the pinning coefficient k is modified to establish a numerical simulation model. By verfied, the improved J-A model can describe the magnetization characteristics of ferromagnetic materials in the biased state better. Then, based on the improved J-A formula proposed a transformer DC bias iterative model. Finally, a transformer in a 500 kV grid is used to verify the accuracy of transformer DC bias model based on the improved J-A formula.

articleTitle: Study on Flashover Characteristics of Epoxy Resin and Polytetrafluoroethylene Under DC Voltage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The main components of resistive type DC superconducting fault current limiter (R-DCSFCL) are the current limiting unit and the electrical terminal, in which the insulating material used in cryogenic zone is mainly glass fiber reinforced epoxy resin and polytetrafluoroethylene. In this paper, insulation performance of epoxy resin and polytetrafluoroethylene samples in liquid nitrogen is studied. The effect of different electrode types, different creep distance and different flashover times on the flashover voltage of test sample in liquid nitrogen is investigated. Further, the test result is analyzed with Weibull distribution. The results show that the flashover voltage of G10 and PTFE is related to the electrode types and creep distance, and the secondary flashover voltage of G10 is significantly lower than the initial flashover voltage, which can be used as the theoretical basis for the design of low-temperature insulation for R-DCSFCL.

articleTitle: Insulation Simulation Analysis of Press-Pack IGBT
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In high voltage applications such as power grid and rail transportation, IGBT devices generally operate under very harsh conditions, which places high demands on device reliability. In this paper, the electric field distribution of silicon chip termination area and press-pack IGBT package structure under high voltage reverse bias experimental conditions is simulated by Fem software. The results indicate the potential electrical insulation failure areas in the package model and the corresponding optimization measures are proposed. To some extent, the problem of breakdown discharge of IGBT devices during operation is alleviated.

articleTitle: A Unit Commitment Model with Demand Response Considering Nuclear Power Participation in Peak Load Regulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Large-scale wind power connected to the power system has brought great challenges to economic operation. This paper presents a unit commitment model with demand response considering nuclear power participation in peak load regulation in order to enhance the capacity of wind power absorption and ensure the economic operation of the power system. This model includes a flexible peak load regulation model part on the premise of meeting the safety constrains of nuclear power units and a demand response model part based on price elasticity, both of them can participate in peak load regulation and valley filling. By increasing the flexibility of power generation on supply side and power consumption on demand side, the new model improve the load regulation capability, reduce the curtailment of renewable power and improve the economy of power system operation. At the same time, an improved limit scenario method is used to express the uncertainty of wind power in confidence interval by using a certain wind power prediction scenario and two limit scenarios, which simplifies the complexity and optimizes the reserve capacity. Examples show that the proposed model has a certain theoretical and practical significance.

articleTitle: Scheduling of Fully Renewable Energy Systems with CSP Plants and Pumped Storage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Energy crisis and environmental pollution are becoming increasingly serious. Increasing the penetration rate of renewable energy in the power system can effectively solve this problem. Wind power and photovoltaic power generation are fluctuating power sources, and their large-scale interconnection will increase the difficulty of grid scheduling. Therefore, based on the regulation characteristics of concentrating solar power station, this paper proposes a green power dispatching strategy for power system with full renewable energy. The purpose of this strategy is to promote the consumption of renewable energy. The cost of power generation of each unit of the system and the security operation constraints of the grid are considered comprehensively. Finally, CPLEX optimization software was used to solve the model. The results verify the feasibility and validity of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Optimization of Lightning Protection System for 10 kV Distribution Network Based on Yalmip Toolbox
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aimed at the problem of lightning breakage in distribution network, this paper firstly combined theoretical analysis and built model simulation in ATP / EMTP according to the actual situation of field lines, and then analyzed the main reasons for frequent lightning accidents in distribution network in China, and the protection ability of lightning shield line and lightning arrester. Secondly, through the analysis of lightning grounding fault of distribution network built in MATLAB/SIMULINK, it is found that the arc-suppression coil grounding operation mode can reduce the arc-building rate. Finally, the lightning protection system of simple radiation network is optimized by using yalmip toolbox.

articleTitle: Design of New Intelligent Commutation Switch Based on Bidirectional Thyristor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the commutation link in the design of intelligent commutation switch, and proposes a new commutation algorithm based on the "class division principle", which is fast and easy to apply in engineering, and optimizes the commutation strategy of the commutation link. At the same time, the hardware design of the commutation link is adopted, and the bidirectional thyristor which is easy to control is adopted as the solid state switch to realize fast switching between different phases. Finally, MATLAB is used to simulate the new commutation strategy, and the actual circuit is built to test the hardware. The feasibility of the scheme is verified.

articleTitle: Transient Analysis and Simulation of a Single-Phase Grounding Fault in 20kV Small Resistance Grounding System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, the distribution network adopting 20kV instead of 10kV has gained wide recognition in reducing the power supply radius and improving the power supply quality. In the southern power grid of China, cities such as Shenzhen, Zhuhai and Guangzhou have carried out pilot projects for the construction of 20kV power grids.20kV systems are often used in urban power distribution system, the concentration of the load and the limitation of outgoing-lines lead to a large cable scale, the system capacitor current often exceeds 100 amps or reach to hundreds of amps. Once a fault occurs, it will have an impact on power supply stability and personal safety. At present, relevant researches on 20kV small resistance grounding systems focus on their economic, steady-state characteristics and protection strategies. However, as the scale of the system continues to increase, the various transient processes that may be triggered and their influences to the electrical equipment still lack operational experience and theoretical evaluation. In this paper, combined with a ground fault of 20kV system and its potential transformer(PT) fault, the electromagnetic transient simulation is used to reproduce the transient over-voltage and over-current of the fault process, so that the cause of the fault is confirmed. The variation law of the over-voltage amplitude with the network scale is discussed, and the cause of failure of PT fault is put forward. The conclusions drawn by the paper can provide reference for the network scale planning, protection formulation, defect Monitoring and analysis of the 20kV neutral point via small resistance grounding system in the future.

articleTitle: Application of X-RAY Digital Imaging Technology in Hardware Quality Test of Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: X-ray spectrum nondestructive testing of electric power fittings is able to provide convenient, quick and accurate detection. The principles of X-ray and detection methods are introduced in this paper. By changing the steel anchor and external aluminum sleeve crimping parts, core wire and anchor pipe or core wire connecting pipe crimping size, external tube and wire or intermediate casing crimping size, X-ray detection technology is used to detect the actual crimping size, and the influence of typical defects on crimping quality of transmission line fittings are analyzed. It is proved that X-ray digital imaging technology is effective in nondestructive testing of the quality of transmission line fittings, and X-ray digital imaging technology can be widely applied in the quality inspection of wire bonding.

articleTitle: Ultra-Short-Term Prediction of Wind Power Based on Chaos Theory and ABC Optimized RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Wind energy has strong randomness and volatility, which makes the prediction accuracy of wind power low. In an attempt to improve the accuracy and robustness of ultra-short term prediction of wind power, a wind power prediction method in ultra-short term combining chaos theory and artificial bee colony(ABC) algorithm to optimize RBF neural network is studied in this paper. Firstly, based on chaos theory, the historical wind power data with the highest correlation is found, which is used for RBF neural network training after phase space reconstruction. Then, the artificial bee colony algorithm is used to solve the optimal RBF neural network parameters through multiple iterations to construct the optimized neural network model. Finally, considering the uncertainty of the prediction model and data noise, the prediction results are interval, and the robustness of the prediction results is evaluated by calculating the confidence of the corresponding interval. The results of the example show that the method proposed in this paper has good accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: A Multi-Agent based Critical Load Restoration Using Islanded Operation of DGs in Radial Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In low-voltage distribution systems, distributed generators (DGs) connected to radial distribution feeders can supply power to critical loads during major disasters. These networks are generally built by using low-inertia DGs that can adapt to changes of operation. Therefore, during disasters, the using of DGs for power restoration is a better choice to provide reliable power for critical loads. Irrespective of the low-inertia advantages of DGs, the disadvantage is that large load steps may cause system instability. Thus, a well-designed control method is necessary to make the system stable. This paper demonstrates a multi-agent system (MAS) based critical loads restoration method and emergency control strategy using the islanded operation of DGs. A modified IEEE 8 nodes distribution feeder system with two synchronous generators is developed in Matlab/Simulink. The simulation results show the effectiveness of the suggested model.

articleTitle: A Dual-Decoupled-Input PWM Three-Port Converter with Sliding Mode Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a partially isolated three-port converter (TPC) consisting of an interleaved BUCK/BOOST converter, an uncontrolled rectifier and a high-frequency transformer is proposed. The proposed TPC can control two photovoltaic (PV) systems independently through two nonisolated input ports to support the DC loads which is connected with the isolated output port. The pulsewidth modulation (PWM) control is employed to realize the decoupled control of two input ports through two duty cycle D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> and D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, respectively. To deal with the uncertainty of the PV systems, the sliding mode control (SMC) based on the maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithm is employed to maximize the efficiency of the PV panels and realizes the fast and smooth transient response for the irradiance and temperature variation. The simulation platform is built to demonstrate the performance of the proposed converter and the designed controller. Finally, the simulation results verify the validity of the converter with the SMC controller.

articleTitle: Method for Detecting Arc Reignition of Circuit Breaker Breaking Process Based on Radiated Electromagnetic Wave
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the deficiencies of the circuit breaker arc reignition detection method, a method based on the electromagnetic wave signal radiated during the breaking process of the circuit breaker is proposed to detect whether it is re-ignited. The detection system used in this method is introduced. The laboratory detection platform of this method is built. The difference of the radiated electromagnetic wave signal during the arc reignition of the circuit breaker is studied, and the arc reignition instant shooting is performed by the high-speed camera. The research results show that the radiated electromagnetic wave is generated at the moment of reignition of the circuit breaker, and the electromagnetic wave is not radiated during the subsequent arc stable combustion process; when the distance between the contacts is short, the arc re-ignites and radiates the electromagnetic wave at the same time each current zero crossing point, and when the distance increases, the arc extinguishes when the current crosses zero and does not reignite.

articleTitle: Comprehensive planning method of new energy considering multi-type and different grid-connected modes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Based on the statistical analysis of the timing characteristics of new energy sources, such as wind power and photovoltaics, the grid-connected positions and installation scale of new energy is optimized synthetically by considering the power types (wind power or photovoltaics) and grid-connected mode (concentration or distribution). The multi-objective optimization model is constructed by considering promoting new energy consumption, minimizing network loss and decreasing purchasing cost of the grid company. The separating process of discrete variables and continuous variables in the proposed optimization model is carried out and the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve model. Taking an area in Hebei Province as an example, the proposed model is simulated. The results show the validity of the model.

articleTitle: A Virtual Inertia Control Strategy to Improve Transient Responses of VSC-HVDC Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The topology of a VSC-HVDC system was similar with that of a synchronous generator (SG), because power controlled converter was analogous to a prime mover and DC voltage controlled converter was analogous to the SG. Importantly, the dynamics of DC-side capacitor were highly similar with that of the rotor. Hence, in this paper, the motion equation used in SG can be applied to VSC-HVDC system to identify the DC-side stability of the system. Moreover, a supplementary power converter was added and paralleled on the inverter station to implement virtual inertia control actions. And it was validated the virtual inertia control behaves as increasing the inertia of DC systems when increasing a virtual capacitance on the original capacitor. Besides, the virtual inertia control was good to the DC-side stability of VSC-HVDC system and enhance damping performance. And it can slow down the response of the system when subjected to a disturbance. And the rate of change of DC voltage was slowed down; the deviation of DC voltage was decreased as well, which was beneficial to improve the DC voltage nadir and keep the stable operation of system. The theoretical analysis was validated by simulations.

articleTitle: Model of Electric Water Heater and Influencing Factors Analysis of Frequency Regulation Response Capability on Demand Side
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A single electric water heater's physical model based on first-order constant coefficient differential equations is constructed in this paper. An electric water heaters' polymerization model is constructed based on the Monte Carlo method, and the error analysis is performed on the polymerization model. The influence of changing conditions on the frequency regulation response of the demand side of electric water heater is analyzed. The simulation results show that the electric water heaters can respond to changes in the frequency of the power system by adjusting their temperature setting point to provide a consider-able amount of frequency backup capacity.

articleTitle: Research on Identification and Processing Method for Abnormal Data of Residential Electric Power Consumption
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper studies the abnormal data generated by technical problems during power data collection. Due to the power consumption behavior of residential power users is greatly affected by some factors such as atmospheric temperature and holidays, the paper presents the criterion of factors affecting electric power consumption, and proposes a method for identifying and processing abnormal data of residential electric power consumption based on a comprehensive study on the above factors on the abnormal data. The identified abnormal data is analyzed by the proposed criterion, and the combination of the mean and interpolation method is used to correct and restore the real effective value in the abnormal data, which greatly preserves the feature of original data. By verifying the one-year electric power consumption data of a community in Henan Province, the results show that the proposed method provides theoretical support for retaining payload data and has prospects for development.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Efficiency Evaluation of Independent Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of society, human's demand for energy sources has been increasing, so the integrated energy system (IES), which can effectively reduce energy consumption and improve energy efficiency has been widely used for that non-renewable fossil energy is running out. As the ocean has been deeply developed and utilized, the independent integrated energy system (IIES), which is closely related to the marine production process such as offshore oil platforms, oceanic islands and large ships has been gradually developed. In order to better plan and schedule the system which is an area far from the coast and needs a variety of energy sources like electric heating, how to reasonably evaluate the IES has become a key issue <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>.Based on the existing evaluation system of large-scale IES, this paper constructs an energy efficiency evaluation system of the IIES, and establishes an energy efficiency evaluation method on the basis of combining the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) with hundred-mark system. Taking an offshore oil platform as an example, the energy efficiency evaluation method of the IIES is calculated and analyzed.

articleTitle: Disturbance Signal Recognition Method of Power System Based on Constrained Fuzzy Clustering
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Traditional methods for identifying disturbance signals in power systems can only solve the single disturbance problem, and can not identify multiple disturbance signals efficiently. To avoid the disadvantages of traditional methods, a method for identifying disturbance signals based on constrained fuzzy clustering is proposed. By calculating the envelope average value of the fitting signal, the difference between the fitting signal and the envelope average value is obtained. The difference is used as a new fitting signal to obtain the minimum eigenvalue component. The signal can be decomposed into several different eigenvalue functions by mode decomposition. The signal after mode decomposition meets the routing information protocol standard. Based on the new sparse vector, the aliasing disturbance signal is extracted. Fourier transform is used to describe the basic change of disturbance signal, and the order derivative of disturbance signal in power system is calculated. The transformation parameters in transmission process are obtained. The spatial coordinate system of acquisition points is obtained. Based on the coordinate system, the optimal window criterion is selected, and the disturbance signals are clustered to the central position by the constrained fuzzy clustering method. By establishing weight coefficient matrix, setting iteration times, and error compensation, new clustering centers are obtained to effectively identify the noise disturbance signals. The experimental results show that the maximum recognition accuracy of this method can reach 98%, which provides support for the normal operation of power system.

articleTitle: A Voltage Equalization Device For Multi-Type Lithium-Ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the 21st century, with the development of renewable energy technologies, electric vehicles have become the focus of research. Inconsistencies between battery cells raise the challenge of managing lithium-ion batteries. In order to shorten the time required for the battery module to be in the early development stage of the laboratory, it is necessary to charge and equalize the module during the test quickly. Based on the LT3741 chip, this paper implements a single-cell charging device for high-current continuous charging, over-charge / over-temperature / over-current protection, SOC estimation of single cells, and uses multiple isolated AC-DCs to supply the power.

articleTitle: Research on Line Protection Configuration Scheme of Hybrid Multi-terminal HVDC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Hybrid multi-terminal HVDC transmission has better engineering application prospects. At present, the research of hybrid multi terminal HVDC line protection mainly focuses on the principle and algorithm, and lacks the systematic research on the protection configuration scheme. In this paper, two simulation models of typical hybrid multi-terminal HVDC transmission topology are built, and the fault characteristics of two kinds of hybrid multi-terminal HVDC transmission lines are analyzed. Based on this, the protection configuration schemes for DC lines under two topologies are proposed, respectively. At the same time, the coordination mechanism of protection scheme, DC circuit breaker action and converter control strategy is discussed, in which topology 1 is the main research object. It has certain engineering application value.

articleTitle: The Harmonic Characteristics of Output Voltages Based on NLM for MMC
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The performances of modular multilevel converter (MMC) are impacted by the modulation scheme greatly. The modulation scheme is significant to analyze the harmonic characteristics based on nearest level modulation (NLM). According to typical level-shift PWM (LS-PWM), a scheme based on hybrid frequency carrier modulation is presented to analyze harmonic distribution of NLM in this paper. Then, considering harmonics from the DC side in practical engineering, the harmonic characteristics of the output voltages on the AC side are analyzed based on the method of Fourier series. Harmonic distribution characteristics of AC output voltages based on NLM and the influence of harmonics from DC side on it are obtained. It is verified to be correct through comparing the results of simulation theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: A primary side controlled single-stage flyback LED driver with high PF
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a high power factor AC-DC LED driver circuit, which uses flyback topology and primary side feedback structure. The power factor correction circuit adopts the fixed on-time control mode and the structure design is simple. The system circuit operates in critical conduction mode (CRM), which reduces switching losses and is suitable for low power applications. To verify the feasibility and performance of the proposed circuit, a controller has been designed and fabricated in 0.5μm 5V/40V HVCMOS process. Experimental results show that, in the AC input range of 85V/60Hz~265V/60Hz, the power factor is greater than 95% and the efficiency is greater than 84.9% under full load which meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Comprehensive quantitative evaluation of effect of lightning protection project based on risk governance and prospect of the application context
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Prevention of the potential risks to power grid operation is an important way to protect the security and improve the equipment operation level. Scientific quantitative evaluation of the effect of lightning protection investment is a foundation to optimization of investment decision, enhance investment efficiency and effects, and to promote investment accuracy. Therefore, this paper presents a comprehensive quantitative evaluation of investment effects. First, by analyzing the mechanism of risk prevention of different lightning protection measures, a comprehensive effect quantitative evaluation index system is established which contains various effects and reflects the characteristics of risk prevention. Secondly, the paper realizes the quantitative evaluation, constructs the investment effects quantitative evaluation model, and normalized coefficient for the first time. Finally, apply quantitative evaluation model to evaluate actual investment effects and discuss the practical application contexts.

articleTitle: Full-field Simulation of ±800kV Valve Hall in Flexible DC System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The limitation of corona inception field strength is a key issue in the design of flexible DC system. In this paper, a full-field simulation of converter valve hall based on Udongde ±800kV Flexible HVDC Project is present. Two major methods are employed to reduce computational complexity. One is the application of component decomposition method based on superposition principle instead of traditional method, and the other is the reasonable simplification when building simulation model. Analysis of simulation results shows that the maximum electric field strength at the given valve hall design is within the electric field limit, which meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Current Harmonic Suppression Technology for Dual Three-Phase Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Through the Vector Space Decomposition (VSD) method, the currents of the dual three-phase PMSM can be decomposed into the α-β component that produces the flux and torque, the z1-z2 component that produces the loss, and the zero sequence component. Controlling α-β current is essential for torque regulation, while controlling z1-z2 current is equally important for suppressing current harmonics generated by nonlinear factors. In this paper, the causes of circulating current in two sets of three-phase windings of dual three-phase PMSM are described in physical sense, and the harmonic current suppression technology for harmonic currents caused by motor nonlinear factors is further proposed. It can be seen by simulation and experimental results that the current suppression technology can reduce the harmonic currents in z1-z2 subspace well and improve motor operating conditions.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Electricity Information Monitoring And Load Forecasting System Based on ADE7758
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Based on the Labview and Matlab software development platform, the intrusive power load monitoring system was developed using the ADE7758 chip. This versatile compliance detection system analyzes power quality and load forecasting in real time, monitoring the health and operational performance of the equipment. Compared with traditional instruments, it has the advantages of short development cycle, strong reusability, and powerful analysis and calculation.

articleTitle: The Engineering Design of SiC Hybrid Switch Series
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: SiC MOSFET and Si IGBT based hybrid switches (HyS) has low conduction loss and low switching loss. At the same time, HyS device costs are much less than pure SiC MOSFET device with the same power rating. The promising performance of HyS can help to design a high power design converter system with over 30 kHz and 50 kW applications. In this paper, a series of SiC/Si HyS modules are designed, and some of them were developed and tested.

articleTitle: A Risk Evaluation Method to Voltage Sag Considering the Process Immunity Time of Industry Consumer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The impact of voltage sags on industry consumer has attracted more and more attention. Therefore, it is important to propose a risk assessment method of voltage sag for users. Due to the fuzziness of industrial users' response to sag events, most of the existing studies adopt the method of measuring the economic loss of voltage sag based on equipment tolerance. This method does not take into account the user-perceived voltage sag effect and the impact of voltage sag on industrial users in addition to economic losses. Based on the impact of voltage sag on the structure, function, economy and safety of user industry, a risk assessment method of voltage sag based on process immune events is proposed. This method can consider the temporary risk more completely.

articleTitle: A Multi-Objective Programming Modeling of Generation Rights Trading to Support Cross Regional Renewable Consumption
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Generation rights trading is one of the market mechanisms that can promote utilization of renewable energy. This paper proposes a new cross regional generation rights trading model with two objectives: maximization of social welfare and minimization of CO2 emission. Cross regional transmission constraint is modeled in terms of energy approximately by applying the transmission limitation to the historical renewable generation in the sending region. The genetic algorithm (GA) is applied to solve the proposed model. Case study using practical system data is performed to verify the effectiveness of the model. Study results indicate that compared with the single-objective models, the multi-objective model is more instructive to the actual power generation rights trading.

articleTitle: Research on Conformance of Integrated Demand Response Communication Based on OpenADR
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper first introduces the basic concepts of communication protocol conformance testing, analyzes and summarizes the content of communication protocol consistency test, the principle of communication protocol consistency test, the process of communication protocol consistency test and the method of communication protocol consistency test. Based on the above research, , design a conformance test model combined with the characteristics of OpenADR communication protocol to ensure interoperability between different interactive entities, improve the efficiency of implementation of interconnection services, ensure the normal development of demand-side systems and equipment interconnection, reduces the cost of power demand side management, and contributes to the development of demand-responsive communication protocols.

articleTitle: Dynamic Reconfiguration of Distribution Network Based on Symbolization of Time Series of Load
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of dynamic reconfiguration of distribution network connected with distributed generation (DG) and electric vehicle (EV), a dynamic reconfiguration method of distribution network based on time series symbolized segmentation is proposed. Firstly, the daily load curve of the distribution network accessed to distributed energy and electric vehicles is predicted. The time series of load is symbolized and the segmentation effect is evaluated by information entropy to determine the time division scheme. Then the model is established with the minimum daily operating loss cost as the objective function, and the distribution network is dynamically reconfigured according to the time division. The particle swarm optimization algorithm (PSO) based on branch group search is proposed to solve the model. Finally, the simulation calculation is carried out by using the IEEE33 node system as an example. The results show that the proposed method can reasonably divide the load time series, so that the daily operating loss cost of the distribution network after dynamic reconfiguration is reduced.

articleTitle: Gas Decomposition Products Produced by Breaking Short Circuit Current of Circuit Breaker with Different Ablation Degree
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Circuit breaker when breaking short circuit current will have a lot of gas decomposition products. These decomposition products may be associated with the degree of ablation of the circuit breaker contact. In order to verify the above point of view, in a new circuit breaker on a number of short-circuit current breaks until the circuit breaker cannot break short-circuit current. About 17 hours after each break, the measurement of gas decomposition products in the circuit breaker is carried out. The measured gas decomposition products include CO, SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. Measurements show that most of the gas decomposition products have been absorbed, and only a small amount of SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is present. Different with contact ablation, SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> content is not too much different. This shows that it is not possible to assess the degree of ablation of the arc contacts of the circuit breaker using the method of gas decomposition product measurement.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Ablation Degree of Circuit Breaker Contact Based on Breaking Radiation Electromagnetic Wave Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The degree of ablation of the contact of the circuit breaker is one of the important representations of the life of the circuit breaker. The existing method cannot detect and evaluate on line. The experiments in the laboratory show that the electromagnetic waves radiated during the breaking process of the circuit breaker are related to the ablation degree of the contact. In order to further clarify this association and lay the foundation for the assessment of the ablation degree of the circuit breaker contacts based on the radiation electromagnetic wave detection during the breaking process, breaking tests were carried out on a new circuit breaker until the end of the circuit breaker life which it cannot break short-circuit current, its radiation electromagnetic wave signals were measured. The results show that the number and amplitude of the radiated electromagnetic wave signal are changed with the increase of the number of interrupts. Based this change, it is possible to evaluate the ablation degree of the breaker contact based on the radiation electromagnetic wave detection.

articleTitle: Optimal Cooperative Scheduling in Multi-energy Micro-grid Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The paper presents a study of cooperative scheduling for the supply of different energy in a micro-grid. CCHP (Combined Cooling Heating and Power) system is applied in the micro-grid to improve the energy efficiency when satisfying multi-energy needs. Demand response (DR) is adopted to relieve the pressure on power supply. The paper first introduces the concepts of cooperative scheduling as well as demand response and the purpose of doing so. The paper then illustrates the models of units in the micro-grid and applies genetic algorithm to perform the optimization. After that, an example is proposed to verify the feasibility of models and approach. Different case studies are performed to show the contribution of CCHP and DR to the improvement of the energy efficiency and power supply reliability.

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Network Fault Simulation Based on Cyber Physics System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The coupling effect between power system and communication system is becoming more and more complex. While the controllability of distribution network has been strengthened, it also has a stronger dependence on information control system. This paper presents a method of distribution network fault simulation based on cyber physical system (CPS). A terminal CPS fusion model based on finite state machine is constructed. Distribution network fault simulation is carried out under Distributed Denial of Service (DDOS) attack. The feasibility of terminal CPS fusion model based on finite state machine is verified, and the actual distribution network fault handling is realized. The simulation fully simulates the interaction process between physical and information in the actual distribution network fault handling process, verifies the correctness of the method proposed in this paper, and analyzes the impact of communication environment on fault handling.

articleTitle: Impedance Modeling and Stability Analysis of Three-Level Neutral-Point-Clamped Grid-Tied Inverters
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Three-level inverters are adaptively used in renewal energy generation equipment, especially in high and medium power levels. The stability of three-level inverters is worth studying. In this paper, a diode clamped three-level inverter is studied. Based on the influence of DC side neutral point control on its impedance characteristics, the impedance model of neutral-clamped three-level inverters is established. Then, the stability of the inverters under different grid impedance and operating power is analyzed by using Nyquist stability criterion. The simulation results show that the impedance characteristics of three-level inverters can accurately judge the stability of the grid-connected inverters.

articleTitle: Calculation of Parasitic Capacitance of Foil Winding Dry-type Power Transformer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power transformers are critical components in the entire grid and are the bridges that connect different voltage levels. At the same time, harmonic pollution has become an essential factor in grid power pollution. It is a serious issue to curb harmonics into the public network and improve power quality. In the process of harmonic transmission, it is necessary to experience this part of the transformer. Therefore, this subject has established an important high-frequency equivalent circuit of the transformer through the study of the high-frequency parameters of the transformer, which has important practical significance for the filtering of harmonics. In this paper, the parasitic capacitance of the foil winding for low voltage side of the dry-type double-split power transformer model studied using the analytical method. According to the specific structure of the transformer, some of the circuits are adjusted to build a relatively accurate high-frequency equivalent circuit. Finally, the harmonics of the harmonic source AC/DC are analyzed to analyze the harmonic components in the waveform. Based on the previously established model, the impedance characteristics of the circuit in the frequency band of the harmonics explored.

articleTitle: Research on Effective Location of Energy Storage in High-Permeability Photovoltaic Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to new energy, such as photovoltaics, character with intermittent and volatility, when connected to the grid, it seriously affects the voltage fluctuation of the distribution network system. Which brings new challenges to traditional voltage regulation technology. In order to solve these challenges, the energy storage technology is proposed. Firstly, from the positional relationships between the energy storage access points and the research nodes, the factors that cause the node voltage changes are studied. According to the voltage change difference caused by different energy storage access locations, the priority siting areas of energy storage are deduced. Then, the heuristic optimization method is used to find out the minimum power value of energy storage. This power value is the minimum value of energy storage to make each node's voltage within a safety domain when voltage distorts for the grid-connected photovoltaic. Afterwards, the effective location areas for energy storage are found by comparing the minimum power value in different situations. Finally, the correctness of the conclusion is verified by the IEEE33 node system. The simulation results show that the closer the energy storage location is to the end of the line, the more obvious improvement effects of system voltage will be, as well as the smaller energy storage capacity.

articleTitle: The Model of Photovoltaic Power Short-Term Prediction Based on Dynamic Time Warping Algorithm of Partial Least Squares
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Dynamic Time Warping(DTW) algorithm has strong resistance to synchronous error. Aiming at the similarity and asynchrony of meteorological factor, a method of applying DTW to photovoltaic power prediction is proposed. The meteorological factors which have great influence on photovoltaic power generation are selected by Pearson correlation coefficient method. Based on the DTW algorithm, the similarity of meteorological factors between the predicting days and the historical days can be measured. Through weighted calculation of similarity, the similar days are used to obtain training data of Partial Least Squares(PLS) prediction model. The simulation study on a photovoltaic power station verifies the correctness and effective of the proposed prediction method. The results show that the prediction model has great forecasting accuracy and certain feasibility and practicability.

articleTitle: Study on Mesh Adaptive Direct Search Algorithm for Distribution Network Reconfiguration with Distribution Generators
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Firstly, based on the distribution network connection model provided by IEC 61970-301 CIM, the mapping rules have been established, and the equivalent reconfiguration topology of the actual distribution network has been obtained, which omits the unnecessary switches to decrease the coding dimension. Secondly, aiming at the distribution network reconfiguration with distribution generators (DG), the multi-objective model, including power loss reduction, voltage deviation, and DG consumption, has been established; and the mesh adaptive direct search (MADS) algorithm has been applied, which has been improved by forming the self-adaptive updating mechanism for mesh size parameter. Finally, the algorithm has been programmed in Visual Studio 2015 with C++ tool. And combined with IEEE 33-bus distribution network, the improved method has been verified the feasibility and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Current Measurement of Rogowski Coil in a Cryogenic Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The Rogowski coil current sensor consists of a Rogowski coil and an integrator. The coil output voltage is proportional to the derivative of the primary current, and the integrator converts the differential into a normal state. Its advantages of good linearity and light weight are gaining more and more attention in the current sampling of smart grids and new electrical equipment, but Rogowski coils have different requirements in different application scenarios. In order to meet the practical needs of current measurement of parallel superconducting units in high temperature superconducting devices, a Rogowski coil can be designed and fabricated from use for cryogenic environments. The Rogowski coil bobbin is made of Fiber Reinforced Plastic (FRP), which has a small deformation in a cryogenic environment and can ensure the accuracy of current measurement. The experimental results show that the linearity of the Rogowski coil is well, and the linear scale factor of the normal temperature environment and the cryogenic environment is well, which can be used to measure the current of the superconducting parallel unit.

articleTitle: Optimization of Operation Strategy of Virtual Power Plants Involved in Peak Shaving
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, as the consumption rate of renewable energy has increased, the impact of renewable energy on the power grid has also increased. Currently, distribution network system operators and transmission line system operators are unable to acquire and control the operational status of renewable energy sources such as wind power photovoltaics. These phenomena pose a significant challenge to the safety and stability of the operation of the power system.
