The virtual power plant is a feasible solution, based on the data acquisition terminal of advanced communication technology, decentralized control or centralized control of DER. Based on the virtual power plant, this paper aggregates three types of resources, wind power, photovoltaic, and electric vehicles, which are typical on the supply side and the demand side. Then, the virtual power plant is regarded as a whole to accept the dispatching instructions of the power grid, formulate the operational strategy of the internal resources of the virtual power plant, and participate in the peaking service.

articleTitle: Coordinated central and local voltage control in low voltage distribution network with photovoltaic generation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High proportion of integrated photovoltaic (PV) in the low-voltage distribution network (LVDN) can lead to overvoltage problem because of the reverse power flow, which is harmful to electrical devices and PV units. Using PV’s own reactive power absorption capacity becomes a mainstream solution since it doesn’t need extra investment. In this paper, a coordinated central and local voltage control method based on reactive power control of PV inverter is proposed, which combines the characteristics of quick response and optimization. The result of case study shows that the proposed method can mitigate overvoltage problem effectively either in clear day or cloud day, meanwhile, unnecessary reactive power absorption is avoided.

articleTitle: Comparison of Performances between Angle Droop Control and Frequency Droop Control in Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Compared with frequency droop control, angle droop control avoids frequency deviation, but it is hard to share active power exactly among distributed generations (DGs). Although this defect can be solved by secondary control, frequency droop control also has a similar way to eliminate frequency deviation. In this paper, several typical operating conditions are designed to test the control effects of these two control methods, and the following conclusions are drawn: using angle droop control is able to make the frequency more stable and take shorter time to enter the steady state than frequency droop control. Finally, the conclusion is validated by analyzing the simulation results.

articleTitle: Analytical Calculation of Leakage Reactance in High-Frequency Transformers Considering Frequency-Dependent and Winding-Structure Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Leakage reactance is determined by leakage inductance and frequency. The leakage inductance of the high- frequency transformer is greatly affected by the high-frequency eddy current effect of windings and structure of winding. However, there are no effective calculation and adjustment methods considering the frequency-dependent and winding- structure characteristics of leakage inductance. Based on the flux linkage method, a leakage reactance calculation method for transformers with arbitrary winding structures was proposed, considering the high frequency effect of winding. After analyzing the magnetic field intensity distribution in different winding configurations, a control method for reducing leakage reactance by interleaved windings was proposed. Based on the magnetic circuit method, this paper studied the influence of the magnetic guide plate on the leakage inductance, and proposed a method to increase the leakage reactance by inserting the magnetic guide plate. These methods were validated by 3D finite-element analysis simulation, as well as by measurements.

articleTitle: The Study on the Application of Energy Storage Technique in Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: According to the pressing demands of large-scale energy storage construction, the researches on application of energy storage system in China is summarized in this paper. First of all, the application requirements of the energy storage system are analyzed in the region of power generation, power transmission and power distribution. The operation modes and the regulation tasks of energy storage system in each region are proposed. Secondly, the energy storage projects in China are summarized and classified. The application region, construction scale and operation mode in each energy storage project are discussed. The researches in this paper can provide new ideas for the construction and application of energy storage system on the fields of power grid operation stability enhancement, power supply reliability promotion and renewable energy consumption advancement.

articleTitle: Modeling on Impulse Voltage Distribution and Experimental Study of Reverse Series-Connected Solenoids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increase of the grid voltage rating, the superconducting fault current limiter operates at a higher voltage and bears various overvoltages under the fault. The insulation of the limiter plays an important role in maintenance of the safe operation. The study about the wave process of superconducting fault current limiter under lightning impulse can provide a basis for the design of longitudinal insulation of the limiter. This paper presents a distributed model and a distribution-lump-type model of the reverse series-connected solenoid resistive type DC superconducting current limiter under lightning impulse. The wave process of the limiter is solved by using the finite element software and MATLAB. A test model was made for experimental verification, and the results had a good numerical agreement with the simulation results.

articleTitle: An Improved Droop Control Method for Accurate Power Sharing and Bus Voltage Restoration in DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Generally, the droop control is used to realize the sharing of load power in DC microgrid. Considering the influence of line resistance on sharing accuracy and the problem of the drop of the DC bus voltage, in this paper, an accurate power sharing method and a voltage restoration method based on information sharing are proposed. By defining the "unit current" of the distributed generators (DGs), the reference voltage compensation of each DG is deduced, so that the accurate power sharing is achieved. Based on this, a feasible method is proposed to transform the above voltage compensation into the droop coefficient compensation. In addition, a distributed DC bus voltage restoration method is proposed, which does not need to add centralized PI controller. Finally, the simulation results of MATLAB/Simulink verify the effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Study on the new characteristics and prevention measures of cascading failure under the condition of clean energy grid-connected
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of large-scaled clean energy grid-connection capacity and the increasing number of HVDC transmission projects, a large number of power electronic equipments have been connected to the power system, resulting in cascading failure modes and new characteristics of the evolution process. Based on this background, this thesis firstly analyzes the influencing factors of cascading faults in transmission network of different forms. Secondly, the construction method and flow chart of cascading failure situation are proposed. The cascading failure situations of two different typical systems of local energy consumption and outgoing energy supply are analyzed by simulation. Thirdly summarize the new characteristics of cascading failures in different power grid forms, and put forward corresponding preventive and control measures to improve the high voltage ride-through capability and frequency ride-through capability of wind turbine generators in order to reduce the probability of cascading failures in power grid.

articleTitle: Distribution network planning considering offshore wind-tide-virtual energy storage system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A virtual energy storage system (VESS) is proposed in this paper based on the virtual power plant (VPP) concept to integrate, regulate, coordinate, and optimize all manner of distributed energy storage facilities. In order to make full use of all kinds of marine energy, reduce the fluctuation of power output, and reduce the power-free time of single energy generation, a combined output model of offshore wind-tide-virtual energy storage system is constructed. The effectiveness of the model is proven by simulation analysis. The influence of the offshore wind-tide-virtual energy storage system on the distribution network structure is preliminarily investigated. The results presented here may demonstrate the advantages of the combined output model and improvements to energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Applicability Analysis of Probabilistic Power Flow Calculation Method in AC/DC Hybrid Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: VSC-HVDC transmission promotes grid-connection with renewable energy and long-distance consumption, which makes power system become main AC/DC hybrid grid structure. Power flow calculation is of critical importance in power system research. With renewable energy integrated into grid, randomness, fluctuation, and intermittency of renewable energy bring challenges to planning of AC/DC hybrid grid. The traditional power flow calculation method does not consider these uncertainty factors in the power grid, while the probabilistic power flow considers them. So, the probabilistic power flow is more suitable for the actual operation state of grid. In this paper, traditional Monte Carlo Simulation (MCS) and Latin hypercube sampling based MCS (LHS) are applied to the AC/DC hybrid grid. Then, their applicability is compared and analyzed. Finally, an AC/DC hybrid system consisting of two IEEE RTS-96 systems, a 3-terminal DC network, and a 4-terminal DC network is used to verify the applicability of MCS and LHS in AC/DC hybrid grid.

articleTitle: Static and Dynamic Performance Research of Superconducting Fault Current Limiting Cable Used in DC Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High temperature superconducting fault current limiting (HTS-FCL) cable utilizes zero resistance characteristics of YBCO superconductor to transmit electricity, and takes advantage of high resistance peculiarity of YBCO superconductor when superconductor at flux-flow or normal states to limit fault current. DC distribution network has the superiorities of high transmission capacity, long power supply distance and flexibility, etc. But it faces so much difficulty in breaking fast when it fails. DC HTS-FCL cables are expected to be used in flexible DC distribution network in the future because of its special characteristics. This paper provides a method of DC HTS-FCL cable integrating to DC distribution network, and establishes circuit and simulation models of HTS-FCL cable. Then the static and dynamic performance of conventional and HTS-FCL cable in flexible DC distribution network are compared by simulation through MATLAB, especially the fault current limiting performance of HTS-FCL cable is studied. Finally, one YBCO tape which could be used in HTS-FCL cable is studied and a 500A@77K model HTS-FCL cable is fabricated, tested and analyzed.

Author Keywords: high temperature superconducting fault current limiting (HTS-FCL) cable

articleTitle: Distribution of Meteorological Elements related to Conductor Icing at Southwest of China
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Air temperature, precipitation, humidity, and wind speed are related to the severity of conductor icing. In this paper, the distribution map of minimum air temperature, maximum precipitation, maximum humidity, and maximum wind speed in winter have been developed at southwest of China, with the aim of understanding the conductor icing characteristics. Due to the fact that the observed meteorological elements at southwest of China are limited, we utilize the re-analysis data generated by European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts. By utilizing the Gumbel I extreme value distribution model, we calculated extreme values of meteorological elements in a specific recurrence period, which are 30a, 50a, and 100a. The analysis of the minimum temperature, maximum precipitation, maximum humidity and maximum wind speed in winter under a specific recurrence period shows that OHLs at Tibet and Western Sichuan may suffers from icing issues. As a result, we should pay attention to the conductor icing at related area to operate OHLs more safety.

articleTitle: Study on the Correction Method of Thermal Resistance of IGBT Module in Accelerated Aging Test Considering Influence of Glue of Thermocouple
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power cycling accelerated aging experiment is an important way to study the evolution process and failure mechanism of insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) power modules under high power load impact. In the accelerated aging experiment, the thermal resistance as a sign of the fatigue fault of the IGBT module solder layer needs to be extracted online in real time, so as to achieve real-time monitoring of the aging degree of the aging process of the IGBT module. Measuring the case temperature with a thermocouple is an important step in the process of extracting the thermal resistance in each power cycle. However, the thermocouple is glued to the IGBT module, and the glue will fall off due to the constant impact and circulation of the temperature during the accelerated aging of the IGBT module. In this paper, in order to avoid the measuring error caused by thermocouple glue in the process of accelerated aging experiment, the correction method in the process of extracting IGBT module thermal resistance is proposed. In this paper, the influence of glue on the thermal resistance extraction is illustrated by finite element simulation and experiment, and the correction method is verified by the stability data in the experiment.

articleTitle: Virtual Synchronous Generator Control Strategy Based on Improved Inner Loop Applied to Power Storage Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The power storage converter(PSC) using the virtual synchronous generator(VSG) control strategy has the dual droop characteristics of active-frequency, reactiveamplitude. The VSG control strategy of the improved inner loop proposed in this paper can make the grid-connected energy storage converter adopting the control strategy have fast power response characteristics. The power level caused by the frequency step, the amplitude step or the instruction order is completed within 20ms. The voltage loop of the improved inner loop adopts the control mode of dq decoupling, and the current loop adopts the control method of deadbeat. This paper will theoretically derive the control strategy and verify the effectiveness of the control strategy through PSCAD simulation.

articleTitle: Bi-Level Method of Islanded Microgrid Optimal Sizing Based on Life Cycle Cost
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To solve the problem of optimal allocation of islanded microgrid, a bi-level method based optimal sizing model is proposed in this paper. The optimal sizing model in upper level gives the optimal configuration strategy. The upper level optimization aiming at the annual investment cost during the life cycle is solved by the improved decimal genetic algorithm. Daily operation cost minimization and renewable energy utilization rate maximization of the microgrid is conducted in lower level based on the optimal dispatch model, which can be solved through a mixed integer linear programming method. Considering the operation constraints of microgrid, the proposed algorithm is applied to an islanded microgrid in Nanchang, Jiangxi province, showing the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed optimal configuration strategy. Meanwhile, the impacts on the optimal configuration strategy brought by the energy storage system is also analyzed.

articleTitle: Analysis of operation characteristics of adjustable-speed pumped storage hydropower unit with AC excitation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The safe and stable operation of the continuing developed power grid can be guaranteed depending largely on the adjustable speed pumped storage hydropower unit (AS-PSH) for its highly efficient peak-frequency modulation ability. In this paper, the design and control strategies of the AS-PSH with AC excitation are proposed. For the evaluation of flexibility and storage capacity, the operation characteristics of the AS-PSH unit are determined through establishing corresponding mathematical models and RTDS simulation tests. The stable operation range and the response speed characteristics of AS-PSH in term of active/reactive power regulation under different working conditions are studied. Results show that the AS-PSH with AC excitation possesses great leading phase capacity and the established de-coupling control system using both AC excitation and governor achieves high response speed. The present study could provide a reliable control basis for the realization of the smooth integration of the intermittent renewable energy sources into the grid.

articleTitle: Medium-to-long Term Electricity Consumption Forecasting Using Deep Hybrid Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a deep hybrid neural network method to predict the regional electricity consumption in the future. The electricity consumption forecasting problem is usually modelled as the time-series problem using the recurrent neural network. Considering the advantage of convolutional neural network on the feature extraction, it is potential to enhance the performance of long short-term memory neural network on improving the training accuracy. It is the regional electricity consumption that is correlated to its economic growth. To address such implicated issue, the proposed approach combines the convolutional and recurrent neural networks to investigate the impact of gross domestic product on the electricity consumption. Furthermore, it is based on the relationship between the electricity consumption and gross domestic product to establish the forecasting model. The available data mainly includes the annual energy consumption data and gross domestic product from the different social industries. The numerical results imply that the deep hybrid neural network model generally correspond to lower relative error when compared with the autoregressive integrated moving average model, and solves the problem of overabundance training database in deep neural work.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Internal Short Circuit for Lithium Ion Battery Pack Under Varying Temperature
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A model based internal short circuit fault diagnosis method for a series-connected battery pack under varying temperature is proposed in this paper. Systematic experiments are conducted to study the relationship between battery capacity, internal resistance and temperature. Internal short circuit fault can be diagnosed based on the decay of dischargeable capacity. To reduce the computational complexity of estimating state of charge (SOC) and diagnosing faults online, a dual time-scale approach is proposed to select standard cell and updating cell. Based on the approach, unscented kalman filter and extended kalman filter are utilized to estimate battery pack SOC. With the accurate SOC, recursive least squares algorithm is utilized to quantitatively diagnose the fault. Finally, dynamic stress test on a series-connected battery pack is conducted to evaluate the proposed method. The results indicate that the method can accurately diagnose the fault in a reasonable time.

articleTitle: Study of Control for Grid Connected Transformerless Photovoltaic System with Improved Modulation Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper discusses the modulation method to suppress the ground current for the single-phase grid-connected photovoltaic inverters. Hybrid modulation (HPWM) is a commonly modulation method for the single-phase inverters. But its application in the non-isolated photovoltaic grid-connected inverters will lead to large ground current. This paper establishes the common-mode model for the parallel single-phase gridconnected inverters with a front-end DC-DC boost converter. The expression of the ground current is given. An improved hybrid modulation method is proposed. The influence of the modulation mode and the circuit parameters on the inter-phase circulating current is also analyzed. The MPPT control algorithm is selected and the control loop for the system is designed based on PI control and repetitive control. The simulation results are given to verify the design based on Matlab\Simulink.

articleTitle: Energy Management Strategy Based on Adaptive Wavelet Analysis for HESS
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Adaptive wavelet analysis strategy is proposed for energy management in this paper. With the help of wavelet analysis, the power demand is decoupled to high frequency and low frequency components by the wavelet decomposition, which are respectively undertaken by ultracapacitors and power lithium ion batteries. According to the power demand and the state of charge of the ultracapacitors, the fuzzy control is used to adjust the wavelet decomposition layer in real time, so that the ultracapacitors have greater absorption redundancy and release energy redundancy. For verifying the effectiveness of proposed method, we conducted the control strategy simulation experiment through Matlab/Simulink Urban Dynamometer Driving Schedule. The results show that the adaptive wavelet analysis can decompose the demand power in real time, and the strategy can keep the state of charge of ultracapacitors being in the range of 0.5 to 0.9. In addition, compared with the conversional method of wavelet decomposition, the proposed method reduces the energy loss by 10.66% at least.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of Customer-side Energy Storage Considering Multiple Profit Models
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: There are many scenarios and profit models for the application of energy storage on the customer side. With the maturity of energy storage technology and the decreasing cost, whether the energy storage on the customer side can achieve profit has become a concern. This paper puts forward an economic analysis method of energy storage which is suitable for peak-valley arbitrage, demand response, demand charge and other profit sources. This method comprehensively considers such factors as energy storage capacity attenuation, capacity income, tax deduction and exemption. On this basis, the economy of customer-side energy storage in typical provinces of China is calculated, and the impact on power grid enterprises is analyzed. Finally, the relevant suggestions are put forward.

articleTitle: Abnormal Time Synchronization Detection of Substation IED based on Frequency Deviation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The occurrence of abnormal time synchronization in smart substation will cause the clock pulse deviation of secondary system to normal time synchronization, affecting the normal operation of secondary equipment, especially relay protection devices. But there is still lack of efficient algorithms for detecting abnormal time synchronization. To improve the accuracy and speed of abnormal time synchronization detection, at first, the signal frequency is calculated by matrix-pencil filter quickly and accurately and frequency deviation is obtained by subtracting the actual value of signal frequency. Then the relationship between the clock pulse intervals of the substation, the sampling interval and the signal frequency are studied and the calculation formula of the time synchronization deviation is derived. On this basis, a substation abnormal time synchronization detection algorithm based on frequency deviation is proposed. When the deviation is larger than the set threshold value, the abnormal time synchronization can be accurately detected and the time synchronization deviation will be calculated, which can provide necessary information for the calibration of the secondary device and locking of relay protection. It is verified by simulation that this algorithm can accurately detect abnormal time synchronization in a time window of 1ms in case of time synchronization deviation is larger than. It has high detection accuracy and precision, and can meet the requirements of relay protection for high precision of time synchronization.

articleTitle: Design of Distributed Task Scheduling in East China Power Market Trading System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the advancement of power reform, the scale of inter-provincial power trading in the East China region has been increasing, the scale of transactions has been expanding. More and more parameters are being considered, and the calculation processing logic is more and more complicated. In order to cope with the situation that the market rules change too fast and the complexity is too high, the East China Power Trading System will introduce a distributed technology architecture based on cloud computing and microservices. However, this process from the single-element architecture to the distributed architecture puts higher demands on the multi-task scheduling processing mechanism of the system. Based on the analysis of East China Power Market Trading Business and East China Power Market Trading System, this paper proposes a task scheduling solution based on distributed control strategy with reference to the solution ideas of the Internet industry. It solves the scheduling problem of mutual exclusion tasks by using the improved Leader election method and effectively avoids the brain crack problem of the Leader election. Based on this distributed task processing strategy, this paper further elaborates the corresponding engineering solutions. It includes the specific implementation contents of task management interface, task scheduling center, task scheduling client and abnormal monitoring function in East China Power Market Trading System, so as to facilitate the practical application of system design and development personnel in system construction. In addition, the program also proved the feasibility of the program through stress testing and application practice.

articleTitle: Research on Combined Optimal Dispatch Model of Nuclear-Thermal-Energy Storage with Nuclear Power Participating in Equivalent Peak Load Regulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing peak-valley difference of power grid and the increasing proportion of nuclear power supply structure, it is imperative for nuclear power to participate in Peak load regulation of power system. This article proposes a combined optimal dispatch model of nuclear-thermal-energy storage with nuclear power participating in equivalent peak load regulation. By the energy transfer capacity of heat storage device, the amount of the nuclear power participating in the peak load regulation is consumed, and the output of other units is optimized. Therefore, the equivalent peak shaving of the nuclear power unit is realized under the full power output. Examples show that the model can achieve the equivalent peak load regulation of nuclear power can save the cost of power generation, and the pollution gas emissions are reduced, so it ensures the economy and security of power grid operation.

articleTitle: Harmonic Current Compensation of PMSM Based on Disturbance Observer and Robustness Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the influences of rotor flux harmonics and nonlinear characteristics of the inverter, high-order harmonic components are contained in the stator current, which results the torque ripples. This disadvantage limits the application of proportional integral controller in synchronous coordinate system in high performance drive system. To solve the problem, firstly, this paper models and analyzes the disturbance in PMSM. The results show that the performance of the motor is mainly affected by the periodic high-order harmonic current. Secondly, a disturbance observer based on band pass filter is designed to estimate the periodic disturbance in the system, and the harmonic current is compensated by internal feedback. Then, design principle of the observer parameter is given. Finally, the simulation model is built. The results verify the correctness, effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Trading Mechanism and Safety Checking Mechanism of Trans-provincial Peak-Shaving Auxiliary Service
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: There are differences in resource distribution and power consumption among provinces in the regional power grid. To carry out trans-provincial peak-shaving auxiliary service market transactions can realize the cross-provincial mutual benefit of peak-shaving resources, thereby enhancing the capacity of regional power grid to absorb renewable energy. Based on the above concepts, aiming at the problem of insufficient peak-shaving resources in the provincial power grids, this paper puts forward the trading mechanism and security checking mechanism of trans-provincial peak-shaving auxiliary service. A market clearing pricing model for peak-shaving auxiliary service in low-load periods is constructed to motivate relevant units to provide peak-shaving auxiliary service with clear price signals. A simplified model of a regional power grid is simulated and analyzed. The results show that the trading mechanism and safety checking mechanism proposed in this paper are feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Research on Ripple Resonance of DC Distribution Network Based on Modal Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Ripple resonance can cause unstable operation of DC distribution network, which is the potential cause of voltage collapse. Using frequency domain analysis to determine the resonant frequency of a DC distribution network requires the establishment of complex high-order transfer functions. In this paper, a modal analysis method for parallel resonance of DC distribution network is proposed. By constructing the Norton equivalent circuit model of key components such as PWM rectifier, PWM inverter and bidirectional DC-DC converter, the equivalent circuit model of DC distribution network is established. Based on the equivalent circuit model, the node impedance matrix of the DC distribution network is formed. The resonance characteristics of the entire DC distribution network are obtained by analyzing the frequency characteristics of each element in the node impedance matrix. The proposed analysis method is verified by MATLAB/Simulink platform.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method for Insulation Degradation Based on Furfural Content in 35kVField Transformer Oil
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Currently, the evaluation methods of fiber insulation degradation state of power transformer are mostly based on accelerated thermal aging test in laboratory, and this paper is based on the evaluation of furfural content in 35kV field transformer oil. First, samples of the field transformer insulating oil are collected. Then, the insulating oil sample is subjected to an extraction experiment, and the furfural in the insulating oil is extracted by methanol solution. Next, the furfural standard solution is prepared, the methanol extract of the insulating oil and the standard solution are centrifuged and oscillated respectively. After filtration, it is placed in a high-performance liquid chromatograph (HPLC) for injection and measurement. Finally, the furfural content in the insulating oil is obtained. A quantitative equation between furfural and DP is used to evaluate the degree of polymerization (DP) of transformer insulation paper. Combined the field operation with maintenance data, the aging condition of the insulating paper is comprehensively evaluated, and the experimental evaluation results are verified, which provides a reliable reference for the safety operation of field transformers.

articleTitle: A Control Strategy of Hybrid Reactive Compensator with Reactive Power Pre-specified
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: On the basis of hybrid reactive power compensation system, this paper presents a method to obtain the number of capacitor banks of Thyristor Switch Capacitor (TSC) and output instructions of the Static Var Generator (SVG) according to pre-specified reactive power output of SVG when TSC reaches steady state. It avoids the over current phenomenon caused by the full compensation of SVG in hybrid compensation system. The entire control system includes the master computer system and salver computer system. The constant reactive power mode or the constant power factor mode can be selected on the master computer of the system. The number of capacitor banks of TSC and output instructions of SVG can be calculate on the master computer and its command value is transferred to the slaver computer to realize the control of the whole system. The feasibility of the compensation algorithm is verified by simulation. The validity of the structure of the system is verified by experiments and its result show the validity of both the algorithm and the control system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Power Characteristics of the Offshore Floating Wind Turbine Based on the Tension Leg Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The fluctuation of wind power will affect the grid frequency stability. The motion of the offshore floating wind turbine (OFWT) will increase the power volatility of it. It is necessary to study the output power characteristics for OFWT. Firstly, this paper analyzes the motion response of an OFWT. Then, the influence of the floating foundation motion response is equivalent to the change of wind catching ability by formula derivation. Finally, compared with the output power of fixed offshore wind turbine, the output characteristics of the OFWT are obtained. The conclusion shows that the pitch, yaw and surge motion of OFWT have an important impact on the output power fluctuation of the wind turbine.

articleTitle: The New Methods for Calculating Voltage Sag Energy in Three-phase System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Voltage sag energy is an interesting single-event characteristic of voltage sag, to show the performance of sensitive equipment under voltage sag. According to the definition of voltage sag energy index, which proposed in IEEE Std. 1564-2014, the standard calculation method of voltage sag energy has not been available. This paper proposes six voltage sag energy calculation methods, with and without consideration of the two transition segments. It is considered three situations of calculation step size, including the sag duration, half-cycle step size and sampling point step size, which called full-process method, half-cycle method and sampling point method, respectively. The six methods are verified by 189 sets of measured voltage sag. The case studies verify the accuracy of the proposed methods, one of the methods is recommended as standard method.

articleTitle: Multi-Phase Interleaved Bidirectional DC/DC Converter with Two-Winding Coupled Inductors
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The interleaved and magnetically integrated bidirectional DC/DC converters are widely used in more and more applications. Currently in these converters, most of the phase inductors are normally integrated to one single-core coupled inductor. With the number of phases increasing, however, this may suffer several problems, such as asymmetry of magnetic components, difficulties of designing suitable multi-phase magnetic core, large DC flux and so on. To solve these issues, a multi-phase interleaved bidirectional DC/DC converter (IBDC) with two-winding coupled inductors (TCIs) is proposed and analyzed. A four-phase IBDC is taken as an example in this paper, where four TCIs are used to replace the single-core coupled inductor. The steady-state and transient-state performances of the proposed converter are studied in detail. The parameter design criteria of TCIs is also given. Finally, the superiority and practicability of the proposed converter are verified by the prototype experiments.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Benefit Analysis of Energy Saving and Loss Reduction for Flexible Substation Applied to Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The comprehensive benefits of energy saving and loss reduction for flexible substation in active distribution network are related to application and promotion prospect of this technology. To this end, the working principle of power electronic transformers in flexible substations is analyzed, and the functions of flexible substations are clarified according to their composition. The characteristics of loss reduction and energy conservation for flexible substation are defined. The resulting benefits are identified and the corresponding benefit calculation method is determined. Taking a 10kV flexible substation as an example, the comprehensive benefit of energy saving and loss reduction in distribution network is calculated according to the actual configuration, and compared with the conventional substation with the same boundary conditions, the effectiveness advantage of flexible substation in energy saving and loss reduction is demonstrated. It also provides calculation methods and reference basis for energy saving and loss reduction analysis of similar projects in the future.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Forecasting Method for AC/DC Distribution System Based on Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: There are more diverse types of loads in an AC/DC distribution system, so it is much more difficult to grasp the change rules. Accurate load forecasting is important for the scheduling of AC/DC distribution system. Aiming at the precision problem of traditional short-term load forecasting methods, such as neural network, grey theory and support vector machine, this study uses the ensemble learning to improve the traditional forecasting methods, and proposes a gradient boosting method based on shallow neural network (GBSNN) as a base learner. Meanwhile, by using the Huber function as the loss function, it is robust to abnormal load data and can reduce the generalization error. Through simulation results and comparison analysis, the proposed short-term load forecasting method based on GBSNN has higher precision than other methods and better performance in load forecasting of AC/DC distribution system.

articleTitle: Study on AC Resistance Characteristics of Stranded Conductors by a High Precision Measuring System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Large cross-section conductors are increasingly used in HV/EHV power cables. However, additional losses can be produced due to the AC resistance affected by the skin-effect, magnetic hysteresis and eddy current, which will increase the line losses and reduce the current capacity. Therefore, reliable AC resistance measuring technology is essentially needed for accurate performance evaluation of in-service or new conductors. In this paper, a test method to measure the AC resistance characteristics of a conductor is studied and the experiment system is set up. By using this measuring system, the AC Resistance Characteristics of a large cross-section solid cylinder copper conductor is studied as a benchmark test; the results show that the differences between the measured values and theoretical values are less than 0.5%. In addition, experimental study is also carried on some common conductors used in power cable and overhead line. The test results can provide reference data for the evaluation of AC loss in actual lines.

articleTitle: The Research of Silicone Rubber Aging Factors by Attenuated Total Reflection Infrared Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For the purpose of studying the significance of various factors affecting the aging of composite insulator's silicone rubber shed, 139 insulators of 33 transmission lines in a province on the southeast coast were tested by attenuated total reflection infrared spectroscopy. The samples included different voltage levels, different ageing years and different manufacturers. Assuming that the inner layer of silicone rubber is unaged rubber and the outer is aging rubber, the difference of infrared spectra between the surface layer and the inner layer is used as the index of aging evaluation. The test data are analyzed by analysis of variance. It is found that the aging is more serious with the increase of ageing years, and the influence of manufactures on ageing is more significant than that of voltage level.

articleTitle: A Substation Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Substation Alarm Signal Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the existing substations, when the fault occurs, too many alarm signals will be sent to the substation layer, so that the monitoring personnel cannot find the critical fault information in time. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method using analyzed alarm signals in substation layer. Firstly, use the string matching algorithm to extract the information of alarm signals and establish signal model and then form the signal information table. Secondly, put the analyzed signals of "accident" and "change-position" level into the device fault causal logic models to determine the failure equipment of the substation. At the same time, if the protection and the circuit breaker incorrect action occur, the inference rules are used to make a preliminary judgment on the cause of the incorrect operation. Finally form a fault brief in substation layer which can assist the monitoring personnel to find faulty equipment and the cause of fault quickly.

articleTitle: A DC-side Harmonic Equivalent Circuit Based on Switching Function
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High voltage direct current transmission (HVDC) has been widely used in China in recent years due to its advantages of large transmission capacity, long distance, and low cost. It is significant to establish models for harmonic analysis in HVDC system. The switching function is used to get DC side harmonic voltage source, and the leakage inductance of transformer in both rectifier and inverter stations is equivalent to the DC side. A DC side harmonic equivalent calculation circuit for 6/12-pulse HVDC system is proposed accordingly. Using the simulation examples built in PSCAD/EMTDC, the correctness of the proposed model is verified.

articleTitle: On-line analysis of suspicious electricity stealing based on level-change detection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The existing data mining methods for suspicious electricity stealing detection, as utilized based on multi-month power consumption data, are of low timeliness. In this light, this paper proposes an online method for suspicious electricity stealing analysis, which is based on level change detection (LCD) on the users' daily power consumption sequence. The power consumption data are turned into cumulative sum values so as to reduce the influence of short-time data abnormality on the detection results. In the case study section, a numerical example is offered based on the daily consumption data of the customers in a residential area in North Shanghai, where the LCD method is also compared with other detection methods. The results show that the LCD method is of high coverage and accuracy, meanwhile it can realize timely online detection by moving the data window.

articleTitle: Current Regulator Generalized Design of Grid-Connected Converter with LCL Filter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In practical applications, the setting of control parameters of grid-connected converters is affected by various factors such as system power rating, filter parameters and sampling frequency. The parameters of PI controller in industry applications are often determined by trial and error method in a certain range, which is different from system to system. In addition, the selection range of controller parameters is large, making it difficult to distinguish system stability by trial and error method. To address these issues, a current regulator generalized design of grid-connected converter with LCL filter is presented in this paper. First, the filter parameters are derived as a function of four system parameters: power rating, DC side voltage, grid voltage and sampling frequency. Afterwards, the generalized transfer function and regulator parameter setting of different systems could be obtained. In order to improve the applicability even if the filter parameters are not designed according to the given rules ˈ the correction coefficients are introduced. It could be deduced that the proportional parameter can be designed by given cut-off frequency and system parameters, and integral parameter are related to the cut off frequency and proportional parameters. Finally, simulation and experimental results indicate that the generalized PI parameter design proposed in this paper has good performance and wide application range.

articleTitle: Analysis of Output Characteristics of LCC-C Inductively Coupled Power Transfer System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposed two design methods for LCC-C Inductively Coupled Power Transfer (ICPT) system. With the proposed topology and its designing methods, the detailed mathematical expression of the output power and efficiency was presented, as well as the analysis, and the influence of mutual inductance and load on the output power and efficiency was studied, then a multi-objective optimization method is proposed to solve the optimal value of output power and efficiency in the full-load range, and the design was verified by calculation and simulation. Finally, a 1 kW/85 kHz prototype with the design method of maximum efficiency is implemented, and experimental results demonstrate a 92.8% peak efficiency from dc power source to battery for the full-load operation.

articleTitle: Evaluation on Dynamic Switching Noise and Power Loss in High-voltage SiC IGBT
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this brief, an evaluation is made on the steady-state and dynamic electrical characteristics of high voltage Silicon Carbide (SiC) Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor (IGBT). Through two-dimensional (2-D) numerical simulation, the impact of the key parameters of the device cell on the performance trade-off between dynamic switching noise and power dissipation is studied. With carrier lifetime in the drift layer enhanced, the generation of high dv/dt noise can be suppressed to a certain extent, but the slowdown of turn-off transient and the resulting increased turn-off power loss weakens device’s maximum operation frequency. It is revealed that the width of JFET region is important for the design of forward voltage drop V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">on</inf> and onstate power loss as a narrow JFET greatly limits the carrier transport into drift region. The introducing of Current Enhancement Layer (CEL) is shown to be an effective way to control carrier injection at the emitter side, though its extension will get the turn-off loss E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">off</inf> increased. With a CEL of moderate doping concentration and extension of approximately 1 μm, the voltage rising rate of SiC IGBT under punch through can be reduced while the frequency capability keeps almost unaffected.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Evaluation Model of Distribution System Energy Efficiency Based on a CV-Grey clustering method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Energy efficiency evaluation of distribution systems is to estimate the efficiency of energy utilization on the premise of safe operation. With the continuous development of new technologies, such as diversified load, renewable energy and demand-side management, new requirements for energy efficiency evaluation are put forward. However, previous works mainly focus on traditional distribution networks and primarily based on subjective methods such as the analytic hierarchy process. In this paper, a comprehensive evaluation model of distribution network energy efficiency is proposed based on the coefficient of variation (CV) - Grey clustering method. Firstly, the evaluation index system of energy efficiency was established from the aspects of equipment, planning, operation and management. Secondly, a grey clustering method based on evaluation model of energy efficiency is introduced. It includes two steps: 1) the weights are determined based on the CV method, 2) the comprehensive evaluation model is established based on the grey triangular whitenization weight function. Finally, the efficiency level of an actual distribution network in eastern China is evaluated as an example. Case analysis shows that the proposed method could scientifically evaluate the energy efficiency, identify the weaknesses and provide references for planning and construction strategy of distribution networks.

articleTitle: Distributed Drones for Power Line Inspection with Weighted Consensus Control in Dynamic Network Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper introduces a weighted consensus control for multi-drone system for power line inspection in a dynamic networked computing environment. The system achieves global load balancing by transferring data with neighbor drones. Algorithms are introduced and their robustness properties against system dynamics are established. Examples and case studies demonstrate the feasibility in power line fault detection applications using multi-drone systems.

articleTitle: Dynamic Load Transfer Strategy of Campus Distribution Network Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, the campus distribution network (CDN) has become an important part of the urban distribution network, but the transformation and upgrading of the distribution network cannot match the growth of the school electricity load. Therefore, there are many problems such as unbalanced load between transformers, excessive peak-and- valley difference within transformers and unbalanced three-phase power existing in the universities. This thesis firstly analyzes the energy usage rules in order to summarize the common problems and causes of CDN. And then this paper proposes a dynamic load transfer strategy based on outgoing side optimization and flexible connection. Finally, taking the actual distribution network of a university in Beijing as an example, an optimization model is established and solved by genetic algorithm. The results of the example analysis indicate that the method can balance the load of each transformer while reducing the transformer loss.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional Stress Analysis of Generator-motor Pole-Lead with Different Structures
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper provides a way to enhance the stability of rotor structure of generator-motor in the design process. To improve the accuracy of generator-motor, this paper analyzes the mechanical stress and thermal stress of pole-led with different structure. Furthermore, a design direction to improve stability is proposed and discussed.

articleTitle: Control and Modulation Method for the Three-Phase Four-Switch Rectifier Based on α-β Stationary Frame
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As its low cost and it can be reconstructed from a three-phase six-switch topology with switch device fault, the three-phase four-switch rectifier (TPFSR) has attracted more and more attention. Firstly, the working principle of the TPFSR is analyzed in detail in this paper, and the mathematical model is established in α-β stationary reference frame. Then, a simplified space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) method is proposed. In order to solve the possible imbalance of the two capacitor voltage in the DC side, the strategy of adding capacitor voltage offset DC component to the reference current of the fault reconstructed bridge arm is proposed. Finally, the feasibility of the control and modulation method are verified by simulation and experimental results.

articleTitle: Composite Active Equilibrium Method for Lithium Ion Battery Pack
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The inconsistency of lithium-ion batteries can lead to the decrease of battery pack's capacity and lifetime, and can even seriously affect the electric vehicles' performance. A composite active equilibrium method, based on Cuk chopper circuit and flyback balancing circuit, is proposed in this paper. The key point of the proposed composite method is to group the battery into different battery subgroups and divide equalization process into two parts: intra-group equilibrium and inter-group equilibrium. The battery's state of charge (SOC) is taken as the equilibrium criterion to formulate the equilibrium strategy. We combine recursive least squares algorithm with forgetting factor and the extended Kalman filter algorithm to estimate the SOC of battery. The equilibrium model is built through Matlab/Simulink. The simulation results show that the composite active equilibrium method can decrease the balancing time by 47.35% and increase the equilibrium effect by 55.32% compared with the conventional cell to cell equilibrium method, and the method can effectively improve the battery pack's available capacity in charging or discharging process.

articleTitle: Simulation of Thermophysical Parameters in the Natural Circulation Evaporative Cooling System of Hydro-generator Stator Busbar
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The evaporative cooling technology is a novel type of generator cooling technology, with those advantages of high-safety, high-efficiency and energy-saving. It depends on the latent heat of cooling medium to carry off the heat discharged by generator. In the natural circulation evaporative cooling system of hydro-generator, the gas mass flow ratio and temperature distribution are the key thermophysical parameters of the system. A calculation program was independently developed for the simulation of the operating state of system and the commercial software Ansys CFX was chosen for the simulation of temperature distribution of the cooling medium in the stator busbars. The simulation results show that with the heat load increasing, the gas mass flow ratio and the cooling medium's temperatures in the stator busbars increases. The cooling medium's temperatures along the length of the stator busbars is distributed smoothly. The error between the two simulation methods was lower than 9% under the experimental conditions.

articleTitle: Technology Summary on the Application of Variable-Speed Pump-Turbine Units for Wind Storage Operation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Variable-speed pump-turbine units are used as the large capacity flexible and fast storage system for peak and frequency modulation in grid. There are several advantages as follows: the total energy conversion efficiency is nearly 80%. The modulation performance that ms-level time can be achieve MWlevel power response. Possibility of active power control in pumping mode. In the generating mode, the range of unit output is wide than conventional units. With the help of flywheel effect, network stability improvement by instantaneous active power injection in the grid. Summing up the above, variable-speed pump-turbine units are useful in concentration area of wind power and other new energy. And it can be used to solve the problem of large-scale wind power integration. The operation characteristics of Variable-speed pump-turbine units and the operation characteristics of wind power output is taken into account in this paper. Variable-speed principle, physical operating characteristics, operating parameters and economic investment of variable-speed pump-turbine units is presented. And the combined operation technology of variable-speed pumpturbine units and wind power is summarized.
